subject.name: Iqtisodiyot nazariyasi 1
subject.description_en: Comprehensive study of fundamental economic principles and theories

questions.text_en: What does the economic problem of scarcity mean?
options: Resurslar ham, inson ehtiyojlari ham qat'iy cheklangan
Faqat kambag'al davlatlarda resurslar yetishmaydi
Resurslar cheklangan, inson ehtiyojlari esa cheksizdir
Inson ehtiyojlari cheklangan, resurslar esa cheksizdir
options_ru: И ресурсы, и потребности людей строго ограничены
Ресурсов не хватает только в бедных государствах
Ресурсы ограничены, а потребности людей безграничны
Потребности людей ограничены, а ресурсы безграничны
options_en: Both resources and human wants are strictly limited
Poor countries lack resources while rich ones do not
Resources are limited while human wants are unlimited
Human wants are limited while resources are unlimited
questions.explanation_en: Scarcity is the contradiction between unlimited, growing wants and the limited resources available to satisfy them. Wants are not limited, resources are not unlimited, and scarcity exists in rich countries too.

questions.text_en: Economics as a science studies primarily:
options: Davlat boy fuqarolardan soliqlarni qanday yig'ishi
Buxgalterlar firma operatsiyalarini qanday yozishi
Injenerlar mashina texnologiyasini qanday yaxshilashi
Jamiyat cheklangan resurslarni ehtiyojlarga taqsimlashi
options_ru: Как государство собирает налоги с богатых граждан
Как бухгалтеры учитывают операции фирмы и склада
Как инженеры улучшают технологию работы машин
Как общество распределяет ограниченные ресурсы
options_en: How governments collect taxes from rich citizens
How accountants record the transactions of a firm
How engineers improve the technology of machines
How society allocates limited resources among needs
questions.explanation_en: Economics is the science of allocating scarce resources among competing needs. Taxation, accounting and engineering are narrower applied fields, not the general subject of economics.

questions.text_en: A point lying inside the production possibilities curve shows:
options: Erishib bo'lmaydigan ishlab chiqarish hajmini
Ikki tovarning maksimal ishlab chiqarilishini
Mavjud resurslardan samarasiz foydalanishni
Barcha resurslardan to'liq foydalanishni
options_ru: Недостижимое при данных ресурсах сочетание
Максимальный возможный выпуск обоих товаров
Неэффективное использование имеющихся ресурсов
Полное и эффективное использование ресурсов
options_en: An output combination that is unattainable
Maximum possible output of both the goods
Inefficient use of the available resources
Full and efficient use of all the resources
questions.explanation_en: Inside points are attainable but wasteful: some resources are idle or badly used. Full efficiency corresponds to points on the curve, and unattainable combinations lie outside it.

questions.text_en: A point lying outside the production possibilities curve represents:
options: Hozirgi texnologiyada erishilmaydigan hajm
Ikki xil tovarning teng ishlab chiqarilishi
Resurslardan samarali, lekin qimmat foydalanish
Resurslarning bo'sh turishi va ishsizlik o'sishi
options_ru: Недостижимый при данной технологии выпуск
Равное производство двух видов этих товаров
Эффективное, но дорогое применение ресурсов
Простой ресурсов и рост уровня безработицы
options_en: Unattainable output at current technology
Equal production of the two kinds of goods
Efficient but costly use of the resources
Idle resources and high unemployment rate
questions.explanation_en: Outside points exceed what the existing stock of resources and technology can produce, so they are unattainable until the curve shifts out. Idle resources place the economy inside the curve instead.

questions.text_en: The opportunity cost of a choice is:
options: Rad etilgan barcha variantlarning jami puli
Hajm oshgan sari kamayib boradigan xarajat
Tanlangan tovar uchun to'langan pul miqdori
Voz kechilgan eng yaxshi imkoniyat qiymati
options_ru: Суммарная стоимость всех отклонённых благ
Издержки, падающие с ростом объёма выпуска
Сумма денег, уплаченная за выбранный товар
Ценность лучшей из отвергнутых альтернатив
options_en: The total cost of all rejected alternatives
The cost that falls as output keeps rising
The money actually paid for the chosen good
The value of the best alternative forgone
questions.explanation_en: Opportunity cost is the value of the single best alternative given up, not the accounting payment and not the sum of all alternatives rejected.

questions.text_en: Why is the production possibilities curve usually bowed outward from the origin?
options: Hajm oshgan sari muqobil xarajat ortgani uchun
Hajm oshgan sari texnologiya yaxshilangani uchun
Egri chiziq bo'ylab didlar o'zgargani uchun
Resurslar ikki tovarga bir xilda mos kelgani uchun
options_ru: Альтернативные издержки растут с ростом выпуска
Технология улучшается по мере роста выпуска
Вкусы потребителей меняются вдоль всей кривой
Ресурсы одинаково пригодны для обоих товаров
options_en: Because opportunity cost rises as output grows
Because technology improves as output expands
Because consumer tastes change along the curve
Because resources suit both goods equally well
questions.explanation_en: Resources are not equally suited to both uses, so each extra unit of one good requires sacrificing ever more of the other: opportunity cost increases. Technology and tastes are held constant along a given curve.

questions.text_en: A straight-line production possibilities curve implies that:
options: Muqobil xarajatning o'zgarmasligini bildiradi
Muqobil xarajatning ortib borishini bildiradi
Muqobil xarajatning kamayib borishini bildiradi
Muqobil xarajatning nolga tengligini bildiradi
options_ru: Альтернативные издержки остаются постоянными
Альтернативные издержки постоянно возрастают
Альтернативные издержки постоянно убывают
Альтернативные издержки равняются нулю
options_en: Opportunity cost remains constant along it
Opportunity cost keeps rising along the line
Opportunity cost keeps falling along the line
Opportunity cost is equal to zero along it
questions.explanation_en: A constant slope means a constant rate of trade-off, so opportunity cost does not change. Zero opportunity cost would require a horizontal or vertical frontier, which would contradict scarcity.

questions.text_en: Which event shifts the production possibilities curve outward?
options: Mehnat bozorida ishsizlik darajasi o'sishi
Ishlab chiqarishni xizmatlarga ko'chirish
Ishlab chiqarish texnologiyasi takomillashishi
Ishlayotgan xodimlar sonining qisqarishi
options_ru: Рост уровня безработицы на рынке труда
Перенос производства из товаров в услуги
Совершенствование применяемой технологии
Сокращение числа занятых работников в стране
options_en: A rise in the unemployment rate of labour
A shift of production from goods to services
An improvement in the production technology
A fall in the number of the employed workers
questions.explanation_en: Better technology raises maximum attainable output, shifting the whole curve out. Unemployment or fewer workers moves the economy inside or shifts the curve inward, and reallocating output only moves along the curve.

questions.text_en: The three fundamental questions facing any economy are:
options: Kim, qayerda va qachon mahsulot sotishi
Qancha soliq, xarajat va qarz olish kerak
Nimani eksport, import va zaxira qilish
Nima, qanday va kim uchun ishlab chiqarish
options_ru: Кто, где и когда продаёт эти продукты
Сколько взимать налогов, тратить, занимать
Что экспортировать, ввозить и хранить
Что, как и для кого производить товары
options_en: Who, where and when to sell the products
How much to tax, spend and borrow abroad
What to export, import and store in stock
What, how and for whom to produce goods
questions.explanation_en: Scarcity forces every society to decide what goods to produce, by what technology, and how the output is distributed. The other sets are particular policy or trade questions, not the universal ones.

questions.text_en: Microeconomics differs from macroeconomics in that it studies:
options: Davlatlar o'rtasidagi savdo oqimlarini
Davlat budjeti taqchilligi va qarzlarini
Alohida firmalar, uy xo'jaliklari va bozorlar
Milliy mahsulot, inflyatsiya va ishsizlikni
options_ru: Потоки торговли между разными странами
Дефицит бюджета и государственный долг
Отдельные фирмы, домохозяйства и рынки
Национальный выпуск, инфляцию, занятость
options_en: International trade flows between countries
Government budget deficits and public debt
Separate firms, households and single markets
National output, inflation and unemployment
questions.explanation_en: Microeconomics analyses individual decision makers and single markets, while aggregate output, inflation, unemployment, trade balances and public debt belong to macroeconomics.

questions.text_en: A free good is a good that:
options: Mehnat resurslarisiz ishlab chiqarilgan tovar
Narxi tannarxidan ancha past bo'lgan tovar
Davlat tomonidan bepul taqdim etiladigan tovar
Barcha ehtiyojlardan ortiq miqdorda mavjud tovar
options_ru: Благо, созданное без применения труда людей
Благо с ценой намного ниже его себестоимости
Благо, бесплатно предоставляемое государством
Благо, существующее в избытке сверх нужд людей
options_en: A good produced with no use of labour at all
A good priced far below its cost of production
A good supplied by the state at no charge
A good existing in amounts exceeding all needs
questions.explanation_en: A free good is available in quantities greater than the wants for it, so it is not scarce and has no opportunity cost. Goods given away by the state or sold cheaply are still scarce economic goods.

questions.text_en: Marginal analysis in economics compares:
options: Harakatning umumiy naf va umumiy xarajatini
Qo'shimcha birlik nafi va qo'shimcha xarajatini
O'rtacha naf va mahsulotning o'rtacha xarajatini
O'tgan naf va kutilayotgan kelgusi xarajatni
options_ru: Общую выгоду с общими издержками действия
Выгоду и издержки одной дополнительной единицы
Среднюю выгоду со средними издержками выпуска
Прошлые выгоды с ожидаемыми будущими затратами
options_en: Total benefit with the total cost of action
Extra benefit with extra cost of one more unit
Average benefit with average cost of output
Past benefits with expected future costs
questions.explanation_en: Rational decisions are made at the margin: the agent weighs the additional benefit of one more unit against its additional cost. Totals and averages do not show whether the next unit is worth producing.

questions.text_en: Which of the following statements is positive rather than normative?
options: Jamiyatdagi daromad tengsizligi nomaqbuldir
Firmalar xodimga adolatli haq to'lashi shart
Soliq o'sishi iste'mol xarajatini kamaytiradi
Hukumat eng kam ish haqini oshirmog'i lozim
options_ru: Неравенство доходов в обществе недопустимо
Фирмы обязаны платить работникам справедливо
Рост налога снижает потребительские расходы
Правительство должно повысить минимум оплаты
options_en: Inequality of incomes in society is unacceptable
Firms should pay their workers a fair wage
A tax rise lowers consumer spending in a country
The government ought to raise the minimum wage
questions.explanation_en: A positive statement describes what is and can be tested against facts. The others contain value judgements about what ought to be and are therefore normative.

questions.text_en: The assumption 'ceteris paribus' in economic reasoning means that:
options: Boshqa barcha omillar o'zgarmas deb olinadi
Barcha agentlar to'liq ratsional harakat qiladi
Barcha bozorlar muvozanat narxida tozalanadi
Barcha resurslar vaqt bo'yicha teng taqsimlanadi
options_ru: Все прочие значимые факторы считаются неизменными
Все экономические агенты ведут себя рационально
Все рынки уравновешиваются по равновесной цене
Все ресурсы распределены равномерно во времени
options_en: All other relevant factors are held unchanged
All economic agents behave fully rationally
All markets clear at the equilibrium price
All resources are distributed evenly in time
questions.explanation_en: 'Other things equal' isolates the influence of one variable by freezing the rest. Rationality and market clearing are separate assumptions, not the meaning of this clause.

questions.text_en: An economy can produce either 100 tons of grain or 50 machines using all its resources. The opportunity cost of one machine equals:
options: Bir mashina uchun 100 tonna g'alla
Bir mashina uchun 2 tonna g'alla
Bir mashina uchun 0,5 tonna g'alla
Bir mashina uchun 50 tonna g'alla
options_ru: 100 тонн зерна на одну машину
2 тонны зерна на одну машину
0,5 тонны зерна на одну машину
50 тонн зерна на одну машину
options_en: 100 tons of grain per machine produced
2 tons of grain per machine produced
0.5 tons of grain per machine produced
50 tons of grain per machine produced
questions.explanation_en: Giving up all 100 tons of grain buys 50 machines, so one machine costs 100/50 = 2 tons of grain. The value 0.5 is the reciprocal, that is the cost of one ton of grain in machines.

questions.text_en: The slope of the production possibilities curve measures:
options: Iste'molda o'rnini bosishning chegaraviy darajasi
Band mehnatning o'rtacha unumdorlik darajasi
Pirovard mahsulotlarga talab elastikligi darajasi
Tovarlarni almashtirishning chegaraviy darajasi
options_ru: Предельная норма замещения в потреблении
Средняя производительность занятого труда
Эластичность спроса на конечные продукты
Предельная норма трансформации этих товаров
options_en: Marginal rate of substitution in consumption
Average productivity of the labour employed
Elasticity of demand for the final products
Marginal rate of transformation of the goods
questions.explanation_en: The slope shows how much of one good must be surrendered to gain a unit of the other in production, which is the marginal rate of transformation. Substitution rates and elasticities describe consumer behaviour instead.

questions.text_en: Points lying on the production possibilities curve itself represent:
options: Ikki tovarning samarali hajm birikmalari
Mavjud resurslardan samarasiz foydalanish
Bu iqtisodiyot uchun erishilmas birikmalar
Barcha iste'molchilar uchun teng ulushlar
options_ru: Эффективные сочетания выпуска двух товаров
Неэффективное использование ресурсов страны
Недостижимые для этой экономики сочетания
Равные доли выпуска для всех потребителей
options_en: Efficient output combinations of two goods
Inefficient use of the available resources
Combinations unattainable for this economy
Equal shares of output for all consumers
questions.explanation_en: On the frontier all resources are fully and efficiently employed, so more of one good always costs some of the other. The frontier says nothing about how output is shared out.

questions.text_en: If a country today devotes a larger share of its resources to capital goods, then:
options: Kelgusi ishlab chiqarish imkoniyati torayadi
Hozirgi iste'mol hajmi darhol ko'payadi
Tabiiy resurslar zaxirasi ko'payib boradi
Kelgusi ishlab chiqarish imkoniyati kengayadi
options_ru: Будущие производственные возможности сузятся
Текущее потребление сразу же увеличится
Запасы природных ресурсов страны возрастут
Будущие производственные возможности вырастут
options_en: Its future production possibilities will shrink
Its current consumption will immediately rise
Its stock of natural resources will increase
Its future production possibilities will expand
questions.explanation_en: Capital goods add to the productive stock, shifting the future frontier outward, but at the cost of lower consumption today. Natural resource endowments are not created by this choice.

questions.text_en: The saying 'there is no such thing as a free lunch' illustrates:
options: Tabiat bergan bepul ne'matlar haqidagi g'oya
Har qanday tanlovning muqobil xarajati g'oyasi
Cheksiz ishlab chiqarish resurslari g'oyasi
Katta bozorlarda xarajat kamayishi g'oyasi
options_ru: Идею бесплатных благ, даруемых природой
Идею альтернативных издержек любого выбора
Идею неограниченности ресурсов производства
Идею снижения издержек на больших рынках
options_en: The idea of free goods supplied by nature
The idea of opportunity cost of any choice
The idea of unlimited productive resources
The idea of falling costs in large markets
questions.explanation_en: The phrase means every benefit is obtained by giving up something else, which is precisely opportunity cost. It denies, rather than asserts, unlimited resources and costless goods.

questions.text_en: Economic resources, or factors of production, are best described as:
options: Davlat har yili yig'adigan soliq tushumlari
Ishlab chiqarishda qo'llanadigan noyob omillar
Uy xo'jaliklari sotib olgan pirovard tovarlar
Firma va uy xo'jaliklaridagi pul qoldiqlari
options_ru: Налоги, собираемые государством за год
Редкие ресурсы, применяемые в производстве
Конечные товары, покупаемые домохозяйствами
Денежные остатки фирм и домашних хозяйств
options_en: Taxes collected by the government each year
Scarce inputs that are used in production
Final goods purchased by households for use
Money balances held by firms and households
questions.explanation_en: Factors of production are the scarce inputs that create goods and services. Final goods are the result of production, while money and taxes are claims and transfers rather than productive inputs.

questions.text_en: A trade-off exists whenever:
options: Birini ko'proq olish boshqasidan voz kechishdir
Ikki tovar bitta firmada ishlab chiqariladi
Resurslar cheksiz, ehtiyojlar esa cheklangandir
Barcha tovar narxlari bir yo'nalishda o'zgaradi
options_ru: Больше одного блага означает меньше другого
Два товара выпускаются одной и той же фирмой
Ресурсы безграничны, а потребности ограничены
Цены всех товаров меняются в одну сторону
options_en: Getting more of one good means less of another
Two goods are produced by the very same firm
Resources are unlimited but wants are limited
Prices of all goods change in one direction
questions.explanation_en: A trade-off is the need to sacrifice one thing to obtain another, which follows directly from scarcity. Joint production by one firm or common price movements do not define a trade-off.

questions.text_en: Which cost should be ignored when a rational economic decision is made?
options: Tanlangan variantning muqobil xarajati
To'langan va qaytmaydigan botgan xarajat
Qo'shimcha birlikning chegaraviy xarajati
Tanlangan variantning kelgusi xarajati
options_ru: Альтернативные издержки выбранного варианта
Уже понесённые невозвратные издержки фирмы
Предельные издержки дополнительной единицы
Ожидаемые будущие издержки по варианту
options_en: Opportunity cost of the chosen option
A sunk cost already paid and unrecoverable
Marginal cost of the extra unit of output
Expected future cost of the chosen option
questions.explanation_en: Sunk costs cannot be recovered and do not change with the decision, so they are irrelevant at the margin. Opportunity, marginal and expected future costs all depend on the choice and must be counted.

questions.text_en: Economic efficiency of resource allocation is achieved when:
options: Ishlab chiqarilgan tovarlar teng bo'linadi
Har bir firma teng foyda olishiga erishiladi
Qurbonliksiz qo'shimcha hajm olish mumkin emas
Mavjud resurslarning bir qismi ishlatilmaydi
options_ru: Все произведённые товары делятся поровну
Каждая фирма получает одинаковую прибыль
Нельзя увеличить выпуск без отказа от другого
Часть имеющихся ресурсов остаётся незанятой
options_en: All produced goods are shared out equally
Every firm in the economy earns equal profit
No extra output is possible without sacrifice
Part of available resources stays unemployed
questions.explanation_en: Efficiency means the economy is on its frontier: more of any good requires less of some other. Idle resources indicate inefficiency, and equal shares or equal profits are questions of distribution.

questions.text_en: Economic models are used in economics mainly in order to:
options: Empirik ma'lumotlarni faraz bilan almashtirish
Real iqtisodiyotning har bir tafsilotini yozish
Haqiqatni soddalashtirib asosiy aloqani ochish
Bozor har doim benuqson ishlashini isbotlash
options_ru: Заменить эмпирические данные допущениями
Описать каждую деталь реальной экономики
Упростить реальность и выявить главные связи
Доказать безупречную работу любого рынка
options_en: Replace empirical data with pure assumptions
Describe every detail of the real economy
Simplify reality to reveal the key relations
Prove that markets always work without fault
questions.explanation_en: A model abstracts from secondary detail so that essential causal links become visible. Models neither prove ideological conclusions nor aim at exhaustive description, and they are tested against data.

questions.text_en: Rational behaviour of an economic agent means that the agent:
options: Berilgan cheklovlarda nafni maksimallashtiradi
Pul daromadini doimo bir yo'la sarflab yuboradi
Narx o'zgarsa ham qarorini hech o'zgartirmaydi
Jamoada qabul qilingan urf-odatlarga amal qiladi
options_ru: Максимизирует выгоду при данных ограничениях
Всегда сразу расходует весь денежный доход
Никогда не меняет решений при смене цен
Следует обычаям, принятым в его сообществе
options_en: Maximizes his benefit under given limitations
Always spends his whole money income at once
Never changes his decisions when prices move
Follows the customs accepted in his community
questions.explanation_en: Rationality means purposeful maximization of net benefit subject to constraints. Spending everything, ignoring prices or merely following custom are not implied by rational choice.

questions.text_en: A general rise in unemployment moves an economy:
options: Yangi va kengaygan imkoniyatlar chizig'iga
Imkoniyatlar chizig'i ichidagi nuqtaga
Imkoniyatlar chizig'idan tashqari nuqtaga
Imkoniyatlar chizig'i bo'ylab yuqoriga
options_ru: На новую, более широкую кривую возможностей
В точку внутри кривой её возможностей
В точку за пределами кривой возможностей
Вдоль кривой производственных возможностей
options_en: Onto a new and wider possibilities curve
To a point inside its possibilities curve
To a point outside its possibilities curve
Along its production possibilities curve
questions.explanation_en: Unemployed labour means resources are not fully used, which is an interior point. The curve itself does not move, because the stock of resources and technology is unchanged.

questions.text_en: The needs of society are treated as unlimited because:
options: Faqat olingan pul daromadiga bog'liq bo'ladi
Ishlab chiqarish rivoji bilan o'sib yangilanadi
Tabiat tomonidan bir yo'la belgilab qo'yilgan
Rivojlangan davlatlarda to'liq qondiriladi
options_ru: Они зависят только от денежного дохода семьи
Они растут и обновляются с развитием выпуска
Они заданы природой один раз и навсегда
Они полностью удовлетворены в развитых странах
options_en: They depend only on the money income earned
They grow and renew as production develops
They are fixed by nature once and for ever
They are met fully in the developed countries
questions.explanation_en: The law of rising needs states that as production and incomes develop, new wants appear faster than old ones are satisfied. Needs are therefore neither fixed by nature nor fully satisfied anywhere.

chapters.title_uz: Ishlab chiqarish jarayoni va uning natijalari

questions.text_en: Production in economics is understood as:
options: Pirovard mahsulotni iste'mol qilish jarayoni
Tovar va xizmatlar yaratish jarayonidir
Tovarlarni pulga almashtirish jarayonidir
Olingan daromadni taqsimlash jarayonidir
options_ru: Процесс потребления конечного продукта
Процесс создания товаров и услуг в стране
Процесс обмена товаров на деньги на рынке
Процесс распределения полученных доходов
options_en: A process of consuming the final product
A process of creating goods and services
A process of exchanging goods for money
A process of distributing earned incomes
questions.explanation_en: Production is the purposeful creation of goods and services. Exchange, distribution and consumption are the other three phases of reproduction that follow production.

questions.text_en: Which list contains only factors of production?
options: Ish haqi, renta, foiz, oddiy foyda
Talab, taklif, narx, bozor muvozanati
Yer, mehnat, kapital, tadbirkorlik
Pul, kredit, aksiya, bank omonati
options_ru: Заработная плата, рента, процент, прибыль
Спрос, предложение, цена, равновесие
Земля, труд, капитал, предпринимательство
Деньги, кредит, акции, вклады в банке
options_en: Wages, rent, interest and normal profit
Demand, supply, price, market balance
Land, labour, capital, entrepreneurship
Money, credit, shares, deposits in banks
questions.explanation_en: The classical factors are land, labour, capital and entrepreneurial ability. The second list contains financial assets, the third the incomes paid to factors, and the fourth market categories.

questions.text_en: Labour as a factor of production means:
options: Firma egasi oladigan boshqaruv tavakkali
Odamlarning maqsadli mehnat faoliyati
Firma ishlatadigan mashinalar soni
Firma foydalanadigan tabiiy resurslar
options_ru: Управленческий риск, берущийся владельцем
Целесообразная трудовая деятельность людей
Общее число машин, применяемых фирмой
Природные ресурсы, используемые фирмой
options_en: Managerial risk taken by a firm's owner
Purposeful work activity of people
Total number of machines used by a firm
Natural resources used by a given firm
questions.explanation_en: Labour is the conscious, purposeful expenditure of human physical and mental effort. Machines are capital, natural resources are land, and bearing risk is the entrepreneurial function.

questions.text_en: Capital as a factor of production is understood as:
options: Firma hisobvaraqlarida turgan pul mablag'i
Tovar yaratishda ishlatiladigan tabiat in'omi
Yollangan xodimlarning bilim va malakasi
Tovar yaratish uchun yaratilgan vositalar
options_ru: Денежные средства на счетах данной фирмы
Дары природы, применяемые в производстве
Знания и умения наёмных работников фирмы
Созданные средства для выпуска других благ
options_en: Money kept in the accounts of the firm
Gifts of nature used in making the goods
Skills and knowledge of hired workers
Produced means used to make other goods
questions.explanation_en: Real capital consists of produced means of production such as machines, buildings and materials. Money is financial capital, natural gifts are land, and skills form human capital embodied in labour.

questions.text_en: Entrepreneurship as a factor of production performs the function of:
options: Uy xo'jaliklari pul jamg'armasini to'plash
Boshqa omillarni birlashtirib tavakkal qilish
Sanoat uchun tabiiy resurslarni taklif etish
Ishlab chiqarishda jismoniy kuch sarflash
options_ru: Накопление денежных сбережений домохозяйств
Соединение прочих факторов и принятие риска
Предложение природных ресурсов для отрасли
Затраты физических усилий в производстве
options_en: Accumulating money savings of the households
Combining other factors and bearing the risk
Supplying natural resources for the industry
Providing the physical effort of production
questions.explanation_en: The entrepreneur unites land, labour and capital, takes decisions and bears the risk of loss. Supplying resources, physical effort and saving are functions of the other factor owners.

questions.text_en: Means of production consist of:
options: Asosiy kapital va mehnatga yaroqli aholi
Pirovard tovarlar va oraliq xizmatlar
Mehnat vositalari va mehnat buyumlari
Ishchi kuchi va firma ish haqi fondi
options_ru: Основной капитал и трудовое население
Конечные товары и промежуточные услуги
Средства труда и предметы труда фирмы
Рабочая сила и фонд оплаты труда фирмы
options_en: Fixed capital and working population
Final goods and intermediate services
Means of labour and objects of labour
Labour force and wage fund of a firm
questions.explanation_en: Means of production combine the means of labour, through which people act on nature, and the objects of labour, on which they act. The labour force itself is a separate element of productive forces.

questions.text_en: Technology of production describes:
options: Kompaniya foydasini soliqqa solish qoidasi
Bozorda tovar narxini belgilash usullari
Omillarni birlashtirib hajm olish usullari
Omillarga egalikning huquqiy shakllari
options_ru: Правила обложения прибыли компании
Методы установления цен на рынке товара
Способы соединения факторов для выпуска
Правовые формы собственности на факторы
options_en: Rules of taxing the profit of a company
Methods of pricing goods in the market
Ways of combining factors to get output
Legal forms of ownership of the factors
questions.explanation_en: Technology is the set of known methods of transforming inputs into output. Ownership forms, taxation and pricing belong to the legal and market environment, not to technology.

questions.text_en: Labour productivity is measured as:
options: To'langan ish haqi birligiga foyda
Sarflangan ish vaqti birligiga mahsulot
Kapital birligiga sarflangan ish vaqti
Qo'llangan kapital birligiga mahsulot
options_ru: Прибыль на единицу выплаченной оплаты труда
Выпуск на единицу затрат рабочего времени
Затраты рабочего времени на единицу капитала
Выпуск продукции на единицу занятого капитала
options_en: Profit per unit of the wages paid out
Output per unit of labour time spent
Labour time spent per unit of capital
Output per unit of capital employed
questions.explanation_en: Labour productivity is output divided by labour input, or equivalently output per worker per period. Output per unit of capital is capital productivity, a different indicator.

questions.text_en: The law of diminishing marginal returns states that:
options: O'zgaruvchi omil qo'shimchasi kamroq hajm beradi
O'zgaruvchi omil qo'shimchasi ko'proq hajm beradi
Korxona ko'lami o'sgach o'rtacha xarajat kamayadi
Barcha omillar teng ulushda oshirilishi shart
options_ru: Добавочные единицы фактора дают меньший прирост
Добавочные единицы фактора дают больший прирост
Средние издержки падают с ростом масштаба завода
Все факторы должны расти равными долями сразу
options_en: Extra units of a variable factor add less output
Extra units of a variable factor add more output
Average cost falls as the scale of plant grows
All factors must be increased in equal shares
questions.explanation_en: With at least one factor fixed, successive units of the variable factor eventually raise output by smaller and smaller amounts. Falling average cost with scale is the separate idea of economies of scale.

questions.text_en: In the short run a firm cannot change:
options: Qo'llanadigan o'zgaruvchi omil miqdorini
Mehnat sarflagan ish soatlari sonini
Sotib olinadigan xom ashyo miqdorini
Qo'llanadigan o'zgarmas omillar miqdorini
options_ru: Количество применяемых переменных факторов
Число отработанных работниками часов
Объём закупаемого фирмой сырья и топлива
Количество применяемых постоянных факторов
options_en: The quantity of variable factors used
The number of hours worked by labour
The volume of raw materials bought
The quantity of fixed factors applied
questions.explanation_en: The short run is defined precisely as the period in which at least one factor, such as plant and equipment, is fixed. Labour hours and material purchases are variable even in the short run.

questions.text_en: Marginal product of labour is:
options: Eng malakasiz ishchi ishlab chiqargan hajm
Oxirgi ishchiga to'langan ish haqi miqdori
Yana bir ishchidan olingan qo'shimcha hajm
Umumiy hajmning ishchilar soniga nisbati
options_ru: Выпуск наименее квалифицированного рабочего
Плата, выданная последнему рабочему фирмы
Прирост выпуска от найма ещё одного рабочего
Общий выпуск, делённый на число рабочих
options_en: Output of the least skilled worker hired
Wage paid to the last worker employed
Extra output from one more worker hired
Total output divided by number of workers
questions.explanation_en: Marginal product is the change in total output caused by adding one more unit of labour. Total output per worker is average product, and the wage is a cost, not a product.

questions.text_en: Average product of labour equals:
options: Umumiy mahsulotning mehnat sarfiga nisbati
Umumiy mahsulot va mehnat sarfi ayirmasi
Sarf o'zgarishiga mahsulot o'zgarishi
Umumiy mahsulot va ish haqi ko'paytmasi
options_ru: Общий продукт, делённый на затраты труда
Общий продукт минус затраты труда фирмы
Изменение продукта на изменение затрат
Общий продукт, умноженный на ставку платы
options_en: Total product divided by labour input
Total product minus the labour input
Change in product per change in input
Total product multiplied by the wage
questions.explanation_en: Average product is total product per unit of the factor used. The ratio of changes defines marginal product, and the other two expressions have no economic meaning.

questions.text_en: A production function shows the relation between:
options: Sarflangan omillar va maksimal mahsulot hajmi
Tovar narxi va unga bo'lgan talab miqdori
Xaridorlar daromadi va umumiy xarajati
Mahsulot tannarxi va firma foydasi hajmi
options_ru: Затратами факторов и максимальным выпуском
Ценой товара и величиной спроса на него
Доходом покупателей и их общими расходами
Себестоимостью выпуска и прибылью фирмы
options_en: Inputs used and the maximum output obtained
Price of a good and the quantity demanded
Income of buyers and their total spending
Cost of output and the profit of the firm
questions.explanation_en: The production function gives the greatest output technically obtainable from each combination of inputs. The other relations are the demand function, the consumption function and a profit identity.

questions.text_en: Economic efficiency of production means:
options: Natijani ishchilar o'rtasida teng taqsimlash
Minimal resurs sarfi bilan minimal natija
Minimal resurs sarfi bilan maksimal natija
Resurs sarfidan qat'i nazar maksimal natija
options_ru: Равное распределение результата по рабочим
Минимальный результат при минимуме затрат
Максимальный результат при минимуме затрат
Максимальный результат при любых затратах
options_en: Equal distribution of result among workers
Minimum result with minimum resource outlay
Maximum result with minimum resource outlay
Maximum result regardless of resource outlay
questions.explanation_en: Efficiency compares result with outlay, so it means obtaining the largest result from the smallest expenditure of resources. Output obtained at any cost whatsoever says nothing about efficiency.

questions.text_en: The extensive type of economic growth is based on:
options: Mavjud resurslardan yaxshi foydalanish hisobiga
Mehnat unumdorligini oshirib borish hisobiga
Yangi ilg'or texnologiya joriy etish hisobiga
Qo'shimcha resurslarni jalb etish hisobiga
options_ru: Лучшем использовании имеющихся ресурсов
Повышении производительности труда людей
Внедрении новой передовой технологии дела
Вовлечении дополнительных ресурсов в выпуск
options_en: Better use of the resources already used
Raising the productivity of the labour
Introducing new and advanced technology
Drawing extra resources into production
questions.explanation_en: Extensive growth increases output by enlarging the quantity of inputs. Higher productivity, better resource use and new technology are the sources of intensive growth.

questions.text_en: Intensive growth of production is achieved mainly through:
options: Sarflanadigan xom ashyo hajmining o'sishi
Ishlatilayotgan resurslar unumdorligi o'sishi
Yollanadigan ishchilar sonining ko'payishi
Haydaladigan yer maydonining kengayishi
options_ru: Увеличения объёма потребляемого сырья
Роста отдачи применяемых ресурсов фирмы
Увеличения числа наёмных работников
Расширения площади обрабатываемой земли
options_en: A greater volume of raw material consumed
Higher productivity of the used resources
A larger number of workers being hired
A wider area of land put under the plough
questions.explanation_en: Intensive growth comes from better quality and higher returns of the same resources. Adding workers, land or materials enlarges inputs and is therefore extensive growth.

questions.text_en: Simple reproduction means that production is repeated:
options: Har bir yangi davrda o'zgarmas hajmda
Har bir yangi davrda o'sib boruvchi hajmda
Har bir yangi davrda kamayuvchi hajmda
Davlat yillik belgilagan hajm doirasida
options_ru: В неизменном масштабе в каждом новом цикле
В растущем масштабе в каждом новом цикле
В убывающем масштабе в каждом новом цикле
В масштабе, задаваемом государством на год
options_en: On the same scale in each new cycle
On a growing scale in each new cycle
On a falling scale in each new cycle
On a scale set by the state each year
questions.explanation_en: In simple reproduction the whole surplus is consumed, so output is renewed at an unchanged scale. Growing scale is expanded reproduction and falling scale is contracting reproduction.

questions.text_en: Division of labour raises output mainly because it allows:
options: Sotiladigan tovar narxining oshishiga
Firmada pul zaxirasining ko'payishiga
Ixtisoslashuv va ishchi malakasi o'sishiga
Har bir firmaning to'liq mustaqilligiga
options_ru: Повышение цен на продаваемые фирмой товары
Увеличение денежных запасов самой фирмы
Специализацию и рост мастерства работника
Полную независимость каждой отдельной фирмы
options_en: Higher prices for the goods that are sold
A larger stock of money held by the firm
Specialization and growth of worker skill
Complete independence of each single firm
questions.explanation_en: Specialization lets each worker repeat a narrow operation, raising skill and saving time, which increases productivity. Division of labour in fact increases mutual dependence rather than independence.

questions.text_en: An intermediate product is a product that is:
options: Davlat strategik zaxira sifatida saqlaydigan
Keyingi ishlab chiqarishda ishlatiladigan
Uy xo'jaliklari pirovard iste'moli uchun
Boshqa davlatlarga sotish uchun chiqarilgan
options_ru: Хранится государством как стратегический запас
Расходуется в дальнейшем производстве благ
Покупается домохозяйствами для потребления
Вывозится в другие страны ради его продажи
options_en: Stored by the state as a strategic stock
Used further in the production of goods
Bought by households for their final use
Exported to other countries for selling
questions.explanation_en: Intermediate goods are consumed inside the production process and their value reappears in the final product, which is why they are excluded from final output to avoid double counting.

questions.text_en: Gross output of a firm differs from its net output by the value of:
options: Firma ishchilariga to'langan ish haqi puli
Davlat budjetiga to'langan soliq summasi
Mulkdor tasarrufida qolgan foyda summasi
Material xarajati va amortizatsiya summasi
options_ru: Заработной платы работников этой фирмы
Налогов, внесённых в бюджет государства
Прибыли, остающейся в распоряжении фирмы
Материальных затрат и амортизации капитала
options_en: Wages paid to the workers of this firm
Taxes paid into the budget of the state
Profit left at the disposal of the firm
Material costs and depreciation of capital
questions.explanation_en: Net output is gross output minus the consumed value of material inputs and worn-out capital. Wages and profit are parts of newly created value and are therefore contained in net output.

questions.text_en: Depreciation (amortization) in the production process means:
options: Kapital qiymatini mahsulotga asta o'tkazish
Asosiy kapital qiymatining asta o'sib borishi
Barcha material sarfini darhol hisobdan chiqarish
Bank krediti foizini muntazam to'lab borish
options_ru: Постепенный перенос стоимости капитала на благо
Постепенный рост стоимости основного капитала
Немедленное списание всех материальных затрат
Регулярная уплата процентов по кредиту банка
options_en: Gradual transfer of capital value to output
Gradual growth of the value of fixed capital
Immediate write-off of all material inputs
Regular payment of interest on a bank loan
questions.explanation_en: Fixed capital wears out over many cycles, and its value is carried into the cost of output in parts. Material inputs are consumed in a single cycle, and interest is a payment for borrowed funds.

questions.text_en: Capital productivity, the output-capital ratio, shows:
options: Mahsulot birligiga sarflangan material hajmi
Kapital birligiga to'g'ri keladigan ishchi soni
Asosiy kapital birligiga to'g'ri keladigan hajm
Mahsulot birligiga to'g'ri keladigan kapital
options_ru: Материальные затраты на единицу выпуска
Число занятых на единицу основного капитала
Выпуск на единицу основного капитала фирмы
Основной капитал на единицу выпуска фирмы
options_en: Material inputs used per unit of output
Workers employed per unit of fixed capital
Output produced per unit of fixed capital
Fixed capital used per unit of the output
questions.explanation_en: Capital productivity is output divided by the value of fixed capital. Its reciprocal is capital intensity, while the other ratios measure material intensity and capital-labour ratio.

questions.text_en: Material intensity of output is the ratio of:
options: Material xarajatining mahsulot hajmiga
Mahsulot hajmining material xarajatiga
Mehnat xarajatining mahsulot hajmiga
Asosiy kapitalning mahsulot hajmiga
options_ru: Материальных затрат к объёму выпуска
Объёма выпуска к материальным затратам
Затрат на оплату труда к объёму выпуска
Основного капитала к объёму выпуска благ
options_en: Material costs to the volume of output
Volume of output to the material costs
Labour costs to the volume of output
Fixed capital to the volume of output
questions.explanation_en: Material intensity measures how much material input is embodied in a unit of output, so lower values indicate resource saving. The inverse ratio measures the return on material inputs.

questions.text_en: Which activity belongs to the sphere of material production?
options: Davlat kollejida talabalarni o'qitish
Shahar klinikasida bemorlarni davolash
Yuridik firmada mijozlarga maslahat berish
Uy-joy va sanoat korxonalari qurilishi
options_ru: Обучение студентов в государственном вузе
Лечение больных в городской поликлинике
Консультирование клиентов юридической фирмой
Строительство жилья и промышленных заводов
options_en: Teaching of students in a state college
Treatment of patients in a city clinic
Advising of clients by a legal company
Building of houses and industrial plants
questions.explanation_en: Material production creates goods in a tangible form, as construction does. Education, health care and legal advice create services and belong to the non-material sphere.

questions.text_en: The productive forces of society include:
options: Aholining urf-odatlari va an'analari majmui
Ishlab chiqarish vositalari va ishchi kuchi
Mulkchilik va taqsimlash munosabatlari
Iqtisodiy hayotni tartibga soluvchi normalar
options_ru: Привычки и традиции населения этой страны
Средства производства и рабочая сила людей
Отношения собственности и распределения
Правовые нормы, регулирующие хозяйство
options_en: Habits and traditions of the population
Means of production and the labour force
Relations of ownership and distribution
Legal norms regulating the economic life
questions.explanation_en: Productive forces are the means of production together with the people who set them in motion. Ownership and distribution relations form the production relations, the other side of the mode of production.

questions.text_en: The main indicators of the economic result of production at the firm level are:
options: Firma yollagan ishchilarning umumiy soni
Zavod egallagan yer maydonining kattaligi
Bankdan olingan kreditning umumiy summasi
Mahsulot hajmi va olingan foyda miqdori
options_ru: Общее число наёмных работников этой фирмы
Площадь земли, занимаемой этим заводом
Общая сумма кредита, взятого в банке
Объём выпуска и полученная фирмой прибыль
options_en: Number of the workers hired by this firm
Area of the land occupied by the factory
Amount of the credit taken from the bank
Volume of output and the profit received
questions.explanation_en: Results of production are measured by output and the profit it yields. Workers, land and credit are inputs or sources of finance, that is costs rather than results.

questions.text_en: Production infrastructure includes:
options: Yo'llar, elektr tarmoqlari va aloqa liniyalari
Maktablar, teatrlar va sport muassasalari
Banklar, sug'urta fondlari va fond bozorlari
Konlar, neft quduqlari va ruda zaxiralari
options_ru: Дороги, электросети и линии связи страны
Школы, театры и спортивные учреждения
Банки, страховые фонды и фондовые рынки
Шахты, нефтяные скважины и залежи руды
options_en: Roads, power grids and communication lines
Schools, theatres and sport institutions
Banks, insurance funds and stock markets
Mines, oil wells and iron ore deposits
questions.explanation_en: Production infrastructure is the set of facilities serving the production process itself, such as transport, energy and communications. Schools and theatres form social infrastructure, and deposits are natural resources.

questions.text_en: An economic system is:
options: Aholi iste'mol qiladigan tovarlar ro'yxati
Jamiyat iqtisodiy hayotini tashkil etish usuli
Davlat parlamenti qabul qilgan qonunlar majmui
Bir xil tovar ishlab chiqaruvchi firmalar guruhi
options_ru: Перечень товаров, потребляемых населением
Способ организации экономической жизни общества
Набор законов, принятых парламентом страны
Группа фирм, выпускающих один вид товара
options_en: A list of goods consumed by the population
A way of organizing the economic life of society
A set of laws adopted by the state parliament
A group of firms producing one kind of good
questions.explanation_en: An economic system is the historically formed way a society organizes production, distribution, exchange and consumption. Laws, branches and consumption lists are only elements or results of such a system.

questions.text_en: The main feature of a command (centrally planned) economy is:
options: Xususiy mulk va tovar narxlarining erkinligi
Qarorlar ajdodlar urf-odatlariga asoslanishi
Davlat va xususiy sektor ulushlari tengligi
Markazlashgan reja va resurslarga davlat egaligi
options_ru: Частная собственность и свободные цены
Решения на основе обычаев, данных предками
Равные доли госсектора и частного сектора
Централизованный план и госсобственность
options_en: Private ownership and free pricing of all goods
Decisions based on customs handed down by elders
Equal shares of the state and private sectors
Central planning and state ownership of resources
questions.explanation_en: In a command economy the state owns the means of production and a central body issues binding plans. Private ownership with free prices characterizes a market economy, and custom rules a traditional one.

questions.text_en: In a market economy the question 'what to produce' is decided by:
options: Iste'molchilar bozordagi talabi orqali
Hukumatning markaziy reja organi tomonidan
Avloddan avlodga o'tgan an'analar asosida
Tarmoq ishchilarining kasaba uyushmalari
options_ru: Потребителями через их спрос на рынке
Центральным плановым органом власти
Традициями, идущими от поколений
Профсоюзами работников этой отрасли
options_en: Consumers through their demand in the market
A central planning body of the government
Traditions passed from one generation on
Trade unions of the workers of the branch
questions.explanation_en: Consumer demand, expressed in prices and purchases, signals to producers what is worth producing. Central organs decide this in a command economy and custom decides it in a traditional one.

questions.text_en: A mixed economy is characterized by:
options: Iqtisodiyotda davlat rolining mutlaq yo'qligi
Qarorlarning faqat an'analar asosida qabul qilinishi
Bozor kuchlari va davlat tartibga solishi uyg'unligi
Bozorning davlat rejasi bilan to'liq almashuvi
options_ru: Полное отсутствие роли государства в хозяйстве
Принятие решений только на основе традиций
Сочетание рыночных сил и регулирования государства
Полная замена рынка государственным планом
options_en: Complete absence of any state role in the economy
Decisions made only on the basis of traditions
Interaction of market forces and state regulation
Full replacement of the market by state planning
questions.explanation_en: A mixed economy combines private market coordination with state regulation and a public sector. Complete planning, a complete absence of the state and pure custom describe the other three models.

questions.text_en: A traditional economy relies mainly on:
options: Urf-odatlar, jamoa qoidalari va qo'l mehnati
Markaziy reja va davlat besh yillik topshiriqlari
Fond bozorlari va xususiy aksiyadorlik jamiyatlari
Ilg'or texnologiya va jahon erkin savdo tizimi
options_ru: Обычаи, общинные правила и ручной труд людей
Центральный план и пятилетние задания власти
Фондовые рынки и частные акционерные общества
Передовая технология и свободная мировая торговля
options_en: Customs, communal rules and manual labour of people
Central plans and five-year targets of the state
Stock markets and private joint-stock companies
Advanced technology and free world trade system
questions.explanation_en: A traditional economy is governed by custom, communal ownership and manual technique. Five-year plans belong to the command model, while stock markets and advanced technology belong to developed market systems.

questions.text_en: The main drawback of a command economy is:
options: Tovarlarni ortiqcha ishlab chiqarish inqirozi
Yoshlar o'rtasidagi yuqori ishsizlik darajasi
Rag'bat kuchsizligi va tovar tanqisligi
Aholi daromadlaridagi chuqur tengsizlik
options_ru: Частые кризисы перепроизводства товаров
Высокая безработица среди молодёжи страны
Слабость стимулов и дефицит многих товаров
Глубокое неравенство доходов населения
options_en: Frequent crises of overproduction of goods
High unemployment among the young workers
Weak incentives and shortages of many goods
Deep inequality of incomes of the population
questions.explanation_en: Without profit incentives and price signals a planned economy produces chronic shortages and low quality. Sharp inequality, overproduction crises and open unemployment are typical problems of market systems.

questions.text_en: Ownership as an economic category expresses:
options: Ne'matlarni o'zlashtirish bo'yicha munosabatlar
Mashina va mehnat o'rtasidagi texnik aloqalar
Faqat fuqarolik kodeksidagi huquqiy qoidalar
Ishlatiladigan narsalarning jismoniy belgilari
options_ru: Отношения между людьми по присвоению благ
Технические связи машин и труда работника
Правовые нормы, записанные в кодексе
Физические свойства используемых вещей
options_en: Relations among people over appropriating goods
Technical links between machines and labour
Legal rules written in the civil code only
Physical features of the things being used
questions.explanation_en: Economically, ownership is a relation between people concerning the appropriation of conditions and results of production. Its legal expression in a code is secondary, and it is not a technical or physical property of things.

questions.text_en: The classical triad of ownership rights includes:
options: Sotib olish, saqlash va sug'urta qilish
Egalik qilish, foydalanish va tasarruf etish
Ishlab chiqarish, almashish va iste'mol qilish
Rejalashtirish, hisobga olish va nazorat
options_ru: Покупка, хранение и страхование блага
Владение, пользование и распоряжение благом
Производство, обмен и потребление блага
Планирование, учёт и контроль над благом
options_en: Purchase, storage and insurance of it
Possession, use and disposal of an object
Production, exchange and consumption of it
Planning, accounting and control over it
questions.explanation_en: The triad of ownership rights is possession, use and disposal. The other lists name phases of reproduction or particular management and commercial functions.

questions.text_en: The subject of ownership relations is:
options: Narsa sotiladigan bozor narxi miqdori
Narsa keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan daromad
Narsaga egalik qiluvchi shaxs yoki organ
Egalik qilinadigan narsa yoki resurs
options_ru: Цена, по которой продаётся эта вещь
Доход, который способна дать вещь
Лицо или орган, владеющий этой вещью
Вещь или ресурс, которым владеют
options_en: The price at which the thing is sold
The income that the thing can bring
The person or body that owns the thing
The thing or resource that is owned
questions.explanation_en: The subject is the owner, that is an individual, collective or state body, while the thing owned is the object of ownership. Price and income are consequences of using the object.

questions.text_en: Private ownership of the means of production means that they belong to:
options: Tumandagi mahalliy boshqaruv organlariga
Alohida shaxslar yoki yuridik shaxslarga
Davlat va uning markaziy ijro organlariga
Mamlakat butun aholisiga birgalikda
options_ru: Местным органам самоуправления района
Отдельным лицам или юридическим лицам
Государству и его центральным органам
Всему населению страны в его совокупности
options_en: Local self-government bodies of a district
Individual persons or separate legal bodies
The state and its central executive organs
The whole population of the country jointly
questions.explanation_en: Private ownership vests the rights of possession, use and disposal in particular persons or private legal entities. The remaining options describe state, public and municipal forms of ownership.

questions.text_en: Joint-stock (corporate) ownership arises when the capital of an enterprise is formed by:
options: Ko'p mulkdorlar aksiyalarini birlashtirish
Markaziy vazirlikning budjet mablag'lari
Yakka mulkdorning shaxsiy jamg'armalari
Markaziy bank bergan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kredit
options_ru: Объединения акций множества собственников
Бюджетных средств центрального министерства
Личных сбережений единственного владельца
Прямых кредитов, выданных центральным банком
options_en: Pooling the shares of many separate owners
Budget transfers from the central ministry
Personal savings of a single sole owner
Credits given directly by the central bank
questions.explanation_en: A joint-stock company unites the contributions of many shareholders, each owning a part of the capital. Budget financing creates state property and personal savings create individual property.

questions.text_en: Privatization is:
options: Xususiy mulkni davlat tasarrufiga o'tkazish
Davlat mulkini vazirliklar o'rtasida bo'lish
Davlat mulkini xorij firmalariga ijaraga berish
Davlat mulkini xususiy egalarga o'tkazish
options_ru: Передача частного имущества государству
Раздел госимущества между министерствами
Сдача госимущества в аренду зарубежным фирмам
Передача госимущества частным собственникам
options_en: Transfer of private property to the state
Division of state property among ministries
Renting of state property to foreign firms
Transfer of state property to private owners
questions.explanation_en: Privatization changes the owner: state property becomes private property. The reverse process is nationalization, while redistribution between ministries or leasing leaves ownership with the state.

questions.text_en: Nationalization means the transfer of property:
options: Bir xususiy egadan boshqasiga o'tishini
Mahalliy organdan mehnat jamoasiga o'tishini
Xususiy qo'ldan davlat mulkiga o'tishini
Davlat qo'lidan xususiy mulkka o'tishini
options_ru: От одного частного владельца к другому
От местных органов к трудовому коллективу
Из частных рук в собственность государства
Из рук государства в частную собственность
options_en: From one private owner to another owner
From local bodies to the labour collective
From private hands into state ownership
From state hands into private ownership
questions.explanation_en: Nationalization converts private assets into state property and is the opposite of privatization. Transfers between private owners are ordinary sales, not changes in the form of ownership.

questions.text_en: According to the formational approach, the historical sequence of societies is:
options: Ibtidoiy, quldorlik, feodal, kapitalistik
Feodal, ibtidoiy, kapitalistik, quldorlik
Kapitalistik, feodal, quldorlik, ibtidoiy
Quldorlik, ibtidoiy, kapitalistik, feodal
options_ru: Первобытное, рабовладельческое, феодальное, капиталистическое
Феодальное, первобытное, капиталистическое, рабовладельческое
Капиталистическое, феодальное, рабовладельческое, первобытное
Рабовладельческое, первобытное, капиталистическое, феодальное
options_en: Primitive, slave-owning, feudal, capitalist
Feudal, primitive, capitalist, slave-owning
Capitalist, feudal, slave-owning, primitive
Slave-owning, primitive, capitalist, feudal
questions.explanation_en: The formational approach orders societies by the dominant mode of production: primitive communal, slave-owning, feudal and capitalist. The other sequences disturb this historical order.

questions.text_en: The civilizational approach to the stages of social development stresses:
options: Faqat moddiy texnika taraqqiyot darajasini
Faqat jamiyatdagi sinfiy kurash holatini
Jamiyat madaniyati, dini va qadriyatlarini
Faqat resurslarga mulkchilik shaklini
options_ru: Только уровень материальной техники
Только классовую борьбу внутри общества
Культуру, религию и ценности общества
Только форму собственности на ресурсы
options_en: Only the level of the material technique
Only the class struggle inside a society
Culture, religion and values of a society
Only the form of ownership of resources
questions.explanation_en: The civilizational approach explains development through culture, spiritual values and institutions as well as technology. Reducing development to ownership forms or class struggle is characteristic of the formational approach.

questions.text_en: A post-industrial society is distinguished by the leading role of:
options: Ko'mir, neft va metall rudasini qazib olish
Xizmatlar, informatsiya va bilimlar sohasi
Og'ir sanoat va ommaviy ishlab chiqarish
Qishloq xo'jaligi va hunarmandchilik sohasi
options_ru: Добыча угля, нефти и руд чёрных металлов
Услуги, информация и сфера знаний людей
Тяжёлая промышленность и массовый выпуск
Сельское хозяйство и ремесленные мастерские
options_en: Mining of coal, oil and metal ores
Services, information and knowledge work
Heavy industry and mass production
Agriculture and handicraft workshops
questions.explanation_en: In the post-industrial stage services, information and knowledge become the main sphere of employment and value creation. Heavy industry marks the industrial stage and agriculture the pre-industrial one.

questions.text_en: The transition from a command to a market economy requires above all:
options: Davlat vazirliklari sonini ko'paytirish
Besh yillik reja tizimiga to'liq qaytish
Iqtisodiyotni butunlay tashqi dunyodan yopish
Mulkni isloh qilib narxlarni erkinlashtirish
options_ru: Рост числа государственных министерств
Возврат к системе пятилетних планов власти
Полное закрытие экономики от внешнего мира
Реформа собственности и освобождение цен
options_en: Growth of the number of state ministries
Return to the system of five-year plans
Full closing of the economy to the world
Reform of ownership and freeing of prices
questions.explanation_en: Transition begins with creating private owners and letting prices be formed by supply and demand. Expanding the planning apparatus or closing the economy would restore the command system instead.

questions.text_en: In a market economy prices of goods are formed:
options: Talab va taklifning erkin o'zaro ta'sirida
Davlat markaziy narx qo'mitasi tomonidan
Mahalliy qishloq jamoasi urf-odatlari bilan
Eng katta firma hisobchilari tomonidan
options_ru: Свободным взаимодействием спроса и предложения
Центральным комитетом цен при государстве
Обычаями местной сельской общины и старейшин
Бухгалтерами самой крупной фирмы отрасли
options_en: By free interaction of demand and supply
By the central price committee of the state
By the customs of the local rural community
By the cost accountants of the largest firm
questions.explanation_en: Market prices emerge from the free interaction of many buyers and sellers. Administrative price setting belongs to the command system, and custom governs pricing only in traditional economies.

questions.text_en: The state in a mixed economy is needed mainly in order to:
options: Har bir korxona uchun hajm rejasini belgilash
Har bir tarmoqda ishchi ish haqini belgilash
Barcha ishlab chiqarish vositalariga egalik qilish
Jamoat ne'matlari berish va nuqsonlarni tuzatish
options_ru: Задавать план выпуска каждому предприятию
Устанавливать оплату труда каждому рабочему
Владеть всеми средствами производства в стране
Поставлять общественные блага и исправлять сбои
options_en: Set the output plan of every single enterprise
Fix the wage of each worker in every industry
Own all the means of production in the country
Supply public goods and correct market failures
questions.explanation_en: The state supplies goods the market underprovides and corrects failures such as externalities and monopoly. Planning every enterprise, fixing every wage or owning everything would convert the system into a command economy.

questions.text_en: Which description best fits the modern developed economies?
options: To'liq rejali sof buyruqbozlik iqtisodiyoti
Davlat ishtirokisiz sof bozor iqtisodiyoti
Jamoaga asoslangan an'anaviy iqtisodiyot
Yirik xususiy sektorli aralash iqtisodiyot
options_ru: Чисто командная экономика с полным планом
Чисто рыночная экономика без государства
Традиционная экономика, основанная на общине
Смешанная экономика с крупным частным сектором
options_en: Pure command economy with full planning
Pure market economy with no state at all
Traditional economy based on the community
Mixed economy with a large private sector
questions.explanation_en: All developed countries today combine private enterprise with substantial state regulation and public spending, which is the mixed model. Purely command, purely market and traditional systems are theoretical or historical cases.

questions.text_en: Municipal property belongs to:
options: Hududda ishlayotgan xorijiy investorlarga
Hududning mahalliy boshqaruv organlariga
Butun mamlakatning markaziy hukumatiga
Shahardagi kompaniyaning aksiyadorlariga
options_ru: Иностранным инвесторам на территории
Местным органам самоуправления территории
Центральному правительству всей страны
Частным акционерам городской компании
options_en: Foreign investors operating in that territory
Local self-government bodies of a territory
The central government of the whole country
Private shareholders of a city-based company
questions.explanation_en: Municipal property is a form of public property managed by local self-government on behalf of the local population. Central government assets are state property and shareholders' assets are private.

questions.text_en: Intellectual property covers rights to:
options: Yer uchastkalari, konlar va o'rmon maydonlari
Binolar, mashinalar va transport vositalari
Aksiyalar, obligatsiyalar va bank omonatlari
Ixtirolar, san'at asarlari va tovar belgilari
options_ru: Земельные участки, месторождения и леса
Здания, машины и транспортные средства
Акции, облигации и вклады в банках страны
Изобретения, произведения и товарные знаки
options_en: Land plots, mineral deposits and forests
Buildings, machines and transport means
Shares, bonds and deposits in the banks
Inventions, works of art and trade marks
questions.explanation_en: Intellectual property concerns the results of creative mental labour, such as inventions, works and trade marks. Land is natural property, buildings are physical capital and securities are financial assets.

questions.text_en: Why are clearly defined property rights important for a market economy?
options: Xususiy firmalar o'rtasidagi raqobatni yo'qotadi
Investitsiya va innovatsiyaga rag'bat yaratadi
Fuqarolar daromadlarini to'liq tenglashtiradi
Davlatga butun hajmni rejalashtirishga imkon beradi
options_ru: Устраняют конкуренцию между частными фирмами
Создают стимулы вкладывать и внедрять новое
Делают все доходы граждан полностью равными
Позволяют государству планировать весь выпуск
options_en: They remove competition between private firms
They create incentives to invest and innovate
They make all incomes of citizens fully equal
They allow the state to plan the whole output
questions.explanation_en: Secure rights let owners keep the results of their decisions, which encourages investment, innovation and voluntary exchange. Property rights do not equalize incomes and they support rather than remove competition.

questions.text_en: Denationalization differs from privatization in that it:
options: Barcha davlat zavodlarini to'liq yopishni bildiradi
Davlat korxonalarini oddiy qayta nomlashdir
Egani o'zgartirmay davlat rolini kamaytiradi
Aktivlarni doimo xorijiy investorga o'tkazadi
options_ru: Означает полное закрытие всех госзаводов
Является простым переименованием госпредприятий
Снижает роль государства без смены владельца
Всегда передаёт активы иностранным инвесторам
options_en: Means the full closing of all state factories
Is a simple renaming of the state enterprises
Reduces the state role without changing owners
Always transfers assets to foreign investors
questions.explanation_en: Denationalization weakens state administrative control and grants enterprises economic independence, while ownership may remain public. Privatization, by contrast, actually changes the owner.

questions.text_en: The object of ownership relations can be:
options: Faqat mamlakatning tabiiy resurs zaxirasi
Yer, kapital tovarlar va intellektual mahsulot
Faqat bank hisobvaraqlaridagi pul mablag'lari
Faqat yollangan xodimlarning ishchi kuchi
options_ru: Только природные ресурсы данной страны
Земля, капитальные блага и продукты знаний
Только денежные средства на счетах банков
Только рабочая сила наёмных работников
options_en: Only the natural resources of the country
Land, capital goods and intellectual products
Only money kept in the accounts of the banks
Only the labour force of the hired workers
questions.explanation_en: Objects of ownership include all economic resources and results: land, capital, consumer goods, money and intellectual products. The other options narrow the object to a single kind of asset.

questions.text_en: In which system is the question 'for whom to produce' solved mainly by incomes earned in markets?
options: Rivojlangan bozor iqtisodiyoti tizimida
Markazlashgan rejali buyruq iqtisodiyotida
An'anaviy jamoa tipidagi iqtisodiyotda
Yopiq natural xo'jalik iqtisodiyotida
options_ru: В развитой рыночной экономике страны
В плановой централизованной экономике
В традиционной общинной экономике
В закрытом натуральном хозяйстве
options_en: In a developed market economy of a country
In a centrally planned command economy
In a traditional communal type economy
In a closed natural subsistence economy
questions.explanation_en: In a market system purchasing power from factor incomes determines who receives the goods. Planned systems distribute administratively, traditional systems by custom, and subsistence economies consume their own output.

questions.text_en: The economic role of competition in a market system is to:
options: Kuchsiz ishlab chiqaruvchini narxdan saqlash
Iqtisodiyotda narx mexanizmini almashtirish
Firmalarni xarajatni kamaytirishga undash
Barcha firmalarga teng foydani kafolatlash
options_ru: Защищать слабых производителей от цен
Заменять ценовой механизм в экономике
Побуждать фирмы снижать издержки выпуска
Гарантировать равную прибыль всем фирмам
options_en: Protect weak producers from any price change
Replace the price mechanism in the economy
Press firms to reduce their production costs
Guarantee equal profits to all market firms
questions.explanation_en: Competition forces producers to cut costs, improve quality and innovate in order to keep customers. It does not guarantee equal profits, shelter weak producers, or replace prices, which it works through.

questions.text_en: In economic theory, what is a commodity?
options: Ayirboshlash uchun ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulot
Faqat o'zi iste'mol qilish uchun yaratilgan mahsulot
Cheklanmagan tarzda mavjud bo'lgan tabiiy resurs
Hech qachon moddiy shaklga ega bo'lmaydigan xizmat
options_ru: Продукт, произведённый для обмена, а не для себя
Продукт, созданный только для личного потребления
Природный ресурс, доступный без каких-либо границ
Услуга, никогда не принимающая материальной формы
options_en: A good produced for exchange rather than own use
A good produced solely for the producer's own use
A free natural resource available without any limit
A service that never takes a material form at all
questions.explanation_en: A commodity is a product of labour made for sale or exchange, not for the producer's own consumption. Option 1 describes a product of natural (subsistence) economy; option 2 describes a free good that is not a commodity because it is not produced by labour and is not scarce; option 3 confuses commodity with the material/immaterial distinction, since services can also be commodities.

questions.text_en: Which pair of properties does every commodity possess?
options: Tanqislik va foydalilikning to'liq yo'qligi
Bozor narxi va davlat ishlab chiqarish subsidiyasi
Iste'mol qiymati va qiymat (ayirboshlash qiymati)
Mehnat xarajatlari va umumiy jismoniy og'irlik
options_ru: Редкость и полное отсутствие полезности блага
Рыночная цена и государственная субсидия
Потребительная стоимость и стоимость обмена
Затраты труда и общий физический вес товара
options_en: Scarcity and the complete lack of utility
Market price and a state production subsidy
Use value and value, or exchange value
Labour costs and total physical weight
questions.explanation_en: Classical analysis shows a commodity as a unity of two properties: use value (its ability to satisfy a need) and value, which appears in exchange as exchange value. Utility cannot be absent, otherwise nobody would buy it; subsidies and physical weight are accidental features, not defining properties of a commodity.

questions.text_en: The use value of a commodity refers to:
options: bozorda u uchun to'langan umumiy pul miqdoriga
insonning biror ehtiyojini qondirish qobiliyatiga
unda mujassam bo'lgan ijtimoiy zarur mehnat vaqtiga
uning boshqa tovarlarga ayirboshlanish nisbatiga
options_ru: общей сумме денег, уплаченной за него на рынке
его способности удовлетворять потребность человека
воплощённому в нём общественно необходимому труду
пропорции, в которой он обменивается на другие блага
options_en: the total amount of money paid for it in the market
its ability to satisfy some human need or want
the socially necessary labour time it embodies
the proportion in which it exchanges for other goods
questions.explanation_en: Use value is the qualitative side of a commodity: its usefulness for the buyer. The money paid is its price, the embodied labour is its value, and the exchange proportion is its exchange value, so options 0, 2 and 3 all name different categories.

questions.text_en: Exchange value of a commodity is best described as:
options: tovarning o'z egasi uchun jismoniy foydaliligi
uni yaratishda ishlatilgan xom ashyoning og'irligi
davlat ishlab chiqaruvchiga beradigan subsidiyasi
uning boshqa tovarlarga ayirboshlanish proporsiyasi
options_ru: физическая полезность блага для его собственника
общий вес сырья, затраченного на его изготовление
субсидия, которую государство даёт производителю
пропорция, в которой он обменивается на иные блага
options_en: the physical usefulness of the good to its owner
the total weight of raw materials used in making it
the subsidy the state grants to its producer firm
the proportion in which it trades for other goods
questions.explanation_en: Exchange value is the quantitative relation in which one commodity is exchanged for another, and in a money economy it appears as price. Usefulness is use value, raw-material weight is a technical fact, and a subsidy is a transfer payment; none of them expresses the exchange relation.

questions.text_en: According to the labour theory of value, the value of a commodity is determined by:
options: oxirgi xaridor oladigan subyektiv foydalilik darajasi
uni ishlab chiqarishga ketgan ijtimoiy zarur mehnat vaqti
mamlakatda muomalada bo'lgan pul massasining miqdori
import tovarlarga joriy etilgan davlat tariflari darajasi
options_ru: субъективная полезность для последнего покупателя блага
общественно необходимое рабочее время на его производство
количество денег, находящихся в обращении в стране сейчас
уровень государственных тарифов на ввозимые в страну блага
options_en: the subjective utility the last buyer derives from it
the socially necessary labour time spent producing it
the quantity of money currently in circulation nationally
the level of state tariffs imposed on imported goods
questions.explanation_en: The labour theory of value (Smith, Ricardo, Marx) measures value by socially necessary labour time, that is the time needed under average conditions of production. Subjective utility belongs to the marginalist theory, money quantity explains the price level rather than value, and tariffs are an element of trade policy.

questions.text_en: The marginal utility theory explains the value of a good by:
options: ishlab chiqarilgan o'rtacha birlikdagi mehnat soatlari
sotuvchi firma zimmasidagi asosiy kapital xarajatlari
oxirgi iste'mol qilingan birlik beradigan qanoatlanish
hukumat har bir birlikdan oladigan bojxona bojlari
options_ru: трудом, воплощённым в средней произведённой единице
постоянными затратами капитала продающей компании
удовлетворением от последней потреблённой единицы
таможенной пошлиной, взимаемой с каждой единицы
options_en: the labour hours embodied in the average unit produced
the fixed capital costs carried by the selling company
the satisfaction the last consumed unit gives the buyer
the customs duty the government collects on each unit
questions.explanation_en: Marginalists (Menger, Jevons, Walras) derive value from the utility of the last, marginal unit consumed, which falls as consumption grows. Option 0 restates the labour theory, while fixed costs and customs duties affect supply price but are not the marginalist basis of value.

questions.text_en: Which two conditions are necessary for commodity production to arise?
options: Mehnat taqsimoti va ishlab chiqaruvchilarning iqtisodiy ajralishi
To'liq davlat mulki va ishlab chiqarishning markaziy rejalashtirilishi
Natural uy xo'jaligi va har qanday ayirboshlashning yo'qligi
Teng daromadlar va xususiy tadbirkorlikning to'liq taqiqlanishi
options_ru: Разделение труда и экономическая обособленность производителей
Полная государственная собственность и центральное планирование
Натуральное домашнее хозяйство и отсутствие всякого обмена благ
Равные доходы и полный запрет частной предпринимательской деятельности
options_en: Social division of labour and economic separation of producers
Full state ownership and central planning of all production
Natural household economy and the absence of any exchange
Equal incomes and a complete ban on private entrepreneurship
questions.explanation_en: Commodity production needs specialisation, so that producers depend on each other, and economic separation of producers, so that goods must change owners through exchange. Central planning, natural economy and a ban on entrepreneurship all remove or restrict exchange rather than create it.

questions.text_en: What is the main disadvantage of a barter exchange system?
options: U sotiladigan barcha tovarlarning narxlarini qat'iy qilib qo'yadi
U ishlab chiqaruvchilarni o'ta tor ixtisoslashuvga majbur qiladi
U iqtisodiyotda umumiy narx darajasini juda tez oshirib yuboradi
U tomonlar ehtiyojlarining ikki tomonlama mos kelishini talab qiladi
options_ru: Он делает цены всех обмениваемых товаров совершенно жёсткими
Он заставляет производителей специализироваться слишком узко
Он быстро повышает общий уровень цен в национальной экономике
Он требует двойного совпадения потребностей сторон обмена
options_en: It makes the prices of all traded goods completely rigid
It forces producers to specialise far too narrowly
It raises the general price level in the economy quickly
It requires a double coincidence of wants between traders
questions.explanation_en: Under barter each party must hold exactly what the other wants, which makes transaction costs very high; money solves this by acting as a universal intermediary. Barter does not fix prices, does not encourage narrow specialisation (it discourages it), and does not by itself cause general price inflation.

questions.text_en: In economic theory, money is defined as:
options: qiymati bir marta farmon bilan belgilanadigan tovar
har qanday tovar uchun qabul qilinadigan umumiy ekvivalent
kapitaldagi ulushga egalikni tasdiqlovchi guvohnoma
egasiga bepul kredit olish huquqini beradigan hujjat
options_ru: благо, чья стоимость раз и навсегда задана декретом
всеобщий эквивалент, принимаемый в обмен на любое благо
свидетельство, подтверждающее право на долю капитала
документ, дающий владельцу право на бесплатный кредит
options_en: a good whose value is set once and for all by decree
a universal equivalent accepted in exchange for any good
a certificate confirming ownership of a share of capital
a document granting the holder the right to free credit
questions.explanation_en: Money is the special commodity that serves as universal equivalent, in which the value of all other commodities is expressed. A share certificate is an equity instrument, a credit document is a debt claim, and no decree can fix money's real value once and for all.

questions.text_en: Money performs the function of a measure of value when it:
options: ilgari kelishilgan qarzni to'lash uchun topshirilsa
muomaladan chiqarilib, jamg'arma sifatida saqlansa
tovarlar qiymatini narx sifatida ifodalashga xizmat qilsa
turli davlatlar o'rtasidagi to'lovlarni amalga oshirsa
options_ru: передаются для погашения ранее согласованного долга
изымаются из обращения и хранятся как сбережения
служат для выражения стоимости товаров в виде цен
используются для расчётов между разными странами
options_en: is handed over to settle a debt agreed upon earlier
is withdrawn from circulation and kept as savings
is used to express the value of goods as prices
serves to settle payments between different countries
questions.explanation_en: As a measure of value money provides the unit in which value is expressed, which is the price of a good; this function can be performed ideally, without money actually changing hands. The other options describe the functions of means of payment, store of value and world money.

questions.text_en: Which situation illustrates money acting as a medium of circulation?
options: Xaridor naqd pul to'laydi va darhol tovarni oladi
Firma oltin quyimlarini bir necha yil saqlab turadi
Narx yorlig'i mahsulot qanchaga arzishini bildiradi
Ishchiga ish bitgandan ikki hafta keyin maosh beriladi
options_ru: Покупатель платит наличными и сразу получает товар
Фирма хранит золотые слитки в сейфе несколько лет
Ценник показывает, сколько стоит данный продукт
Рабочий получает плату через две недели после труда
options_en: A buyer pays cash and immediately receives the goods
A firm keeps gold bars in a vault for several years
A price tag states how much a product is worth
A worker is paid wages two weeks after working
