questions.explanation_en: To sell one more unit the monopolist must lower the price on all units, so MR is below price. MR equals price only when demand is perfectly elastic, as for a price taker.

questions.text_en: A natural monopoly arises mainly because
options: uzoq muddatli o'rtacha xarajat butun bozorda pasayadi
davlat barcha raqobatchi ishlab chiqaruvchini taqiqlaydi
iste'molchilar bitta tanish brendni kuchli afzal ko'radi
firma ishlab chiqarish usuliga patentga egalik qiladi
options_ru: долгосрочные средние издержки падают на всем рынке
государство запрещает всех конкурирующих производителей
потребители сильно предпочитают один знакомый бренд
фирма владеет патентом на свой способ производства
options_en: long-run average cost falls over the whole market
the government forbids all competing producers
consumers strongly prefer one familiar brand
the firm holds a patent on its production method
questions.explanation_en: A natural monopoly exists when economies of scale are so large that one firm can serve the whole market at lower average cost than two or more. Legal prohibition and patents create legal, not natural, monopolies; brand loyalty alone does not.

questions.text_en: Which of the following is a legal barrier to entry?
options: Noyob va kam uchraydigan xomashyoga egalik
Uzoq bozor faoliyati orqali orttirilgan obro'
Yangi ishlab chiqarish texnologiyasiga patent
Juda yirik hajmdan olinadigan xarajat ustunligi
options_ru: Владение уникальным и редким природным сырьем
Репутация, созданная за долгие годы работы на рынке
Патент, защищающий новую технологию производства
Преимущество в издержках от очень крупного масштаба
options_en: Ownership of a unique and scarce raw material
A reputation built through long market presence
A patent protecting a new production technology
A cost advantage gained from very large scale
questions.explanation_en: A patent is a state-granted exclusive right, hence a legal barrier. Scale economies, control of a scarce input and accumulated reputation are economic (natural or strategic) barriers, not legal ones.

questions.text_en: Compared with a competitive industry, a monopolist typically
options: kamroq miqdorni o'zgarmagan bozor narxida sotadi
kamroq miqdorni yuqoriroq bozor narxida sotadi
ko'proq miqdorni pastroq bozor narxida sotadi
xuddi shu miqdorni, lekin yuqori xarajat bilan sotadi
options_ru: продает меньший объем по той же самой рыночной цене
продает меньший объем по более высокой рыночной цене
продает больший объем по более низкой рыночной цене
продает тот же объем, но с более высокими издержками
options_en: sells a smaller quantity at the same market price
sells a smaller quantity at a higher market price
sells a larger quantity at a lower market price
sells the same quantity but with higher costs
questions.explanation_en: Setting MR = MC with MR below price, the monopolist restricts output and charges more than the competitive price. Output falls and price rises together, so the options keeping price or quantity unchanged are wrong.

questions.text_en: The deadweight loss of monopoly measures
options: monopolist iste'molchiga o'tkazadigan foydani
monopolist qoplay olmaydigan doimiy xarajatni
davlat savdodan yig'adigan soliq tushumini
hajm cheklanganligi uchun yo'qolgan ortiqchani
options_ru: прибыль, передаваемую монополистом потребителям
постоянные издержки, невозместимые монополистом
налоговые поступления государства от продаж
излишек, потерянный из-за ограничения выпуска
options_en: the profit the monopolist transfers to consumers
the fixed cost the monopolist cannot recover
the tax revenue government collects on sales
the surplus lost because output is restricted
questions.explanation_en: Deadweight loss is the total surplus destroyed on units worth more to buyers than they cost to produce but not sold because output is restricted. Surplus merely transferred from consumers to the monopolist is not a deadweight loss.

questions.text_en: Price discrimination means that a seller
options: xarajat pasayganda narxni ham pasaytiradi
boshqa hududdagi xaridorlarga sotmaydi
bir xil mahsulot uchun turli narx qo'yadi
har bir xaridorga bitta yagona narx qo'yadi
options_ru: снижает цену всегда при снижении издержек
не продает покупателям из других регионов
назначает разные цены на один и тот же товар
назначает единую цену для каждого покупателя
options_en: lowers price whenever production costs decline
refuses to sell to buyers from other regions
charges different prices for the same product
charges one uniform price to every single buyer
questions.explanation_en: Price discrimination is charging different prices for the same good to different buyers for reasons unrelated to cost. Uniform pricing is the opposite, cost-based price cuts apply to everyone, and refusing to serve a region is not discrimination in price.

questions.text_en: Successful price discrimination requires that
options: xaridorlar mahsulotni boshqalarga oson qayta sotishi
sotuvchi firma o'z bozorida narx oluvchi bo'lishi
barcha xaridorlar talab elastikligi bir xil bo'lishi
xaridor guruhlari to'lov istagi bilan farq qilishi
options_ru: покупатели могут легко перепродавать товар другим
продающая фирма должна быть чистым получателем цены
у всех покупателей одинаковая эластичность спроса
группы покупателей различаются готовностью платить
options_en: buyers can easily resell the product to others
the selling firm has to be a pure price taker
all buyers have exactly the same demand elasticity
groups of buyers differ in their willingness to pay
questions.explanation_en: Discrimination needs market power, separable groups with different elasticities, and no cheap resale between them. Easy resale destroys it, a price taker has no power to discriminate, and identical elasticities leave nothing to exploit.

questions.text_en: First-degree (perfect) price discrimination means charging
options: har bir xaridor to'lashga tayyor bo'lgan eng yuqori narx
har bir bozor segmenti uchun alohida guruh narxi
ko'p miqdorda xarid qilganlar uchun pastroq narx
barcha xaridorlar uchun yagona foyda maksimal narx
options_ru: максимальная цена, которую готов платить сам покупатель
отдельная групповая цена для каждого сегмента рынка
более низкая цена за единицу при крупных закупках
единая максимизирующая прибыль цена для всех покупателей
options_en: each buyer the highest price that buyer accepts
each market segment its own separate group price
a lower unit price for larger purchased volumes
a single profit-maximising price to all buyers
questions.explanation_en: First-degree discrimination extracts each buyer's full reservation price, so all consumer surplus becomes profit. Group pricing is third-degree, quantity-based pricing is second-degree, and a single price is no discrimination at all.

questions.text_en: Student and pensioner discounts on cinema tickets are an example of
options: raqobatchilarni siqib chiqaruvchi talonchi narx siyosati
xaridor guruhi bo'yicha uchinchi darajali diskriminatsiya
to'lov istagi bo'yicha birinchi darajali diskriminatsiya
qat'iy kirish to'lovi bilan ikki qismli narx tizimi
options_ru: хищнического ценообразования против конкурентов
ценовой дискриминации третьей степени по группам
ценовой дискриминации первой степени по готовности
двухчастного тарифа с фиксированной платой за вход
options_en: predatory pricing aimed at removing competitors
third-degree price discrimination by buyer group
first-degree price discrimination by willingness
two-part pricing with a fixed entry fee charged
questions.explanation_en: Charging identifiable groups (students, pensioners) different prices for the same film is third-degree discrimination. First-degree would price each individual separately; two-part tariffs and predatory pricing are different strategies.

questions.text_en: Monopolistic competition differs from perfect competition mainly because
options: mahsulotlar bir xil emas, balki tabaqalashgan bo'ladi
tarmoqqa kirish imkoni butunlay to'sib qo'yilgan
butun bozor talabini faqat bitta firma qondiradi
firmalar uzoq davrda minimal o'rtacha xarajatda ishlaydi
options_ru: продукты дифференцированы, а не полностью одинаковы
вход в отрасль полностью заблокирован для новых фирм
весь рыночный спрос обслуживает только одна фирма
фирмы работают при минимальных средних издержках
options_en: products are differentiated rather than identical
entry into the industry is completely blocked
only one firm serves the entire market demand
firms produce at minimum average cost in the long run
questions.explanation_en: Monopolistic competition keeps many firms and free entry but adds product differentiation, giving each firm a slightly downward-sloping demand curve. Blocked entry and a single seller describe monopoly, and minimum-cost production is a perfectly competitive outcome.

questions.text_en: A defining feature of oligopoly is that
options: firmalar mutlaq elastik talab chizig'iga duch keladi
tarmoqqa kirishda hech qanday to'siq mavjud emas
bir necha firma tarmoq savdosining asosiy qismini oladi
har bir firma raqiblarning javobini butunlay inkor etadi
options_ru: фирмы сталкиваются с абсолютно эластичным спросом
в отрасли полностью отсутствуют барьеры для входа
несколько фирм дают основную часть продаж отрасли
каждая фирма полностью игнорирует реакцию соперников
options_en: firms face perfectly elastic demand curves
no barriers to entry exist in the industry
a few firms account for most industry sales
each firm ignores how rivals will react
questions.explanation_en: Oligopoly means a few large sellers whose decisions are strategically interdependent, so each must anticipate rivals' reactions. Perfectly elastic demand and costless entry belong to perfect competition.

questions.text_en: The Herfindahl-Hirschman index is used to measure
options: umumiy bozor taklifida import ulushini
tarmoqdagi bozor konsentratsiyasi darajasini
muayyan tovarga talabning elastikligini
firma iqtisodiy foydasi marjasi hajmini
options_ru: долю импорта в общем предложении рынка
степень рыночной концентрации в отрасли
эластичность спроса на данный товар
размер маржи экономической прибыли фирмы
options_en: the share of imports in total market supply
the degree of concentration in an industry
the elasticity of demand for a given good
the size of a firm's economic profit margin
questions.explanation_en: The HHI sums the squared market shares of all firms, so it rises with concentration and is used in competition policy. It says nothing directly about elasticity, profit margins or import penetration.

questions.text_en: If a natural monopoly is forced to set price equal to marginal cost, it will
options: mumkin bo'lgan eng katta iqtisodiy foydani oladi
o'zining o'rtacha umumiy xarajatini to'liq qoplaydi
ishlab chiqarish hajmini samarali darajadan kamaytiradi
iqtisodiy zarar ko'rib, subsidiyaga muhtoj bo'ladi
options_ru: получит максимально возможную экономическую прибыль
в точности покроет свои средние общие издержки
сократит выпуск ниже общественно эффективного уровня
понесет экономический убыток и потребует субсидии
options_en: earn the largest possible economic profit
exactly cover its average total cost
reduce output below the efficient level
make an economic loss and need a subsidy
questions.explanation_en: With falling average cost, marginal cost lies below average total cost, so P = MC leaves revenue short of total cost and a subsidy is needed. Average-cost pricing, not marginal-cost pricing, is what exactly covers costs.

questions.text_en: A monopolist can keep positive economic profit in the long run because
options: iste'molchilarda boshqa joyga sarflash daromadi yo'q
u doim talab noelastik bo'lgan nuqtada ishlaydi
kirish to'siqlari potensial raqiblarni kiritmaydi
hajm o'sishi bilan o'rtacha xarajati doim pasayadi
options_ru: у потребителей нет дохода для трат в других местах
он всегда работает там, где спрос неэластичен
барьеры входа не допускают потенциальных конкурентов
его средние издержки всегда падают с ростом выпуска
options_en: consumers have no income to spend elsewhere
it always produces where demand is inelastic
barriers to entry keep potential rivals out
its average cost always falls as output grows
questions.explanation_en: Profit survives in the long run only if entry is blocked; otherwise new firms would compete it away. Falling average cost is not universal, and a profit-maximising monopolist actually operates on the elastic part of demand.

questions.text_en: A profit-maximising monopolist never operates where demand is
options: elastik, chunki u yerda chekli tushum musbat
birlik elastik, chunki umumiy tushum maksimal
mutlaq elastik, chunki narx o'rtacha xarajatga teng
noelastik, chunki u yerda chekli tushum manfiy
options_ru: эластичен, так как предельная выручка положительна
единично эластичен, так как выручка максимальна
абсолютно эластичен, так как цена равна издержкам
неэластичен, так как предельная выручка отрицательна
options_en: elastic, since marginal revenue is positive there
unit elastic, since total revenue is at a maximum
perfectly elastic, since price equals average cost
inelastic, since marginal revenue is negative there
questions.explanation_en: On the inelastic part of demand marginal revenue is negative, so cutting output would raise revenue and lower cost at once. Since MC is positive, the optimum always lies on the elastic segment.

questions.text_en: Free entry and exit in a competitive industry ensure that in the long run
options: iqtisodiy foyda nolga tomon siqib chiqariladi
iqtisodiy foyda doimiy ravishda yuqori qoladi
firmalar soni abadiy o'zgarmas bo'lib qoladi
narxlar o'rtacha xarajatdan tobora oshib boradi
options_ru: экономическая прибыль стремится к нулевому уровню
экономическая прибыль остается постоянно высокой
число фирм в отрасли навсегда остается неизменным
цены неуклонно растут выше средних издержек
options_en: economic profits are driven toward zero
economic profits stay permanently high
the number of firms becomes fixed forever
prices rise steadily above average cost
questions.explanation_en: Profits attract entry and losses cause exit until price equals minimum average total cost and economic profit is zero. The number of firms therefore adjusts rather than staying fixed.

questions.text_en: The main purpose of competition (antitrust) policy is to
options: iqtisodiyotdagi har bir tovar narxini belgilash
bozor hokimiyatini cheklab, iste'molchini himoya qilish
firmalarga belgilangan foyda marjasini kafolatlash
har bir tarmoqdagi firmalar sonini teng saqlash
options_ru: устанавливать цену каждого товара в экономике
защитить потребителей, ограничивая рыночную власть
гарантировать фирмам фиксированную норму прибыли
сохранять равное число фирм в каждой отрасли
options_en: set the price of every good sold in the economy
protect consumers by limiting market power
guarantee a fixed profit margin to firms
keep the number of firms in each industry equal
questions.explanation_en: Competition policy restrains abuse of market power, cartels and harmful mergers to protect consumer welfare. It does not guarantee firms' profits, equalise firm numbers, or set all prices administratively.

questions.text_en: The short-run supply curve of a competitive firm is its
options: o'zgaruvchi xarajatdan yuqori chekli xarajat chizig'i
minimum nuqtadan yuqori o'rtacha umumiy xarajat chizig'i
barcha hajmlar uchun o'rtacha doimiy xarajat chizig'i
zararsizlik narxidan yuqori joylashgan talab chizig'i
options_ru: кривая предельных издержек выше средних переменных
кривая средних общих издержек выше точки минимума
кривая средних постоянных издержек на всем выпуске
кривая спроса выше уровня безубыточной цены
options_en: marginal cost curve above average variable cost
average total cost curve above its minimum point
average fixed cost curve over all output levels
demand curve above the break-even price level
questions.explanation_en: Setting P = MC, the firm supplies along its marginal cost curve, but only above minimum average variable cost, below which it shuts down. Average cost curves describe profitability, not the supply decision.

questions.text_en: Perfect competition achieves allocative efficiency because
options: firmalar doimo normal hisob foydasiga ega bo'ladi
har bir firma mahsulotini juda keng reklama qiladi
tanlangan hajmda narx chekli xarajatga teng bo'ladi
muvozanatda narx o'rtacha doimiy xarajatga teng
options_ru: фирмы всегда получают нормальную бухгалтерскую прибыль
каждая фирма очень активно рекламирует свой продукт
цена равна предельным издержкам при данном выпуске
цена равна средним постоянным издержкам в равновесии
options_en: firms always earn a normal accounting profit
each firm advertises its product very heavily
price equals marginal cost at the chosen output
price equals average fixed cost in equilibrium
questions.explanation_en: Allocative efficiency means the value of the last unit to buyers (price) equals its opportunity cost (marginal cost). Price never equals average fixed cost in equilibrium, and advertising or accounting profit is unrelated to this condition.

questions.text_en: Schumpeter argued that temporary monopoly power may be useful because it
options: vaqt o'tishi bilan samaradorlikni kafolatlaydi
innovatsiyani taqdirlab, uni rag'batlantiradi
barcha iste'molchilar uchun narxni pasaytiradi
mahsulot xilma-xilligiga ehtiyojni yo'qotadi
options_ru: гарантирует эффективность размещения ресурсов
вознаграждает и тем самым поощряет инновации
снижает рыночную цену для всех потребителей
устраняет потребность в разнообразии товаров
options_en: guarantees allocative efficiency over time
rewards and therefore encourages innovation
lowers the market price for all consumers
removes the need for any product variety
questions.explanation_en: In Schumpeter's view the prospect of temporary monopoly profit finances and motivates innovation, driving creative destruction. Monopoly does not lower prices, eliminate the value of variety, or guarantee allocative efficiency.

questions.text_en: Saying that a firm is a 'price taker' means that the firm
options: o'z foydasini maksimal qiladigan narxni tanlaydi
narxni bevosita davlat amaldorlaridan oladi
xaridorlar talab qilgan har qanday hajmni oladi
o'z hajmi bilan bozor narxiga ta'sir eta olmaydi
options_ru: выбирает цену, максимизирующую его собственную прибыль
получает цену напрямую от государственных чиновников
обязана принять любой объем, требуемый покупателями
не может влиять на рыночную цену своим выпуском
options_en: chooses the price that maximises its own profit
takes prices directly from government officials
must accept whatever quantity buyers demand
cannot influence the market price by its output
questions.explanation_en: A price taker is too small relative to the market for its output decisions to move price, so it treats price as given. Choosing a profit-maximising price describes a price maker, and the term has nothing to do with administrative prices.

chapters.title_ru: Природа цены и характеристики её формирования
chapters.title_en: The nature of price and the characteristics of its formation

questions.text_en: In economic theory, price is most precisely defined as
options: mahsulot birligini ishlab chiqarish xarajati
bitta bitimda ayirboshlanadigan tovar miqdori
sotuvchi bir savdodan oladigan foyda summasi
tovar qiymatining pul ko'rinishidagi ifodasi
options_ru: совокупные издержки производства единицы товара
количество товара, обмениваемое в одной сделке
прибыль продавца от одной отдельной продажи
денежное выражение стоимости данного товара
options_en: the total cost of producing one unit of output
the quantity of a good exchanged in one deal
the profit a seller gains from a single sale
the monetary expression of the value of a good
questions.explanation_en: Price is the value of a good expressed in money. Cost is only one component underlying price, while quantity exchanged and profit are separate magnitudes determined partly by price.

questions.text_en: Price performs a stimulating function when it
options: ijtimoiy guruhlar o'rtasida daromadni qayta taqsimlaydi
taklif va talab miqdorlarini muvozanatga keltiradi
ishlab chiqaruvchini xarajatni qisqartirishga undaydi
tovarlarning qiymatini pul shaklida o'lchab beradi
options_ru: перераспределяет доходы между группами общества
уравновешивает величины спроса и предложения
побуждает производителей снижать свои издержки
измеряет стоимость товаров в денежной форме
options_en: redistributes income between social groups
balances the quantities supplied and demanded
encourages producers to cut costs and innovate
measures the value of goods in money terms
questions.explanation_en: The stimulating function works through the profit incentive: higher prices or lower costs raise profit, pushing firms to economise and innovate. Measuring, redistributing and balancing are the accounting, distributive and equilibrating functions.

questions.text_en: Cost-plus pricing sets the price by
options: eng yaqin raqiblar qo'ygan narxni ko'chirib olish
xaridorlar his qiladigan qiymatni hisoblab baholash
butun zaxirani sotib bo'ladigan narxni tanlash
birlik xarajatga belgilangan foiz ustama qo'shish
options_ru: копирование цены, назначенной близкими конкурентами
оценку ценности, воспринимаемой покупателями
выбор цены, при которой распродаются все запасы
прибавление фиксированной наценки к издержкам
options_en: copying the price charged by the closest rivals
estimating the value perceived by the buyers
choosing the price that clears all held stocks
adding a fixed percentage mark-up to unit cost
questions.explanation_en: Cost-plus (cost-oriented) pricing starts from unit cost and adds a mark-up. Copying rivals is competition-based pricing, perceived value is value-based pricing, and clearing stocks is a demand-driven rule.

questions.text_en: Target-return pricing is based mainly on
options: investitsiya qilingan kapitaldan rejadagi daromad normasi
butun bozorda kuzatilgan eng past narx ko'rsatkichi
har bir xaridor e'lon qiladigan sub'ektiv qiymat
aholining o'rtacha daromad darajasi ko'rsatkichi
options_ru: планируемая норма дохода на вложенный капитал
самая низкая цена, наблюдаемая на всем рынке
субъективная ценность, заявленная покупателем
средний уровень доходов населения страны
options_en: a planned rate of return on invested capital
the lowest price observed in the whole market
the subjective value declared by each buyer
the average income level of the population
questions.explanation_en: Target-return pricing chooses the price that yields a desired return on invested capital at a planned sales volume. The other options describe competitor-, value- and income-oriented considerations.

questions.text_en: Value-based pricing starts from
options: distributorlar talab qiladigan ulgurji marjasi
mahsulotning xaridorga beradigan naf darajasi
mahsulot ishlab chiqarishning to'liq hisob qiymati
asosiy raqobatchi e'lon qilgan narxlar ro'yxati
options_ru: оптовая маржа, которую требуют дистрибьюторы
польза, которую продукт дает самому покупателю
полная бухгалтерская себестоимость продукта
прайс-лист, опубликованный главным конкурентом
options_en: the wholesale margin required by distributors
the benefit the product gives to the customer
the full accounting cost of making the product
the price list published by the main competitor
questions.explanation_en: Value-based pricing begins with the buyer's perceived benefit and works back to cost. Beginning with cost is cost-plus pricing, and starting from rivals' lists or distributors' margins reflects competitor- and channel-driven approaches.

questions.text_en: Competition-based pricing means that a firm sets its price mainly with reference to
options: o'zining bevosita raqiblari qo'ygan narxlarga
mahsulot birligidagi o'zgaruvchi xarajatiga
davlat tomonidan tasdiqlangan rasmiy tarifga
uzoq muddatli taklif elastikligi ko'rsatkichiga
options_ru: на цены, назначаемые ее прямыми конкурентами
на свои переменные издержки на единицу товара
на официальный тариф, утвержденный государством
на эластичность своего долгосрочного предложения
options_en: the prices charged by its direct rivals
its own variable cost per unit of output
the official tariff approved by the state
the elasticity of its long-run supply curve
questions.explanation_en: Competition-based pricing takes rivals' prices as the main benchmark, often used in oligopoly. Variable cost points to cost-based pricing, official tariffs to regulated pricing, and supply elasticity is not a pricing method.

questions.text_en: Which of these is an internal factor in a firm's pricing decision?
options: Davlat tomonidan joriy etilgan narx tartibi
Bozordagi yaqin o'rinbosarlar sonining miqdori
Firma ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarining tarkibi
Mamlakatdagi uy xo'jaliklari daromadi darajasi
options_ru: Государственное регулирование цен в отрасли
Число близких товаров-заменителей на рынке
Структура производственных издержек самой фирмы
Уровень доходов домохозяйств в данной стране
options_en: The price regulation imposed by government
The number of close substitutes on the market
The structure of the firm's production costs
The level of household income in the country
questions.explanation_en: Costs are determined inside the firm, so they are an internal pricing factor. Household income, state regulation and the number of substitutes are all external conditions the firm must adapt to.

questions.text_en: Which of these is an external factor affecting price formation?
options: Kompaniya ichidagi ish haqi siyosati tartibi
Bozordagi xaridorlarning to'lov qobiliyati
Firma tanlagan marketing maqsadlari tizimi
Firma qo'llaydigan ishlab chiqarish texnologiyasi
options_ru: Политика оплаты труда внутри самой компании
Покупательная способность покупателей на рынке
Маркетинговые цели, выбранные самой фирмой
Технология производства, применяемая фирмой
options_en: The wage policy applied inside the company
The purchasing power of buyers in the market
The marketing objectives chosen by the firm
The production technology used by the firm
questions.explanation_en: Buyers' purchasing power is a market condition outside the firm's control, hence external. Marketing objectives, technology and wage policy are chosen within the firm and are internal factors.

questions.text_en: Price elasticity of demand measures
options: umumiy xarajatning hajm o'zgarishiga javob berishi
talabning daromad o'zgarishiga javob berish darajasi
taklifning soliq o'zgarishiga javob berish darajasi
talab miqdorining narxga qanchalik javob berishi
options_ru: насколько общие издержки реагируют на выпуск
насколько спрос реагирует на изменение дохода
насколько предложение реагирует на налоги
насколько величина спроса реагирует на цену
options_en: how much total cost responds to output change
how much demand responds to a change in income
how much supply responds to a change in taxes
how much quantity demanded responds to price
questions.explanation_en: Price elasticity of demand is the percentage change in quantity demanded divided by the percentage change in price. Responses to income or taxes, and cost behaviour, are measured by other coefficients.

questions.text_en: If demand for a good is price elastic, a price reduction will
options: sotuvchining umumiy tushumini o'zgartirmaydi
sotuvchining umumiy doimiy xarajatini oshiradi
sotuvchining umumiy savdo tushumini oshiradi
sotuvchining umumiy savdo tushumini kamaytiradi
options_ru: оставит общую выручку продавца без изменений
увеличит общие постоянные издержки продавца
увеличит общую выручку продавца от продаж
уменьшит общую выручку продавца от продаж
options_en: leave the seller's total revenue unchanged
raise the seller's total fixed cost outlay
raise the seller's total sales revenue
reduce the seller's total sales revenue
questions.explanation_en: With elastic demand quantity rises proportionally more than price falls, so total revenue increases. Revenue would fall with inelastic demand and stay unchanged with unit elasticity; fixed cost does not depend on price.

questions.text_en: For a good with inelastic demand, a price increase of 10% will
options: talab miqdorini 10% dan ko'proqqa kamaytiradi
talab miqdorini roppa-rosa 10% ga kamaytiradi
talab miqdorini mutlaqo o'zgarishsiz qoldiradi
talab miqdorini 10% dan kamroqqa kamaytiradi
options_ru: сократит величину спроса больше чем на 10%
сократит величину спроса ровно на 10% товара
оставит величину спроса полностью неизменной
сократит величину спроса меньше чем на 10%
options_en: reduce quantity demanded by more than 10%
reduce quantity demanded by exactly 10%
leave quantity demanded completely unchanged
reduce quantity demanded by less than 10%
questions.explanation_en: Inelastic demand means the elasticity coefficient is between zero and one, so quantity changes proportionally less than price. A larger fall indicates elastic demand, an equal fall unit elasticity, and no change perfect inelasticity.

questions.text_en: Total revenue reaches its maximum where demand is
options: birlik elastik, elastiklik ko'rsatkichi birga teng
mutlaq noelastik, elastiklik ko'rsatkichi nolga teng
mutlaq elastik, elastiklik cheksizlikka teng bo'ladi
juda noelastik, elastiklik ko'rsatkichi birdan kichik
options_ru: единично эластичным, с эластичностью равной единице
абсолютно неэластичным, с эластичностью равной нулю
абсолютно эластичным, с бесконечной эластичностью
сильно неэластичным, с эластичностью меньше единицы
options_en: unit elastic, with elasticity equal to one
perfectly inelastic, with elasticity of zero
perfectly elastic, with infinite elasticity
highly inelastic, with elasticity below one
questions.explanation_en: Revenue rises while demand is elastic and falls once it becomes inelastic, so it peaks at unit elasticity where marginal revenue is zero. In the inelastic range revenue is still increasing with price, not at a maximum.

questions.text_en: Demand for a good tends to be more elastic when
options: xaridorlarga moslashish uchun vaqt juda kam bo'lsa
ko'p yaqin o'rinbosarlar oson topiladigan bo'lsa
tovar kundalik zaruriy ehtiyoj buyumi bo'lsa
u budjetning juda kichik bir ulushini egallasa
options_ru: у покупателей очень мало времени на адаптацию
доступно много близких товаров-заменителей
товар является предметом первой необходимости
он занимает очень малую долю бюджета покупателя
options_en: buyers are given very little time to adjust
many close substitutes are easily available
the good is a basic daily necessity item
it takes only a tiny share of the budget
questions.explanation_en: Available substitutes let buyers switch easily, which makes demand elastic. Necessities, a small budget share and a short adjustment period all make demand less elastic.

questions.text_en: A positive cross elasticity of demand between two goods indicates that they are
options: iste'molda o'zaro o'rinbosar bo'lgan tovarlar
iste'molda birgalikda ishlatiladigan tovarlar
ko'pchilik xaridor uchun past navli tovarlar
talabi bir-biriga bog'liq bo'lmagan tovarlar
options_ru: взаимозаменяемыми товарами в потреблении
взаимодополняющими товарами в потреблении
товарами низшего качества для большинства
независимыми товарами с несвязанным спросом
options_en: mutual substitutes used in consumption
complements used together in consumption
inferior goods for the majority of buyers
unrelated goods with independent demands
questions.explanation_en: If one good's price rises and demand for the other increases, the cross elasticity is positive and the goods are substitutes. Complements give a negative coefficient, independent goods roughly zero, and inferiority is about income, not cross price.

questions.text_en: A negative income elasticity of demand means the good is
options: o'rtacha xaridor uchun hashamatli tovar
butun jamiyat uchun ijtimoiy ne'mat
o'rtacha xaridor uchun past navli tovar
o'rtacha xaridor uchun oddiy normal tovar
options_ru: предметом роскоши для среднего покупателя
общественным благом для всего сообщества
товаром низшей категории для покупателя
нормальным товаром для среднего покупателя
options_en: a luxury good for the average buyer
a public good for the whole community
an inferior good for the average buyer
a normal good for the average buyer
questions.explanation_en: Negative income elasticity means demand falls as income rises, which defines an inferior good. Normal goods have positive elasticity and luxuries elasticity above one; public goods are defined by non-rivalry, not elasticity.

questions.text_en: Market penetration pricing means launching a product at
options: birlik tannarxiga aniq teng bo'lgan narxda
bozor ulushini tez olish uchun past narxda
boy xaridorlarni qamrash uchun yuqori narxda
yetakchi raqobatchi narxiga teng darajada
options_ru: цены, точно равной себестоимости единицы
низкой цены для быстрого захвата доли рынка
высокой цены для снятия сливок с богатых
цены, равной цене ведущего конкурента рынка
options_en: a price exactly equal to its unit cost
a low price to win market share quickly
a high price to skim the richest buyers
the same price as the leading competitor
questions.explanation_en: Penetration pricing deliberately sets a low introductory price to build volume and market share fast. A high initial price is skimming, matching rivals is follow-the-leader pricing, and pricing at cost is break-even pricing.

questions.text_en: Price skimming is normally used when
options: firma narxni tushirib, kirishni to'smoqchi bo'lsa
bozor bir xil mahsulotlar bilan to'lib ketgan bo'lsa
davlat tovar uchun eng yuqori narxni belgilasa
yangi mahsulot ko'p to'laydigan xaridorlarni jalb qilsa
options_ru: фирма хочет закрыть вход, снижая цену товара
рынок переполнен совершенно одинаковыми товарами
государство фиксирует максимальную цену товара
новый товар привлекает щедро платящих покупателей
options_en: the firm wants to block entry by cutting price
the market is crowded with identical products
the state fixes a maximum price for the good
a new product attracts buyers who will pay much
questions.explanation_en: Skimming starts high to capture the surplus of buyers with high willingness to pay, then lowers price over time. Cutting price to deter entry is limit pricing, and crowded or price-capped markets rule skimming out.

questions.text_en: Setting a price of 9.99 instead of 10.00 is an example of
options: mahsulotning hududiy narx belgilash usuli
mahsulotning kamsituvchi narx belgilash usuli
mahsulotning psixologik narx belgilash usuli
mahsulotning xarajatga yo'naltirilgan usuli
options_ru: географического ценообразования товара
дискриминационного ценообразования
психологического ценообразования товара
затратного ценообразования этого товара
options_en: geographical pricing of the product
discriminatory pricing of the product
psychological pricing of the product
cost-oriented pricing of the product
questions.explanation_en: Odd or 'charm' prices exploit how buyers perceive numbers, which is psychological pricing. The price is not derived from cost, not based on buyer location, and the same price is offered to everyone.

questions.text_en: A quantity discount in a price list is justified mainly by
options: ulgurji bitimlardagi soliqlarning oshishi
mahsulot nufuzini oshirish zarurati bilan
mayda xaridorga yordam berish majburiyati
birlikdagi sotish xarajatlarining pasayishi
options_ru: повышением налогов на оптовые операции
необходимостью поднять престиж товара
обязанностью помогать мелким покупателям
снижением удельных издержек сбыта товара
options_en: higher taxes on wholesale transactions
the need to raise the product's prestige
a legal duty to help small retail buyers
lower unit selling and handling costs
questions.explanation_en: Large orders reduce per-unit order processing, transport and storage costs, which the discount passes on. Prestige motives belong to premium pricing, and there is no tax or legal rationale of the kind described.

questions.text_en: Geographic pricing deals with the problem of
options: uzoq hududdagi xaridorlardan qanday narx olish
firma egalari o'rtasida foydani qanday bo'lish
omborda turgan zaxiralarni qanday baholash kerak
bir firma filiallarida ish haqini qanday belgilash
options_ru: как назначать цену покупателям в далеких регионах
как делить прибыль между всеми собственниками фирмы
как оценивать запасы, хранящиеся на складе фирмы
как устанавливать зарплату в филиалах одной фирмы
options_en: how to charge buyers located in distant regions
how to divide profit between owners of the firm
how to value stocks held in the firm's warehouse
how to set wages in branches of the same firm
questions.explanation_en: Geographic pricing decides how delivery distance and transport costs are reflected in prices for different regions. Profit distribution, inventory valuation and wage setting are separate financial or personnel questions.

questions.text_en: A government price ceiling set below the equilibrium price leads to
options: ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarining doimiy pasayishi
tartibga solingan tovarning doimiy taqchilligi
tartibga solingan tovarning doimiy ortiqchasi
muvozanat narxining darhol ko'tarilib ketishi
options_ru: постоянному снижению издержек производства
устойчивому дефициту регулируемого товара
устойчивому избытку регулируемого товара
немедленному росту равновесной цены товара
options_en: a permanent fall in the costs of production
a persistent shortage of the regulated good
a persistent surplus of the regulated good
an immediate rise in the equilibrium price
questions.explanation_en: Below equilibrium, quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied, producing a lasting shortage and often queues or black markets. A surplus follows a price floor, and a ceiling changes neither the equilibrium price nor production costs.

questions.text_en: A price floor set above the equilibrium price results in
options: mahsulotning sotilmagan ortiqcha zaxiralari
mahsulotning kuchayib boruvchi taqchilligi
taklif miqdorining keskin qisqarib ketishi
talab miqdorining barqaror oshib borishi
options_ru: непроданным избыточным запасам продукта
растущему устойчивому дефициту продукта
резкому сокращению величины предложения
устойчивому росту величины спроса на него
options_en: unsold surplus stocks of the given product
a growing permanent shortage of the product
a sharp fall in the quantity being supplied
a steady rise in the quantity being demanded
questions.explanation_en: Above equilibrium, quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded, so unsold surpluses accumulate. Quantity supplied rises and quantity demanded falls, which is why a shortage cannot appear.

questions.text_en: The retail price of a consumer good normally exceeds the wholesale price by
options: ishlab chiqarish zavodi ish haqi fondiga
bank overdrafti uchun to'langan foizga
savdo marjasi va egri soliqlar summasiga
ishlab chiqaruvchining doimiy xarajatiga
options_ru: фонд оплаты труда завода-изготовителя
проценты по банковскому овердрафту
торговую наценку и косвенные налоги
постоянные издержки производителя
options_en: the wage bill of the manufacturing plant
the interest paid on a bank overdraft
the trade margin plus indirect taxes
the producer's fixed cost of capital
questions.explanation_en: Moving from wholesale to retail price adds the retailer's trade margin and indirect taxes such as VAT or excise. Producer costs and financing charges are already embedded in the wholesale price.

questions.text_en: A consumer price index is constructed in order to
options: bozor taklifi elastikligini taxminan hisoblab chiqish
iste'mol narxlarining o'rtacha o'zgarishini kuzatish
iqtisodiyotning umumiy ishlab chiqarishini o'lchash
turli tarmoqlardagi ish haqi darajasini solishtirish
options_ru: оценивать эластичность рыночного предложения
отслеживать среднее изменение цен потребителей
измерять общий объем выпуска всей экономики
сравнивать заработки в разных отраслях страны
options_en: estimate the elasticity of market supply
track the average change in consumer prices
measure the total output of the whole economy
compare wages between different industries
questions.explanation_en: The CPI weights the prices of a fixed consumption basket to show how the general price level for households changes over time. Aggregate output is measured by GDP, and wage or elasticity comparisons require different data.

questions.text_en: The real price of a good differs from its nominal price because the real price
options: xaridor to'lagan barcha egri soliqlarni qamrab oladi
eksport uchun xorijiy valyutada e'lon qilinadi
firmaning chekli xarajatiga teng bo'lib qoladi
narxlarning umumiy o'zgarishiga tuzatilgan bo'ladi
options_ru: включает все косвенные налоги покупателей товара
указывается в иностранной валюте для экспорта
равна предельным издержкам выпуска самой фирмы
скорректирована на общее изменение уровня цен
options_en: includes all indirect taxes paid by buyers
is quoted in foreign currency for export
equals the firm's marginal cost of output
is adjusted for the general change in prices
questions.explanation_en: A real price is a nominal price deflated by a price index, so it shows purchasing power rather than current money units. Taxes, currency of quotation and marginal cost are unrelated to the nominal-real distinction.

questions.text_en: A transfer price is the price used when
options: davlat strategik zaxira uchun tovar sotib olganda
bank ikki hisob o'rtasida pul o'tkazma qilganda
bir kompaniya bo'linmalari o'zaro savdo qilganda
firma tovarlarini xorijiy bozorlarga eksport qilsa
options_ru: государство закупает товар в стратегический резерв
банк переводит деньги между двумя своими счетами
подразделения одной компании торгуют друг с другом
фирма экспортирует свои товары на внешние рынки
options_en: the state buys goods for its strategic reserve
a bank transfers money between two accounts
divisions of one company trade with each other
a firm exports its goods to foreign markets
questions.explanation_en: Transfer prices value internal deliveries between divisions or affiliates of the same company and shape internal performance and tax outcomes. Export, procurement and payment transfers are market or banking operations.

questions.text_en: The break-even price for a product is the price that
options: mumkin bo'lgan eng katta iqtisodiy foydani beradi
asosiy raqobatchining o'rtacha xarajatiga tenglashadi
faqat ishlab chiqarishning doimiy xarajatini qoplaydi
birlikdagi o'rtacha umumiy xarajatni aniq qoplaydi
options_ru: дает максимально возможную экономическую прибыль
равна средним издержкам основного конкурента
покрывает лишь постоянные издержки производства
в точности покрывает средние общие издержки
options_en: yields the largest possible economic profit
equals the average cost of the main rival
covers only the fixed cost of production
exactly covers average total cost per unit
questions.explanation_en: At the break-even price total revenue equals total cost, so price equals average total cost and profit is zero. Maximum profit requires a higher price, and covering only fixed cost would still leave a loss.

questions.text_en: A 'loss leader' in retail pricing is a product sold
options: boshqa tovarlarga xaridor jalb qilish uchun arzonga
yaqin o'rinbosari yo'qligi sababli juda qimmatga
faqat ulgurji xaridorlarga juda katta hajmlarda
davlat tomonidan belgilangan qat'iy narx bo'yicha
options_ru: дешево, чтобы привлечь покупателей других товаров
дорого, так как у него нет близких заменителей
только оптовым покупателям очень крупными партиями
по цене, жестко установленной государством страны
options_en: cheaply to attract buyers for other goods
dearly because it has no close substitute
only to wholesale buyers in large volumes
at a price fixed by state regulation rules
questions.explanation_en: A loss leader is priced very low, even below cost, to draw customers who then buy profitable items. Premium pricing, wholesale-only sales and regulated prices describe other situations.

questions.text_en: Entrepreneurship is best defined as
options: mehnat shartnomasi asosida bajariladigan har qanday ish
tayinlangan amaldorlar tomonidan davlat mulkini boshqarish
joriy daromadning bir qismini kelgusi iste'mol uchun jamlash
foyda olishga qaratilgan, o'z tavakkaliga mustaqil faoliyat
options_ru: любая оплачиваемая работа по трудовому договору найма
управление государственным имуществом назначенными лицами
сбережение части текущего дохода для будущего потребления
самостоятельная деятельность на свой риск ради прибыли
options_en: any paid work performed under an employment contract
management of state property by appointed officials
saving part of current income for future consumption
independent activity at one's own risk aimed at profit
questions.explanation_en: Entrepreneurship combines independence, risk bearing and the profit motive. Hired work transfers risk to the employer, administering state property is management by delegation, and saving is a financial decision, not a business activity.

questions.text_en: Which combination lists the core features of entrepreneurship?
options: tashabbus, tavakkalchilik, innovatsiya, mustaqillik
ish staji, qat'iy ish haqi, oddiy ish, bo'ysunish
markaziy reja, kvota, subsidiya, narx nazorati
altruizm, ixtiyoriy mehnat, foydasiz xizmatlar
options_ru: инициатива, риск, новаторство, самостоятельность
выслуга лет, оклад, рутинный труд, подчинение
план, квоты, субсидии, контроль над ценами
альтруизм, добровольный труд, бесплатные услуги
options_en: initiative, risk bearing, innovation, independence
seniority, fixed salary, routine work, obedience
central planning, quotas, subsidies, price control
altruism, voluntary work, no profit, free services
questions.explanation_en: Initiative, risk, innovation and economic independence are the standard defining features. Salaried routine work, administrative planning instruments and unpaid voluntary service each lack at least one of them.

questions.text_en: The main difference between an entrepreneur and a hired manager is that the entrepreneur
options: hamkorlar bilan ta'minot shartnomalarini imzolaydi
biznesning moliyaviy tavakkalini o'z bo'yniga oladi
xodimlarning kundalik ishini tashkil qilib boradi
firmaning buxgalteriya hisobini yuritib boradi
options_ru: подписывает договоры поставки с партнерами фирмы
берет на себя финансовый риск своего дела
организует ежедневную работу своих работников
ведет бухгалтерский учет на данном предприятии
options_en: signs supply contracts with the partners
bears the financial risk of the business
organises the daily work of the employees
keeps the accounting records of the firm
questions.explanation_en: The decisive difference is who bears the residual financial risk and claims the residual income. Organising work, keeping records and signing contracts are functions a hired manager can perform on the owner's behalf.

questions.text_en: In Schumpeter's theory, the entrepreneur's central function is
options: ishlab chiqarishni yangilaydigan innovatsiya qilish
qat'iy tejamkorlik orqali pul kapitalini jamg'arish
ishchilarni nazorat qilib, mehnat unumini oshirish
boshqa firmalarga foiz asosida kapital qarz berish
options_ru: осуществление инноваций, обновляющих производство
накопление денежного капитала путем бережливости
надзор за работниками для роста их усердия в труде
предоставление капитала другим фирмам под процент
options_en: carrying out innovations that renew production
accumulating money capital through pure thrift
supervising the workers to raise their effort
lending own capital to other firms at interest
questions.explanation_en: Schumpeter identifies the entrepreneur with innovation: new goods, methods, markets or organisational forms that drive creative destruction. Saving, supervision and lending are functions of the saver, manager and capitalist respectively.

questions.text_en: Buying goods in order to resell them at a higher price belongs to which type of business activity?
options: Moliyaviy, ya'ni kredit va pul bozori faoliyati
Konsalting, ya'ni maslahat berish faoliyati
Tijorat, ya'ni savdo va qayta sotish faoliyati
Ishlab chiqarish, ya'ni yangi tovar yaratish
options_ru: Финансовая, то есть кредитно-денежная сфера
Консультационная, то есть советы и аудит
Коммерческая, то есть торгово-посредническая
Производственная, то есть создание товаров
options_en: Financial and credit market activity
Consulting and professional advising
Commercial trading and resale activity
Productive manufacturing of new goods
questions.explanation_en: Buying in order to resell without transforming the good is commercial (trade) entrepreneurship. Production creates new goods, financial activity trades money and securities, and consulting sells professional advice.

questions.text_en: The main disadvantage of a sole proprietorship is
options: qabul qilinadigan qarorlar ustidan nazoratni yo'qotish
egasining cheklanmagan shaxsiy mulkiy javobgarligi
davlat ro'yxatidan o'tish tartibining murakkabligi
taqsimlangan foydaning ikki karra soliqqa tortilishi
options_ru: утрата полного контроля над принятием решений
неограниченная личная ответственность владельца
сложная процедура государственной регистрации
двойное налогообложение распределенной прибыли
options_en: the loss of full control over decisions
the owner's unlimited personal liability
the complex procedure of its registration
the double taxation of its distributed profit
questions.explanation_en: A sole proprietor answers for business debts with all personal property, which is the form's main drawback. Registration is in fact the simplest, double taxation affects corporations, and the owner keeps full control.

questions.text_en: A general partnership differs from a sole proprietorship mainly because
options: uning aksiyalari fond birjasida erkin savdo qilinadi
u olgan foydasidan hech qanday soliq to'lamaydi
u doimo davlat organiga tegishli bo'lib boshqariladi
kapital va javobgarlik bir necha egaga taqsimlanadi
options_ru: его акции свободно обращаются на фондовой бирже
он вообще не платит налогов с полученной прибыли
он всегда принадлежит государству и им управляется
капитал и ответственность делят несколько владельцев
options_en: its shares are freely traded on a stock exchange
it pays no taxes at all on the profit it earns
it is always owned and managed by the state body
capital and liability are shared by several owners
questions.explanation_en: A partnership pools the capital and the liability of two or more partners, which widens resources but divides control. Traded shares belong to joint-stock companies, and partnerships are taxed and privately owned.

questions.text_en: The key legal advantage of a joint-stock company for its investors is
options: kundalik boshqaruv ustidan to'liq shaxsiy nazorat
barcha korporativ soliqlardan to'liq ozod bo'lish
javobgarlik aksiyalari qiymati bilan cheklanishi
qonunda belgilangan kafolatli yillik dividend
options_ru: полный личный контроль над текущим управлением
полное освобождение от всех налогов на прибыль
ответственность ограничена стоимостью их акций
гарантированный законом годовой дивиденд фирмы
options_en: full personal control over daily management
complete exemption from all corporate taxes
liability limited to the value of their shares
a guaranteed annual dividend fixed by the law
questions.explanation_en: Shareholders risk only what they paid for their shares, which is why large capital can be raised from many investors. Dividends are not guaranteed, daily control belongs to managers, and corporate profit is taxed.

questions.text_en: In a limited liability company, the members' risk is limited to
options: kompaniya aktivlarining bozor qiymati bilan
o'z shaxsiy mulkining to'liq qiymati bilan
yollangan xodimlarga qarz ish haqi bilan
ustav kapitaliga qo'shgan ulushlari bilan
options_ru: рыночной стоимостью активов этой компании
полной стоимостью их личного имущества
долгами по зарплате наемных работников
их вкладами в уставный капитал общества
options_en: the market value of the company's assets
the whole value of their personal property
the wages owed to all the hired employees
their contributions to the charter capital
questions.explanation_en: Members of an LLC answer only up to their contribution to the charter capital. Liability extending to all personal property characterises proprietorships and general partnerships.

questions.text_en: Small business status in most countries is determined mainly by
options: xodimlar soni va yillik aylanma hajmi bilan
ta'sischi yoshi va ma'lumot darajasi bilan
tarmoq turi va eksport ulushi hajmi bilan
ustav fondidagi xorijiy kapital ulushi bilan
options_ru: числом работников и годовым оборотом фирмы
возрастом основателя и уровнем образования
отраслью производства и долей экспорта фирмы
долей иностранного капитала в уставном фонде
options_en: the number of employees and annual turnover
the age of the founder and his education level
the branch of industry and the export share
the share of foreign capital in the charter fund
questions.explanation_en: Statistical and legal definitions of small business rely on quantitative criteria, above all headcount and turnover (sometimes asset value). Personal characteristics of the founder and export or ownership shares are not the basic criteria.

questions.text_en: Entrepreneurial capital is best understood as
options: davlat budjetiga har yili o'tkaziladigan soliqlar
biznesni boshlash va yuritishga avanslangan resurslar
bank depozit hisobida saqlanadigan shaxsiy jamg'arma
yollangan xodimlarga to'lab beriladigan ish haqi fondi
options_ru: налоги, перечисляемые ежегодно в бюджет государства
ресурсы, авансированные для начала и ведения дела
личные сбережения, хранимые на банковском депозите
фонд оплаты труда, выплачиваемый наемным работникам
options_en: the taxes transferred to the state budget yearly
the resources advanced to start and run a business
the personal savings kept on a bank deposit account
the wage fund paid out to all hired personnel
questions.explanation_en: Entrepreneurial capital is the stock of money, physical and intangible resources advanced into a business to earn income. Idle savings are not yet capital, while the wage fund and taxes are current outlays financed from capital turnover.

questions.text_en: Which of the following belongs to the firm's fixed capital?
options: Ko'p yillar ishlatiladigan ishlab chiqarish uskunasi
Bir aylanishda to'liq iste'mol qilinadigan xomashyo
Joriy ish oyi davomida yoqilgan yoqilg'i zaxirasi
Ishchilarga har oy to'lab beriladigan ish haqi
options_ru: Производственное оборудование, служащее годами
Сырье, полностью потребляемое за один цикл
Топливо, сожженное в течение текущего месяца
Заработная плата, выплачиваемая рабочим ежемесячно
options_en: Production machinery used for many years
Raw materials consumed within one cycle
Fuel burned during the current work month
Wages paid out to the workers monthly
questions.explanation_en: Fixed capital serves many production cycles and transfers its value gradually through depreciation, as machinery does. Raw materials, fuel and wages are consumed within one cycle and belong to working capital.

questions.text_en: Borrowed (debt) capital differs from equity capital because it
options: yillik foydaning faqat qoldiq ulushini oladi
firma balans hisobotida umuman aks ettirilmaydi
belgilangan muddatda foizi bilan qaytarilishi shart
egasiga firma qarorlarida ovoz huquqini beradi
options_ru: получает лишь остаточную долю годовой прибыли
вообще не отражается в балансовом отчете фирмы
подлежит возврату с процентами в срок договора
дает владельцу голос в решениях самой фирмы
options_en: receives a residual share of annual profit
never appears on the balance sheet at all
must be repaid with interest by a set date
gives its supplier a vote in firm decisions
questions.explanation_en: Debt carries a contractual obligation to repay principal with interest on schedule, regardless of profit. Voting rights and a residual profit claim belong to equity, and all liabilities do appear on the balance sheet.

questions.text_en: Venture capital is normally invested in
options: barqaror tushumli yetuk kommunal firmalarga
tavakkali yuqori yosh innovatsion firmalarga
kafolatlangan kuponli davlat obligatsiyalariga
tijorat banklarining sug'urtalangan depozitiga
options_ru: в зрелые компании с устойчивой годовой выручкой
в молодые инновационные фирмы высокого риска
в государственные облигации с твердым купоном
в застрахованные депозиты коммерческих банков
options_en: mature utilities with stable revenue
young innovative firms with high risk
state bonds with a guaranteed coupon
insured deposits of commercial banks
questions.explanation_en: Venture capital accepts a high probability of failure in exchange for very large returns from a few successful innovative start-ups. Government bonds, insured deposits and mature utilities are low-risk, low-return placements.

questions.text_en: Which is an internal source of a firm's start-up capital?
options: Tijorat bankidan olingan muddatli kredit
Davlat budjetidan olingan subsidiya puli
Korporativ obligatsiya chiqarib olingan pul
Ta'sischilarning jamg'armasi va mulki
options_ru: Долгосрочный кредит коммерческого банка
Субсидия, полученная из бюджета страны
Средства от выпуска облигаций компании
Сбережения и имущество самих учредителей
options_en: A long-term loan from a commercial bank
A subsidy received from the state budget
Funds raised by issuing corporate bonds
Savings and property of the founders
questions.explanation_en: The founders' own savings and contributed property are internal (own) sources. Bank credit, budget subsidies and bond issues bring funds in from outside the firm.

questions.text_en: Risk that affects the whole market and cannot be removed by diversification is called
options: operatsion, ya'ni ichki texnik tavakkalchilik
ma'naviy, ya'ni shartnomadan keyingi tavakkal
tizimli, ya'ni diversifikatsiyalanmas tavakkal
xususiy, ya'ni firma darajasidagi tavakkal
options_ru: операционным внутренним техническим риском
моральным риском после заключения договора
систематическим, недиверсифицируемым риском
специфическим риском отдельной фирмы рынка
options_en: operational, or internal technical, risk
moral hazard, or post-contract, risk
systematic, or non-diversifiable, risk
specific, or firm-level, individual risk
questions.explanation_en: Systematic risk comes from economy-wide factors such as recessions or inflation and therefore cannot be diversified away. Specific, operational and moral-hazard risks arise at the level of an individual firm or contract.

questions.text_en: Spreading investment across many different projects is a way of
options: sug'urta orqali tavakkalni o'tkazib yuborish
bozordan chiqib, tavakkaldan butunlay qochish
fyuchers shartnomasi bilan tavakkalni to'sish
diversifikatsiya orqali tavakkalni kamaytirish
options_ru: передачи риска через договор страхования дела
уклонения от риска путем выхода с этого рынка
хеджирования риска фьючерсными контрактами
снижения риска путем диверсификации вложений
options_en: transferring risk through insurance
avoiding risk by leaving the market
hedging risk with futures contracts
reducing risk through diversification
questions.explanation_en: Holding many imperfectly correlated projects lowers the variability of total return, which is diversification. Insurance transfers risk to another party, exit avoids it, and hedging offsets it with derivative contracts.

questions.text_en: Entrepreneurial income (profit) is best seen economically as
options: tavakkal va innovatsiya uchun mukofot sifatida
qarz pulidan foydalanish uchun to'lov sifatida
tanqis yerdan foydalanish uchun renta sifatida
oddiy mehnat soatlari uchun ish haqi sifatida
options_ru: вознаграждение за риск и новаторство дела
плата за пользование заемными средствами
рента за использование редкой земли фирмой
заработная плата за часы рутинного труда
options_en: a reward for bearing risk and innovating
a payment for the use of borrowed money
a rent paid for the use of scarce land
a wage for the hours of routine labour
questions.explanation_en: Profit is the residual income that rewards risk bearing, organisation and innovation. Interest, rent and wages are the incomes of the other factors - capital, land and labour.

questions.text_en: Economic profit differs from accounting profit because economic profit also subtracts
options: narx tarkibiga kirgan egri soliqlar summasini
o'z resurslarining yashirin imkoniyat xarajatini
faqat boshqalarga qilingan aniq pul to'lovlarini
asosiy kapitalga hisoblangan amortizatsiyani
options_ru: косвенные налоги, включенные в цену продукта
неявные альтернативные издержки своих ресурсов
только явные платежи, сделанные другим лицам
амортизационные отчисления основного капитала
options_en: the indirect taxes included in the price
implicit opportunity costs of own resources
only the explicit payments made to others
the depreciation charge on fixed capital
questions.explanation_en: Economic profit deducts implicit costs such as the forgone salary and interest on the owner's own capital, so it can be zero while accounting profit is positive. Explicit payments, depreciation and taxes are already in accounting cost.

questions.text_en: Under a franchise agreement, the franchisee obtains
options: tanilgan brend ostida savdo qilish huquqini
franchayzerning ustav kapitalidan ulush olishni
bojsiz eksport qilish uchun davlat litsenziyasini

gives the firm a tax exemption for five years
provides the use of assets without full purchase

questions.explanation_en: Leasing separates use from ownership, so the firm obtains equipment without a large initial outlay. Ownership passes only if a purchase option is exercised, lease payments are periodic by nature, and no blanket tax holiday is involved.

options_en: fix the wage rates of all future employees
justify the project and attract financing
replace the firm's annual tax declaration
record all completed accounting operations
questions.explanation_en: A business plan sets out the idea, market, finances and risks in order to guide the founders and convince investors or lenders. Tax reporting and bookkeeping record past facts, and wage setting is an internal personnel decision.

questions.text_en: Bankruptcy of a firm legally means that the firm
options: bir necha yil davomida o'z foydasini kamaytirgan
faoliyat yo'nalishini o'zgartirishga qaror qilgan
aksiyalarining nazorat paketini sotib yuborgan

продала контрольный пакет своих обыкновенных акций
не может исполнить обязательства перед кредиторами
options_en: has reduced its profit for several years
has decided to change its line of business
has sold a controlling block of its shares
cannot meet its obligations to creditors
questions.explanation_en: Bankruptcy (insolvency) is the legally recognised inability to satisfy creditors' claims from available assets. Falling profit, a change of activity or a sale of shares are business events that need not involve insolvency.

questions.text_en: Introducing a cheaper method of making an existing good is an example of

firma qilgan moliyaviy investitsiyaga
firma ichidagi jarayon innovatsiyasiga
firma ichidagi mahsulot innovatsiyasiga

продуктовой инновацией внутри фирмы
options_en: a marketing campaign run by the firm
a financial investment made by the firm
a process innovation inside the firm
a product innovation inside the firm
questions.explanation_en: Changing how an unchanged good is produced is process innovation, which lowers unit cost. Product innovation would change the good itself, while a campaign or an investment need involve no new technology.

семейный бизнес на неоплачиваемом домашнем труде
предпринимательские проекты внутри крупной компании
options_en: entrepreneurship financed only by state grants
informal trading carried on without registration
family business based on unpaid household work
entrepreneurial projects inside a large company
questions.explanation_en: Intrapreneurship means employees developing new ventures with their employer's resources inside an existing company. Grant financing, informal trade and family businesses are unrelated classifications.

questions.text_en: Which element belongs to the external business environment of a firm?

Выбранная внутренняя учетная политика
options_en: Tax legislation and market competition
The firm's own organisational structure
The qualification of the firm's staff
The internal accounting policy chosen
questions.explanation_en: Legislation and competitive pressure are set outside the firm, which can only adapt to them. Structure, staff qualification and accounting policy are internal variables chosen by management.

questions.text_en: The circuit of entrepreneurial capital follows the sequence

questions.explanation_en: Capital begins as money, is converted into inputs, passes through production, emerges as finished goods and returns as a larger sum of money. The other orders break this logical sequence of the capital circuit.

questions.text_en: Social responsibility of entrepreneurship mainly requires a firm to

qisqa muddatli foydani har qanday yo'l bilan oshirish
butun foydasini xayriya jamg'armalariga o'tkazish
narxni o'rtacha xarajatdan past darajada saqlash

максимизировать краткосрочную прибыль любыми путями
передавать всю свою прибыль благотворительным фондам
держать цены ниже средних издержек своего выпуска

maximise short-run profit by any legal means
transfer all of its profit to charity funds
keep prices below the average cost of output
questions.explanation_en: Social responsibility means taking account of employees, consumers, the community and the environment alongside profit. Pure short-run profit maximisation ignores it, while giving away all profit or pricing below cost would destroy the business.

questions.text: Qisqa muddatda mahsulot hajmi oshganda qaysi xarajat turi o'zgarmay qoladi?
questions.text_ru: Какой вид затрат остаётся неизменным при росте выпуска в коротком периоде?
questions.text_en: Which type of cost remains unchanged as output rises in the short run?
options: Ijara haqi kabi doimiy xarajatlar
Ish haqi kabi o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar
Mahsulotning marjinal xarajatlari
Firmaning jami umumiy xarajatlari
options_ru: Постоянные затраты, например аренда
Переменные затраты, например зарплата
Предельные затраты выпуска продукции
Общие суммарные затраты всей фирмы
options_en: Fixed costs such as the rent paid
Variable costs such as hourly wages
Marginal costs of the extra unit
Total costs of the entire firm
questions.explanation_en: Fixed costs are contractual commitments (rent, insurance, equipment leases) that do not vary with output over the short run. Variable costs move with output, marginal cost is the cost of one extra unit, and total cost contains both fixed and variable parts, so all three change as output changes.

questions.text: Nonvoyxona uchun quyidagilardan qaysi biri o'zgaruvchan xarajat hisoblanadi?

options: Binoga to'lanadigan yillik soliq
Boshqaruvchining oylik maoshi
Ishlatilgan un va shakar qiymati
Oyma-oy to'lanadigan ijara haqi
options_ru: Ежегодный налог на здание цеха
Месячный оклад управляющего
Стоимость израсходованной муки
Ежемесячная арендная плата цеха
options_en: Annual tax paid on the building
Monthly salary of the manager
Cost of the flour actually used
Monthly rent paid for the shop
questions.explanation_en: Raw material use rises and falls directly with the number of loaves baked, which is the defining feature of a variable cost. Rent, the property tax and a fixed monthly salary are contractual amounts that are owed even when the ovens stand idle.

questions.text: Umumiy xarajat doimiy va o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar bilan qanday bog'langan?
questions.text_ru: Как общие затраты связаны с постоянными и переменными затратами?
questions.text_en: How is total cost related to fixed and variable costs?
options: Umumiy xarajat doimiy va o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar ayirmasi
Umumiy xarajat doimiy va o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar ko'paytmasi
Umumiy xarajat doimiy va o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar nisbati
Umumiy xarajat doimiy va o'zgaruvchan xarajatlar yig'indisi
options_ru: Общие затраты равны разности постоянных и переменных затрат
Общие затраты равны произведению постоянных и переменных затрат
Общие затраты равны отношению постоянных и переменных затрат
Общие затраты равны сумме постоянных и переменных затрат
options_en: Total cost equals the difference of fixed and variable costs
Total cost equals the product of fixed and variable costs
Total cost equals the ratio of fixed and variable costs
Total cost equals the sum of fixed and variable costs
questions.explanation_en: By definition TC = FC + VC: every outlay of the firm is classified as either fixed or variable, so adding the two gives total cost. Subtracting, multiplying or dividing them has no economic meaning and would give the wrong units.

questions.text: Marjinal xarajat nimani ifodalaydi?
questions.text_ru: Что выражают предельные затраты?
questions.text_en: What do marginal costs express?
options: Barcha ishlab chiqarilgan birliklarning o'rtacha xarajati
Mahsulot hajmiga umuman bog'liq bo'lmagan xarajat
Barcha ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarining yig'indisi
Qo'shimcha bir birlik mahsulot ishlab chiqarish xarajati
options_ru: Средние затраты на все произведённые единицы
Затраты, не зависящие от объёма выпуска продукции
Сумма всех производственных затрат предприятия
Затраты на производство одной дополнительной единицы
options_en: Average cost of all the units produced
Cost that does not depend on the output
Sum of all production costs of the firm
Cost of producing one extra unit of output
questions.explanation_en: Marginal cost is the change in total cost caused by producing one more unit, MC = dTC/dQ. Average cost spreads cost over all units, cost independent of output is fixed cost, and the sum of all outlays is total cost.

questions.text: Mahsulot hajmi oshgani sari o'rtacha doimiy xarajat qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.text_ru: Как изменяются средние постоянные затраты при росте выпуска продукции?
questions.text_en: How do average fixed costs change as output increases?
options: Mahsulot hajmidan qat'i nazar o'zgarmaydi
Mahsulot hajmi oshganda nolga aylanadi
Mahsulot hajmi oshgani sari pasayib boradi
Mahsulot hajmi oshgani sari ortib boradi
options_ru: Она не меняется при любом объёме выпуска
При росте выпуска она становится нулевой
При росте выпуска продукции она снижается
При росте выпуска продукции она растёт
options_en: It stays the same at every output level
It becomes exactly zero at large output
It falls continuously as output increases
It rises continuously as output increases
questions.explanation_en: AFC = FC/Q, so a constant numerator divided by a growing denominator falls steadily; this is the spreading of overheads. It never rises, is not constant (only total fixed cost is), and approaches zero without ever reaching it.

questions.text: Marjinal xarajat egri chizig'i o'rtacha umumiy xarajat egri chizig'ini qayerda kesib o'tadi?
questions.text_ru: В какой точке кривая предельных затрат пересекает кривую средних общих затрат?
questions.text_en: At which point does the marginal cost curve cross the average total cost curve?
options: Umumiy xarajatning maksimal nuqtasida
O'rtacha xarajatning minimal nuqtasida
O'rtacha xarajatning maksimal nuqtasida
Doimiy xarajatning minimal nuqtasida
options_ru: В точке максимума общих затрат фирмы
В точке минимума средних затрат фирмы
В точке максимума средних затрат фирмы
В точке минимума постоянных затрат фирмы
options_en: At the maximum point of total cost
At the minimum point of average cost
At the maximum point of average cost
At the minimum point of fixed cost
questions.explanation_en: While MC lies below ATC the average is pulled down and while MC lies above it the average is pushed up, so the two curves must meet exactly where ATC is at its lowest. ATC has no maximum in the relevant range, and MC has no special link to the extremes of fixed or total cost.

questions.text: Qisqa muddatda marjinal xarajat nima uchun oxir-oqibat o'sib boradi?
questions.text_ru: Почему в коротком периоде предельные затраты в конечном счёте растут?
questions.text_en: Why do marginal costs eventually rise in the short run?
options: Marjinal mahsuldorlikning pasayishi tufayli
Doimiy xarajatlarning pasayishi tufayli
Mahsulot narxining pasayishi tufayli
O'rtacha mahsuldorlikning ortishi tufayli
options_ru: Из-за убывающей предельной производительности
Из-за снижения постоянных затрат предприятия
Из-за снижения рыночной цены готового товара
Из-за роста средней производительности труда
options_en: Because marginal productivity diminishes
Because fixed costs fall as output grows
Because the market price of goods falls
Because average productivity keeps rising
questions.explanation_en: With at least one input fixed, extra units of the variable input add less and less output, so each additional unit of product absorbs more input and costs more. Falling fixed cost per unit and the market price of the good do not enter the cost of the next unit, and rising average productivity would lower, not raise, marginal cost.

questions.text: Firmaning doimiy xarajati 400, 50 birlik mahsulotdagi o'zgaruvchan xarajati 600. O'rtacha umumiy xarajat qancha?
questions.text_ru: Постоянные затраты фирмы равны 400, переменные при выпуске 50 единиц — 600. Чему равны средние общие затраты?
questions.text_en: A firm's fixed cost is 400 and its variable cost at an output of 50 units is 600. What is average total cost?
options: 12 so'm
28 so'm
32 so'm
20 so'm
options_ru: 12 сум
28 сум
32 сум
20 сум
options_en: 12 so'm
28 so'm
32 so'm
20 so'm
questions.explanation_en: Total cost is 400 + 600 = 1000 and ATC = 1000/50 = 20. The value 12 is average variable cost, 28 mixes the figures incorrectly, and 32 would require a far smaller output.

questions.text: Mahsulot hajmi 100 dan 110 birlikka oshganda umumiy xarajat 1500 dan 1680 ga ko'tarildi. Marjinal xarajat qancha?
questions.text_ru: При росте выпуска с 100 до 110 единиц общие затраты выросли с 1500 до 1680. Чему равны предельные затраты?
questions.text_en: When output rises from 100 to 110 units, total cost rises from 1,500 to 1,680. What is marginal cost?
options: 21 so'm
24 so'm
18 so'm
15 so'm
options_ru: 21 сум
24 сум
18 сум
15 сум
options_en: 21 so'm
24 so'm
18 so'm
15 so'm
questions.explanation_en: MC equals the change in total cost divided by the change in output: 180/10 = 18. The figure 15 is average total cost at the first output level, while 21 and 24 do not follow from the given changes.

questions.text: O'zgaruvchan xarajat 900 so'm bo'lib, 60 birlik mahsulot ishlab chiqarilgan. O'rtacha o'zgaruvchan xarajat qancha?
questions.text_ru: Переменные затраты составляют 900 сум при выпуске 60 единиц. Чему равны средние переменные затраты?
questions.text_en: Variable cost is 900 so'm at an output of 60 units. What is average variable cost?
options: 15 so'm
12 so'm
18 so'm
25 so'm
options_ru: 15 сум
12 сум
18 сум
25 сум
options_en: 15 so'm
12 so'm
18 so'm
25 so'm
questions.explanation_en: AVC = VC/Q = 900/60 = 15. The other values would require a different level of variable cost or of output, and none of them can be obtained from the two figures given.

questions.text: Firmaning daromadi 50 000, oshkor xarajatlari 35 000, yashirin xarajatlari 8 000. Iqtisodiy foyda qancha?
questions.text_ru: Выручка фирмы 50 000, явные издержки 35 000, неявные издержки 8 000. Чему равна экономическая прибыль?
questions.text_en: A firm's revenue is 50,000, explicit costs are 35,000 and implicit costs are 8,000. What is economic profit?
options_ru: 7 000 сум
questions.explanation_en: Economic profit subtracts both explicit and implicit costs: 50,000 - 35,000 - 8,000 = 7,000. The value 15,000 is accounting profit, 23,000 adds the implicit cost instead of subtracting it, and 42,000 ignores the explicit costs.

questions.text: Iqtisodiy foyda buxgalteriya foydasidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
questions.text_ru: Чем экономическая прибыль отличается от бухгалтерской прибыли?
questions.text_en: How does economic profit differ from accounting profit?
options: Yashirin xarajatlarni ham hisobga oladi
Faqat oshkor xarajatlarni hisobga oladi
Faqat doimiy xarajatlarni hisobga oladi
Hech qanday xarajatni hisobga olmaydi
options_ru: Он учитывает также неявные издержки фирмы
Он учитывает только явные издержки фирмы
Он учитывает только постоянные издержки
Он вообще не учитывает никакие издержки
options_en: It also counts the implicit costs borne
It counts only the explicit money costs
It counts only the fixed costs incurred
It counts no costs of the firm at all
questions.explanation_en: Economic profit deducts the opportunity cost of the owner's own resources (implicit costs) in addition to money payments, so it is always smaller than accounting profit. Counting only explicit costs defines accounting profit, and the remaining options describe no recognised profit concept.

questions.text: Normal foyda holati nimani anglatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает ситуация нормальной прибыли?
questions.text_en: What does the situation of normal profit mean?
options: Firmaning iqtisodiy foydasi juda katta
Firmaning buxgalteriya foydasi nolga teng
Firmaning umumiy daromadi nolga teng
Firmaning iqtisodiy foydasi nolga teng
options_ru: Экономическая прибыль фирмы очень велика
Бухгалтерская прибыль фирмы равна нулю
Общая выручка фирмы равна нулю совсем
Экономическая прибыль фирмы равна нулю
options_en: The firm's economic profit is very large
The firm's accounting profit equals zero
The firm's total revenue equals zero
The firm's economic profit equals zero
questions.explanation_en: Normal profit is the minimum return that keeps resources in their present use, so revenue just covers explicit plus implicit costs and economic profit is zero while accounting profit is still positive. Zero accounting profit or zero revenue would mean the firm cannot cover its money outlays at all.

questions.text: Firma foydani maksimallashtirish uchun mahsulot hajmini qanday tanlaydi?
questions.text_ru: Как фирма выбирает объём выпуска для максимизации прибыли?
questions.text_en: How does a firm choose the output level that maximises profit?
options: Marjinal daromad marjinal xarajatga teng bo'lganda
Marjinal daromad marjinal xarajatdan yuqori bo'lganda
O'rtacha daromad o'rtacha xarajatga teng bo'lganda
Umumiy daromad umumiy xarajatga teng bo'lganda
options_ru: Когда предельный доход равен предельным затратам
Когда предельный доход выше предельных затрат
Когда средний доход равен средним затратам фирмы
Когда общая выручка равна общим затратам фирмы
options_en: When marginal revenue equals marginal cost
When marginal revenue exceeds marginal cost
When average revenue equals average cost
When total revenue equals the total cost
questions.explanation_en: Profit grows while MR exceeds MC and shrinks once MC exceeds MR, so the maximum is reached where MR = MC. If MR still exceeds MC the firm should expand further, while the equality of averages or of totals describes break-even, not the profit maximum.

questions.text: Zararsizlik (break-even) nuqtasi nimani ko'rsatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что показывает точка безубыточности?
questions.text_en: What does the break-even point show?
options: Marjinal xarajat eng past bo'lgan nuqta
Umumiy daromad umumiy xarajatga teng nuqta
Umumiy daromad eng yuqori bo'lgan nuqta
O'rtacha xarajat eng past bo'lgan nuqta
options_ru: Точка, где предельные затраты минимальны
Точка, где выручка равна общим затратам
Точка, где выручка достигает максимума
Точка, где средние затраты минимальны
options_en: The point where marginal cost is lowest
The point where revenue equals total cost
The point where revenue reaches a maximum
The point where average cost is a minimum
