questions.explanation_en: At break-even the firm makes neither profit nor loss because total revenue exactly covers total cost. Maximum revenue, minimum average cost and minimum marginal cost are different output levels and generally involve either profit or loss.

questions.text: Doimiy xarajat 30 000, narx 50, o'rtacha o'zgaruvchan xarajat 30. Zararsizlik hajmi qancha?
questions.text_ru: Постоянные затраты 30 000, цена 50, средние переменные затраты 30. Каков безубыточный объём?
questions.text_en: Fixed cost is 30,000, price is 50 and average variable cost is 30. What is the break-even quantity?
options: 2 000 dona
3 000 dona
1 500 dona
1 000 dona
options_ru: 2 000 единиц
3 000 единиц
1 500 единиц
1 000 единиц
options_en: 2 000 units
3 000 units
1 500 units
1 000 units
questions.explanation_en: Break-even output equals fixed cost divided by the contribution margin: 30,000/(50 - 30) = 1,500 units. Dividing fixed cost by price alone gives 600, while 1,000, 2,000 and 3,000 use the wrong margin.

questions.text: Qisqa muddatda firma ishlab chiqarishni qachon to'xtatishi maqsadga muvofiq?
questions.text_ru: Когда фирме целесообразно остановить производство в коротком периоде?
questions.text_en: When is it sensible for a firm to shut down in the short run?
options: Narx o'rtacha doimiy xarajatga teng bo'lsa
Narx o'rtacha o'zgaruvchan xarajatdan past bo'lsa
Narx o'rtacha umumiy xarajatdan past bo'lsa
Narx marjinal xarajatdan sezilarli yuqori bo'lsa
options_ru: Если цена равна средним постоянным затратам
Если цена ниже средних переменных затрат
Если цена ниже средних общих затрат фирмы
Если цена заметно выше предельных затрат
options_en: If price is equal to average fixed cost
If price falls below average variable cost
If price falls below average total cost
If price rises well above marginal cost
questions.explanation_en: Operating is worthwhile as long as revenue covers variable cost and makes some contribution to fixed cost; once price drops below AVC each unit sold adds to the loss, so shutting down is better. A price below ATC but above AVC means a loss that is still smaller than the fixed cost, and a price above MC is a reason to produce more.

questions.text: "Botgan" (sunk) xarajat deganda nima tushuniladi?
questions.text_ru: Что понимается под необратимыми (утопленными) затратами?
questions.text_en: What is meant by a sunk cost?
options: Qaytarib bo'lmaydigan va qarorga ta'sirsiz xarajat
Har bir qo'shimcha birlik uchun qilinadigan xarajat
Mahsulot hajmi bilan birga o'sib boradigan xarajat
Bir birlikka to'g'ri keladigan o'rtacha xarajat
options_ru: Невозвратные затраты, не влияющие на решение
Затраты на каждую дополнительную единицу
Затраты, растущие вместе с объёмом выпуска
Затраты, приходящиеся на одну единицу
options_en: A past cost that cannot affect decisions
A cost incurred for each extra unit made
A cost that grows together with output
A cost that falls on a single unit sold
questions.explanation_en: A sunk cost has already been incurred and cannot be recovered, so a rational forward-looking decision ignores it. The other descriptions define marginal cost, variable cost and average cost, all of which do change with current choices.

questions.text: Uzoq muddatli davrda xarajatlar bilan nima sodir bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Что происходит с затратами в длительном периоде?
questions.text_en: What happens to costs in the long run?
options: Faqat xomashyo xarajati doimiy bo'ladi
Barcha xarajatlar o'zgaruvchan bo'ladi
Barcha xarajatlar doimiy bo'lib qoladi
Faqat ish haqi doimiy bo'lib qoladi
options_ru: Постоянными остаются только материалы
Все затраты становятся переменными
Все затраты становятся постоянными
Постоянной остаётся только зарплата
options_en: Only material costs remain fixed costs
All of the firm's costs become variable
All of the firm's costs become fixed
Only wage payments remain fixed costs
questions.explanation_en: In the long run the firm can change every input, including plant and equipment, so no cost is fixed. Wages and materials are the classic variable costs even in the short run, so they cannot be the items that stay fixed.

questions.text: Ishlab chiqarish miqyosidan tejamkorlik (economies of scale) nimani bildiradi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает экономия на масштабе производства?
questions.text_en: What do economies of scale mean?
options: Ishlab chiqarish o'sganda o'rtacha xarajat pasayadi
Ishlab chiqarish o'sganda o'rtacha xarajat ortadi
Ishlab chiqarish o'sganda umumiy xarajat pasayadi
Ishlab chiqarish o'sganda marjinal daromad ortadi
options_ru: С ростом масштаба средние затраты снижаются
С ростом масштаба средние затраты растут
С ростом масштаба общие затраты снижаются
С ростом масштаба предельный доход растёт
options_en: Average cost falls as the scale of output grows
Average cost rises as the scale of output grows
Total cost falls as the scale of output grows
Marginal revenue rises as the scale grows
questions.explanation_en: Economies of scale mean long-run average cost declines as the plant grows, thanks to specialisation, bulk buying and indivisible equipment. Rising average cost is diseconomies of scale, total cost always rises with output, and marginal revenue depends on demand, not on scale.

questions.text: Miqyosdan zarar (diseconomies of scale) asosan nima tufayli yuzaga keladi?
questions.text_ru: Из-за чего в основном возникает отрицательный эффект масштаба?
questions.text_en: What mainly gives rise to diseconomies of scale?
options: Xomashyoni arzon narxda ko'p miqdorda sotib olish
Yangi texnologiyalarni keng joriy etish imkoni
Boshqaruvning murakkablashishi va nazorat qiyinligi
Ixtisoslashuvning chuqurlashishi va tejamkorlik
options_ru: Закупка сырья крупными партиями по низкой цене
Возможность широко внедрять новые технологии
Усложнение управления и трудности контроля
Углубление специализации и экономия ресурсов
options_en: Inputs are bought in bulk at much lower prices
New technologies can be introduced more widely
Management becomes complex and control is harder
Specialisation deepens and resources are saved
questions.explanation_en: Beyond a certain size coordination, monitoring and communication become costly, so long-run average cost turns upward. Deeper specialisation, bulk purchasing and wider use of technology are all sources of economies of scale, which lower average cost.

questions.text: Uzoq muddatli o'rtacha xarajat egri chizig'i nimani ko'rsatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что показывает кривая долгосрочных средних затрат?
questions.text_en: What does the long-run average cost curve show?
options: Har bir hajm uchun eng katta umumiy daromadni
Har bir hajm uchun eng kam o'rtacha xarajatni
Har bir hajm uchun eng katta o'rtacha xarajatni
Har bir hajm uchun eng kam marjinal xarajatni
options_ru: Наибольшую общую выручку для каждого объёма
Наименьшие средние затраты для каждого объёма
Наибольшие средние затраты для каждого объёма
Наименьшие предельные затраты для каждого объёма
options_en: The highest total revenue for each output level
The lowest average cost for each output level
The highest average cost for each output level
The lowest marginal cost for each output level
questions.explanation_en: The LRAC curve is the envelope of all short-run average cost curves and therefore traces the cheapest way of producing each output when plant size is adjustable. It says nothing about the highest costs, about marginal cost minima, or about revenue.

questions.text: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri yashirin (implicit) xarajatga misol bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Что из перечисленного является примером неявных издержек?
questions.text_en: Which of the following is an example of an implicit cost?
options: Yetkazib beruvchiga to'langan mablag'
Bank krediti uchun to'langan foizlar
Egasi olishi mumkin bo'lgan ish haqi
Ishchilarga haqiqatda to'langan ish haqi
options_ru: Плата, перечисленная поставщику за сырьё
Проценты, выплаченные банку по кредиту
Зарплата, которую владелец мог бы получать
Зарплата, фактически выплаченная рабочим
options_en: The money paid to the input supplier
The interest paid on the bank loan
The salary the owner could have earned
The wages actually paid to the workers
questions.explanation_en: An implicit cost is the opportunity cost of a resource the owner already controls, such as the salary forgone by working in the own firm; no money changes hands. Wages, supplier payments and loan interest are explicit money outlays recorded in the accounts.

questions.text: Foyda iqtisodiy nazariyada qanday aniqlanadi?
questions.text_ru: Как прибыль определяется в экономической теории?
questions.text_en: How is profit defined in economic theory?
options: Umumiy xarajat va mahsulot hajmi o'rtasidagi farq
Umumiy daromad va umumiy xarajat o'rtasidagi farq
Umumiy daromad va umumiy xarajat o'rtasidagi nisbat
Umumiy daromad va sotilgan mahsulot ko'paytmasi
options_ru: Разность между общими затратами и объёмом выпуска
Разность между общей выручкой и общими затратами
Отношение общей выручки к общим затратам фирмы
Произведение общей выручки и объёма продукции
options_en: The difference between total cost and total output
The difference between total revenue and total cost
The ratio of total revenue to the total cost
The product of total revenue and total output
questions.explanation_en: Profit is a residual: what is left of revenue after all costs have been covered, so profit = TR - TC. A ratio of revenue to cost measures profitability rather than profit, and the remaining expressions combine incompatible units.

questions.text: Firma 200 dona mahsulotni 60 so'mdan sotdi, umumiy xarajati 9 000 so'm. Foyda qancha?
questions.text_ru: Фирма продала 200 единиц по 60 сум, общие затраты составили 9 000 сум. Чему равна прибыль?
questions.text_en: A firm sells 200 units at 60 so'm each and its total cost is 9,000 so'm. What is its profit?
options_ru: 9 000 сум
3 000 сум
questions.explanation_en: Total revenue is 200 x 60 = 12,000 and profit is 12,000 - 9,000 = 3,000. The figure 12,000 is revenue, 9,000 is total cost, and 21,000 wrongly adds revenue and cost together.

questions.text: Marjinal xarajat o'rtacha umumiy xarajatdan past bo'lsa, o'rtacha umumiy xarajat qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.text_ru: Если предельные затраты ниже средних общих затрат, как меняются средние общие затраты?
questions.text_en: If marginal cost lies below average total cost, what happens to average total cost?
options: O'rtacha umumiy xarajat ortib boradi
O'rtacha umumiy xarajat o'zgarmaydi
O'rtacha doimiy xarajat ortib boradi
O'rtacha umumiy xarajat pasayib boradi
options_ru: Средние общие затраты будут возрастать
Средние общие затраты не изменятся
Средние постоянные затраты возрастут
Средние общие затраты будут снижаться
options_en: Average total cost will keep rising
Average total cost will stay the same
Average fixed cost will start rising
Average total cost will keep falling
questions.explanation_en: Each extra unit that costs less than the current average pulls the average down, exactly as a low new mark lowers a student's mean grade. The average only rises when MC is above it, stays constant when MC equals it, and average fixed cost always falls with output.

questions.text: Qisqa muddatda marjinal mahsuldorlikning pasayish qonuni xarajatlarda qanday namoyon bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Как закон убывающей предельной производительности проявляется в затратах в коротком периоде?
questions.text_en: How does the law of diminishing marginal returns show up in short-run costs?
options: Umumiy mahsulot kamayib, umumiy xarajat kamayadi
Marjinal mahsulot kamayib, marjinal xarajat ortadi
Marjinal mahsulot ortib, marjinal xarajat kamayadi
O'rtacha mahsulot ortib, doimiy xarajat kamayadi
options_ru: Общий продукт падает, общие затраты также падают
Предельный продукт падает, предельные затраты растут
Предельный продукт растёт, предельные затраты падают
Средний продукт растёт, постоянные затраты падают
options_en: Total product falls, so total cost also falls
Marginal product falls, so marginal cost rises
Marginal product rises, so marginal cost falls
Average product rises, so fixed cost falls
questions.explanation_en: Marginal cost is the input price divided by marginal product, so when marginal product declines marginal cost must rise; this is why the MC curve is upward sloping. The other combinations describe the earlier stage of increasing returns or confuse product with cost movements.

chapters.title_ru: Заработная плата, оклад и трудовые отношения

questions.text: Iqtisodiy nazariyada ish haqi nimani ifodalaydi?
questions.text_ru: Что выражает заработная плата в экономической теории?
questions.text_en: What does the wage represent in economic theory?
options: Tadbirkorlik qobiliyati uchun olinadigan foyda
Ish kuchi xizmatlari uchun to'lanadigan narx
Yer resursidan foydalanish uchun to'lov
Kapital qiymatining pul ko'rinishidagi o'sishi
options_ru: Доход, получаемый за предпринимательство
Цена, уплачиваемая за услуги рабочей силы
Плата за использование земельного ресурса
Прирост стоимости капитала в денежной форме
options_en: The income earned by the entrepreneur
The price paid for the services of labour
The payment made for the use of land
The money increase in the value of capital
questions.explanation_en: The wage is the factor price of labour, the amount paid per unit of labour services hired. Payment for land is rent, the return to capital is interest, and the residual reward of the entrepreneur is profit.

questions.text: Real ish haqi nimani ko'rsatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что показывает реальная заработная плата?
questions.text_en: What does the real wage show?
options: Ishlagan soatlar uchun olingan jami pul
Nominal ish haqining sotib olish quvvati
Pulda to'langan ish haqining miqdori
Soliqlar to'langandan keyingi daromad
options_ru: Все деньги, полученные за отработанные часы
Покупательная способность номинальной зарплаты
Сумма заработной платы, выплаченной деньгами
Доход, остающийся после уплаты всех налогов
options_en: All money received for the hours worked
The purchasing power of the nominal wage
The amount of wages paid out in money
The income left after all taxes are paid
questions.explanation_en: The real wage is the nominal wage deflated by the price level, so it measures the basket of goods a worker can actually buy. The money sum received is the nominal wage, and net-of-tax pay is disposable income, neither of which allows for price changes.

questions.text: Nominal ish haqi 10 foizga, narxlar 4 foizga oshdi. Real ish haqi qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.text_ru: Номинальная зарплата выросла на 10 процентов, цены — на 4 процента. Как изменится реальная зарплата?
questions.text_en: Nominal wages rise by 10 per cent and prices rise by 4 per cent. How does the real wage change?
options: Taxminan 6 foizga ortadi
Taxminan 6 foizga kamayadi
Taxminan 14 foizga ortadi
Taxminan 4 foizga kamayadi
options_ru: Вырастет примерно на 6 процентов
Снизится примерно на 6 процентов
Вырастет примерно на 14 процентов
Снизится примерно на 4 процента
options_en: It rises by about 6 per cent
It falls by about 6 per cent
It rises by about 14 per cent
It falls by about 4 per cent
questions.explanation_en: The approximate change in the real wage is the growth of the nominal wage minus inflation: 10 - 4 = 6 per cent. A fall would require inflation above wage growth, and adding the two rates (14) has no economic meaning.

questions.text: Firmaning mehnatga bo'lgan talabi birinchi navbatda nimaga asoslanadi?
questions.text_ru: На чём прежде всего основан спрос фирмы на труд?
questions.text_en: What is a firm's demand for labour based on above all?
options: Ishchilarning o'rtacha ish haqi darajasi
Firmaning doimiy xarajatlari miqdori
Mahsulotga bo'lgan talabning elastikligi
Mehnatning marjinal mahsulot daromadi
options_ru: Средний уровень заработной платы рабочих
Величина постоянных издержек предприятия
Эластичность спроса на готовую продукцию
Доход от предельного продукта труда фирмы
options_en: The average wage level of the workers
The size of the firm's fixed costs
The elasticity of demand for the good
The marginal revenue product of labour
questions.explanation_en: Labour demand is a derived demand: the firm values a worker by the extra revenue that worker's output brings, so the MRP curve is the demand curve for labour. The wage level determines how much of that demand is exercised, while fixed costs and demand elasticity affect the position of the curve only indirectly.

questions.text: Ishchining marjinal mahsuloti 5 birlik, mahsulot narxi 12 so'm. Marjinal mahsulot daromadi qancha?
questions.text_ru: Предельный продукт работника 5 единиц, цена продукции 12 сум. Чему равен доход от предельного продукта?
questions.text_en: A worker's marginal product is 5 units and the product price is 12 so'm. What is the marginal revenue product?
options: 60 so'm
50 so'm
17 so'm
72 so'm
options_ru: 60 сум
50 сум
17 сум
72 сум
options_en: 60 so'm
50 so'm
17 so'm
72 so'm
questions.explanation_en: In a competitive product market MRP = marginal product x price = 5 x 12 = 60. The value 17 adds the two figures, while 50 and 72 use the wrong product or price.

questions.text: Raqobatli bozorda firma qo'shimcha ishchi yollashni qachon to'xtatadi?
questions.text_ru: Когда фирма на конкурентном рынке прекращает нанимать дополнительных работников?
questions.text_en: When does a competitive firm stop hiring additional workers?
options: Ish haqi marjinal mahsulot daromadiga teng bo'lguncha
Ish haqi o'rtacha mahsulot qiymatiga teng bo'lguncha
Umumiy daromad umumiy xarajatga teng bo'lguncha
Marjinal mahsulot eng yuqori darajaga chiqquncha
options_ru: Пока зарплата не сравняется с предельным доходом
Пока зарплата не сравняется со средним продуктом
Пока общая выручка не сравняется с общими затратами
Пока предельный продукт не достигнет максимума
options_en: Until the wage equals marginal revenue product
Until the wage equals the average product value
Until total revenue equals the total cost paid
Until marginal product reaches its maximum
questions.explanation_en: Every worker whose MRP exceeds the wage adds to profit, so hiring continues until W = MRP. Comparing the wage with average product overstates the gain from the last worker, revenue equal to cost is break-even, and the maximum of marginal product occurs long before the optimal employment level.

questions.text: Yuqori ish haqi darajasida shaxsiy mehnat taklifi egri chizig'i nima uchun orqaga qayrilishi mumkin?
questions.text_ru: Почему при высокой зарплате индивидуальная кривая предложения труда может загибаться назад?
questions.text_en: Why can the individual labour supply curve bend backwards at high wage levels?
options: Mehnat unumdorligi keskin pasayib boshlaydi
Daromad effekti almashish effektidan ustun keladi
Almashish effekti daromad effektidan ustun keladi
Ish haqining real qiymati butunlay yo'qoladi
options_ru: Производительность труда резко начинает падать
Эффект дохода превышает эффект замещения
Эффект замещения превышает эффект дохода
Реальная стоимость зарплаты полностью теряется
options_en: Labour productivity suddenly begins to decline
The income effect outweighs the substitution effect
The substitution effect outweighs the income effect
The real value of the wage is completely lost
questions.explanation_en: At high wages the worker is rich enough to buy more leisure, and this income effect can dominate the substitution effect that pulls towards more work, so hours offered fall. When the substitution effect dominates the curve slopes upward, and neither a loss of real wage value nor falling productivity explains the backward bend.

questions.text: Inson kapitali tushunchasi nimani anglatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает понятие человеческого капитала?
questions.text_en: What does the concept of human capital mean?
options: Bankda saqlanadigan pul mablag'lari zaxirasi
Davlat ixtiyoridagi tabiiy resurslar zaxirasi
Ishchilarning bilim va ko'nikmalari zaxirasi
Korxonaning mashina va uskunalar zaxirasi
options_ru: Запас денежных средств, хранимых в банке
Запас природных ресурсов в руках государства
Запас знаний и профессиональных навыков людей
Запас машин и оборудования предприятия
options_en: The stock of money balances held in a bank
The stock of natural resources held by a state
The stock of knowledge and skills of people
The stock of machines and plant of a firm
questions.explanation_en: Human capital is the accumulated stock of education, training, experience and health embodied in people, which raises their productivity. Machines are physical capital, bank balances are financial assets, and natural resources are the land factor.

questions.text: Nima uchun ma'lumot darajasi yuqori ishchilar o'rtacha ko'proq daromad oladi?
questions.text_ru: Почему работники с более высоким образованием в среднем получают больше?
questions.text_en: Why do more educated workers on average earn more?
options: Ularning soliq yuki ancha past bo'ladi
Ularning mehnat unumdorligi yuqori bo'ladi
Ularning ish vaqti har doim qisqa bo'ladi
Ularga davlat majburiy ustama to'laydi
options_ru: Их налоговая нагрузка существенно ниже
Их производительность труда обычно выше
Их рабочее время всегда намного короче
Государство платит им обязательную надбавку
options_en: Their tax burden is substantially lower
Their labour productivity is usually higher
Their working hours are always much shorter
The state pays them a compulsory supplement
questions.explanation_en: Investment in schooling and training raises marginal productivity, which raises the marginal revenue product employers are willing to pay for. Educated workers do not systematically work shorter hours, receive no legally mandated premium, and face the same or higher tax rates.

questions.text: Xavfli va noqulay ishlar uchun nima uchun ko'pincha yuqoriroq haq to'lanadi?
questions.text_ru: Почему за опасную и неприятную работу часто платят более высокую зарплату?
questions.text_en: Why is a higher wage often paid for dangerous or unpleasant work?
options: Davlat bu tarmoqlarda narxni belgilagani uchun
Noqulay sharoitlar uchun qo'shimcha to'lov sifatida
Bu ishlarda unumdorlik doimo yuqori bo'lgani uchun
Bu ishlarda hech qanday malaka talab etilmagani uchun
options_ru: Потому что цены в этих отраслях задаёт государство
Как компенсация за неблагоприятные условия труда
Потому что производительность там всегда выше
Потому что там не требуется никакой квалификации
options_en: Because the state sets prices in these branches
As compensation for the unpleasant conditions
Because productivity there is always higher
Because no qualification at all is required
questions.explanation_en: This is a compensating wage differential: workers must be paid extra to accept risk, dirt or inconvenient hours, otherwise labour supply to that occupation dries up. Such jobs are not necessarily more productive, low skill requirements would lower pay, and administered prices are not the mechanism.

questions.text: Raqobatli mehnat bozorida muvozanatdan yuqori eng kam ish haqi belgilansa nima yuz beradi?
questions.text_ru: Что произойдёт, если на конкурентном рынке труда ввести минимальную зарплату выше равновесной?
questions.text_en: What happens if a minimum wage above the equilibrium level is set in a competitive labour market?
options: Mehnatga talab ortadi va bandlik ko'payadi
Bozor muvozanati umuman o'zgarmay qoladi
Mehnat taklifi ortadi va ishsizlik paydo bo'ladi
Mehnat taklifi kamayadi va ishsizlik yo'qoladi
options_ru: Спрос на труд растёт, занятость увеличивается
Рыночное равновесие вообще не изменяется
Предложение труда растёт, появляется безработица
Предложение труда падает, безработица исчезает
options_en: Labour demand rises and employment increases
The market equilibrium does not change at all
Labour supply rises and unemployment appears
Labour supply falls and unemployment vanishes
questions.explanation_en: A binding wage floor makes more people willing to work while employers hire fewer, so the quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded and this excess supply is unemployment. A higher wage cannot raise labour demand, and a floor above equilibrium is by definition binding, so the market cannot be unaffected.

questions.text: Kasaba uyushmasi a'zolarining ish haqini qanday yo'l bilan oshirishi mumkin?
questions.text_ru: Каким способом профсоюз может повысить заработную плату своих членов?
questions.text_en: In what way can a trade union raise the wages of its members?
options: Mehnatga bozor talabini kamaytirish orqali
Tayyor mahsulot narxini pasaytirish orqali
Daromad solig'i stavkasini oshirish orqali
Bozorda mehnat taklifini cheklash orqali
options_ru: Уменьшая рыночный спрос на труд в отрасли
Снижая цену готовой продукции отрасли
Повышая ставку налога на доходы граждан
Ограничивая рыночное предложение труда
options_en: By reducing the market demand for labour
By lowering the price of the final good
By raising the income tax rate on people
By restricting the market supply of labour
questions.explanation_en: Restricting entry through licensing, apprenticeship rules or closed-shop agreements shifts labour supply leftward and raises the negotiated wage. Reducing labour demand or the product price would lower the marginal revenue product and hence wages, and tax rates are not set by unions.

questions.text: Monopsoniya sharoitidagi mehnat bozorida to'lanadigan ish haqi qanday bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Какой будет заработная плата на рынке труда в условиях монопсонии?
questions.text_en: What is the wage paid in a monopsonistic labour market like?
options: To'liq davlat tomonidan belgilab qo'yiladi
Marjinal mahsulot daromadidan past bo'ladi
Marjinal mahsulot daromadidan yuqori bo'ladi
Har doim bozor muvozanati darajasida bo'ladi
options_ru: Полностью устанавливается самим государством
Ниже дохода от предельного продукта труда
Выше дохода от предельного продукта труда
Всегда равна равновесному уровню на рынке
options_en: Completely set by the government itself
Below the marginal revenue product of labour
Above the marginal revenue product of labour
Always equal to the competitive market level
questions.explanation_en: A single buyer of labour faces a rising supply curve, so its marginal cost of labour exceeds the wage; it hires where MRP equals that marginal cost and pays a wage below MRP. Paying above MRP would mean losses, and the outcome differs precisely from the competitive level without any state involvement.

questions.text: Ishbay ish haqi tizimida to'lov nimaga bog'liq bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: От чего зависит оплата при сдельной системе заработной платы?
questions.text_en: What does pay depend on under a piece-rate wage system?
options: Ishlab berilgan vaqt soatlari miqdoriga
Ishchining xizmat muddati uzunligiga
Korxonaning yillik sof foyda hajmiga
Bajarilgan ish yoki mahsulot miqdoriga
options_ru: Количество фактически отработанных часов
Длительность стажа работы на предприятии
Размер годовой чистой прибыли предприятия
Количество выполненной работы работником
options_en: The number of hours actually worked
The length of service with the firm
The size of the firm's annual net profit
The amount of work actually completed
questions.explanation_en: A piece rate ties earnings directly to measured output, which strengthens the incentive to work intensively. Paying by hours is the time-rate system, seniority pay rewards length of service, and profit sharing links pay to company results.

questions.text: Kollektiv muzokara (collective bargaining) nimani anglatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает коллективный договорный процесс?
questions.text_en: What does collective bargaining mean?
options: Ikki ishchi o'rtasida tuzilgan shaxsiy kelishuv
Davlat tomonidan ish haqini bir tomonlama belgilash
Ishchilarni tanlash va ishga qabul qilish tartibi
Kasaba uyushmasi va ish beruvchi o'rtasidagi muzokara
options_ru: Личное соглашение между двумя наёмными работниками
Односторонняя установка зарплаты государством
Порядок отбора и приёма работников на работу
Переговоры профсоюза с работодателем об условиях
options_en: A private agreement between two hired workers
A one-sided setting of wages by the government
The procedure for selecting and hiring workers
Negotiation between a union and the employer
questions.explanation_en: Collective bargaining is the joint negotiation of wages and working conditions by the organised workforce with the employer, which strengthens the workers' bargaining position. An individual contract, a state decree and recruitment procedures are all different institutions.

questions.text: Jini koeffitsienti nimani o'lchaydi?
questions.text_ru: Что измеряет коэффициент Джини?
questions.text_en: What does the Gini coefficient measure?
options: Narxlar umumiy darajasini o'lchab beradi
Mehnat unumdorligi o'sishini o'lchaydi
Daromadlar tengsizligi darajasini o'lchaydi
Ishsizlik darajasining o'sishini o'lchaydi
options_ru: Измеряет общий уровень цен в экономике страны
Измеряет темп роста производительности труда
Измеряет степень неравенства доходов населения
Измеряет рост уровня безработицы в стране
options_en: It measures the general level of prices
It measures the growth of labour productivity
It measures the degree of income inequality
It measures the rise in the unemployment rate
questions.explanation_en: The Gini coefficient runs from 0 (complete equality) to 1 (complete inequality) and summarises how far the income distribution departs from equal shares. Unemployment, the price level and productivity are measured by entirely different indicators.

questions.text: Lorents egri chizig'ida mutlaq tenglik qanday ko'rinishda bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Как выглядит абсолютное равенство на кривой Лоренца?
questions.text_en: How is perfect equality shown on a Lorenz curve diagram?
options: Pastga qarab juda kuchli egilgan chiziq
Vertikal holatda joylashgan to'g'ri chiziq
Gorizontal holatda joylashgan to'g'ri chiziq
45 daraja burchak ostidagi to'g'ri chiziq
options_ru: Сильно изогнутая вниз кривая линия графика
Прямая линия, расположенная вертикально
Прямая линия, расположенная горизонтально
Прямая линия под углом сорок пять градусов
options_en: A line bowed sharply below the diagonal
A straight line placed quite vertically
A straight line placed fully horizontally
A straight line at forty-five degrees
questions.explanation_en: If every population share receives an identical income share, the cumulative shares plot along the diagonal, so the 45-degree line is the line of perfect equality. A curve bowed away from the diagonal shows inequality, and vertical or horizontal lines are not possible shapes for cumulative shares.

questions.text: Daromadlarning funksional taqsimlanishi nimani ko'rsatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что показывает функциональное распределение доходов?
questions.text_en: What does the functional distribution of income show?
options: Yosh va jins guruhlari o'rtasida
Ishlab chiqarish omillari o'rtasida
Alohida uy xo'jaliklari o'rtasida
Turli hududlar va viloyatlar o'rtasida
options_ru: Между возрастными и половыми группами
Между факторами производства в экономике
Между отдельными домашними хозяйствами
Между различными регионами и областями
options_en: Between the age and the gender groups
Between the factors of production used
Between individual separate households
Between the different regions of a land
questions.explanation_en: Functional distribution divides national income into wages, rent, interest and profit, that is, by factor of production. Division among households is the personal distribution, while regional, age and gender breakdowns are further descriptive cuts of that personal distribution.

questions.text: A davlatda Jini koeffitsienti 0,48, B davlatda 0,28. Bundan qanday xulosa chiqadi?
questions.text_ru: В стране A коэффициент Джини равен 0,48, в стране B — 0,28. Какой вывод следует?
questions.text_en: Country A has a Gini coefficient of 0.48 and country B has 0.28. What follows from this?
options: A davlatda tengsizlik yuqoriroq
B davlatda tengsizlik yuqoriroq
Ikki davlatda tengsizlik bir xil
Ikki davlatda tengsizlik yo'q
options_ru: В стране A неравенство выше
В стране B неравенство выше
Неравенство в странах одинаково
Неравенства в странах вовсе нет
options_en: Inequality is higher in country A
Inequality is higher in country B
Inequality is the same in both
Inequality is absent in both
questions.explanation_en: A larger Gini value means a distribution further from equality, so inequality in A exceeds that in B. The coefficients differ, so the distributions are not identical, and only a value of zero would indicate no inequality at all.

questions.text: Friksion ishsizlik qaysi holatda yuzaga keladi?
questions.text_ru: В каком случае возникает фрикционная безработица?
questions.text_en: In which situation does frictional unemployment arise?
options: Iqtisodiy tanazzul va inqiroz davri tufayli
Yil fasllariga bog'liq mavsumiy sabablar bilan
Ish qidirish va ish joyini almashtirish davrida
Iqtisodiyotdagi tarkibiy o'zgarishlar tufayli
options_ru: Из-за экономического спада и кризиса в стране
По сезонным причинам, связанным с временем года
В период поиска и смены места работы людьми
Из-за структурных изменений в экономике страны
options_en: Because of an economic downturn and crisis
For seasonal reasons linked to the year
While workers search for and change jobs
Because of structural change in the economy
questions.explanation_en: Frictional unemployment is the short-term joblessness of people moving between positions while information about vacancies is imperfect. Mismatch of skills with new technology is structural unemployment, downturn-related joblessness is cyclical, and weather-driven idleness is seasonal.

questions.text: Ishchilarning g'ayratini oshirish va kadrlar oqimini kamaytirish uchun bozor darajasidan yuqori haq to'lash qanday nomlanadi?
questions.text_ru: Как называется выплата зарплаты выше рыночной для роста усилий и снижения текучести кадров?
questions.text_en: What is it called when a wage above the market level is paid to raise effort and cut labour turnover?
options: Ishbay ish haqi tizimi tartibi
Vaqtbay ish haqi tizimi tartibi
Samaradorlik ish haqi nazariyasi
Minimal ish haqi qonunchiligi
options_ru: Система сдельной заработной платы
Система повременной заработной платы
Теория эффективной заработной платы
Законодательство о минимальной плате
options_en: The piece-rate payment system
The time-rate payment system
The efficiency wage explanation
Minimum wage legislation rules
questions.explanation_en: Efficiency wage theory argues that a premium above the market rate raises effort, attracts better applicants and reduces costly turnover, so it can be profitable for the firm. A statutory minimum is imposed by law, and piece and time rates describe how pay is measured, not its level.

questions.text: Uzoq muddatda real ish haqining o'sishining asosiy manbai nima?
questions.text_ru: Что является главным источником роста реальной заработной платы в длительном периоде?
questions.text_en: What is the main source of rising real wages in the long run?
options: Umumiy mehnat unumdorligining o'sishi
Pul massasining juda tez o'sib ketishi
Mamlakatdagi soliq stavkalarining o'sishi
Ishsizlik darajasining umumiy o'sishi
options_ru: Рост общей производительности труда
Быстрый рост денежной массы в стране
Рост налоговых ставок в стране в целом
Рост общего уровня безработицы в стране
options_en: Growth of overall labour productivity
Rapid growth of the national money supply
Growth of the tax rates in the country
Growth of the unemployment rate overall
questions.explanation_en: Only higher output per worker allows pay to rise without raising prices, so productivity growth driven by capital and human capital is the long-run source of real wage growth. Faster money growth mainly raises prices, higher taxes reduce take-home pay, and more unemployment weakens workers' bargaining position.

questions.text: Mehnat bozorida ish haqi diskriminatsiyasi qachon mavjud bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Когда на рынке труда существует дискриминация в оплате труда?
questions.text_en: When does wage discrimination exist in the labour market?
options: Teng malakali ishchilarga turlicha haq to'lanadi
Turli malakali ishchilarga turlicha haq to'lanadi
Barcha ishchilarga bir xil ish haqi to'lanadi
Ish haqi mahsulot miqdoriga qarab to'lanadi
options_ru: Равным по квалификации работникам платят по-разному
Работникам разной квалификации платят по-разному
Всем работникам платят одинаковую заработную плату
Оплата труда зависит от количества продукции
options_en: Equally qualified workers are paid differently
Differently qualified workers are paid unequally
All of the workers are paid the very same wage
Pay depends on the quantity of output made
questions.explanation_en: Discrimination means equally productive workers receive different pay because of characteristics unrelated to productivity, such as gender or ethnicity. Different pay for different qualifications reflects productivity differences, uniform pay is the opposite case, and output-based pay is simply a piece rate.

questions.text: Yozma mehnat shartnomasida odatda nimalar belgilanadi?
questions.text_ru: Что обычно определяется в письменном трудовом договоре?
questions.text_en: What does a written employment contract normally specify?
options: Ish vazifalari, ish haqi va ish vaqti
Faqat korxonaning yillik foyda hajmi
Faqat mahsulot sotish narxlari ro'yxati
Faqat ishchi yashash joyining manzili
options_ru: Обязанности, размер оплаты и время работы
Только размер годовой прибыли предприятия
Только перечень цен на продукцию фирмы
Только адрес места проживания работника
options_en: The duties, the pay and the working time
Only the annual profit of the enterprise
Only the list of prices of the products
Only the home address of the hired worker
questions.explanation_en: An employment contract fixes the mutual obligations of the parties: job duties, remuneration, hours and conditions of work. Company profit and product prices are commercial matters outside the contract, and the worker's address is only a formal detail.

questions.text: Mehnatga talab oshsa, raqobatli mehnat bozorida nima yuz beradi?
questions.text_ru: Что произойдёт на конкурентном рынке труда при росте спроса на труд?
questions.text_en: What happens in a competitive labour market when the demand for labour increases?
options: Ish haqi tushadi va bandlik kamayadi
Ish haqi oshadi va bandlik kamayadi
Ish haqi tushadi va bandlik ko'payadi
Ish haqi oshadi va bandlik ko'payadi
options_ru: Зарплата падает, занятость сокращается
Зарплата растёт, занятость сокращается
Зарплата падает, занятость увеличивается
Зарплата растёт, занятость увеличивается
options_en: The wage falls and employment decreases
The wage rises and employment decreases
The wage falls and employment increases
The wage rises and employment increases
questions.explanation_en: A rightward shift of labour demand along an upward-sloping supply curve raises both the equilibrium wage and the quantity of labour employed. The opposite movement would follow a fall in demand, and the mixed combinations describe shifts of labour supply instead.

questions.text: Nominal ish haqi 4 000 000 so'm, narxlar indeksi 125 (baza 100). Real ish haqi qancha?
questions.text_ru: Номинальная зарплата 4 000 000 сум, индекс цен 125 (база 100). Чему равна реальная зарплата?
questions.text_en: The nominal wage is 4,000,000 so'm and the price index is 125 (base 100). What is the real wage?
questions.explanation_en: The real wage equals the nominal wage divided by the price index in hundredths: 4,000,000/1.25 = 3,200,000. Leaving the figure unchanged ignores inflation, multiplying by 1.25 gives 5,000,000, and 2,500,000 uses the wrong divisor.

questions.text: Mehnatga bo'lgan talab qaysi holatda ko'proq elastik bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: В каком случае спрос на труд будет более эластичным?
questions.text_en: In which case is the demand for labour more elastic?
options: Mahsulotga talab butunlay elastik bo'lmasa
Ishchilar kasaba uyushmasiga a'zo bo'lmasa
Mehnatni kapital bilan almashtirish oson bo'lsa
Mehnat ulushi umumiy xarajatda juda kichik bo'lsa
options_ru: Спрос на готовую продукцию совсем неэластичен
Работники не состоят в профсоюзе данной отрасли
Труд легко заменяется капиталом в производстве
Доля труда в общих затратах очень невелика
options_en: Demand for the final product is inelastic
The workers do not belong to a trade union
Labour can easily be replaced by capital
The labour share in total cost is very small
questions.explanation_en: The easier it is to substitute machines for workers, the more employment falls when wages rise, so labour demand is more elastic. A small labour share in costs and inelastic product demand both make labour demand less elastic, and union membership affects bargaining power rather than the elasticity itself.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligining asosiy o'ziga xos xususiyati nimada?
questions.text_ru: В чём состоит главная специфическая особенность сельского хозяйства?
questions.text_en: What is the main specific feature of agriculture?
options: Mahsulot ishlab chiqarish mavsumga bog'liq emas
Natijalar ob-havoga umuman bog'liq bo'lmaydi
Ishlab chiqarish davri juda qisqa bo'ladi
Yer asosiy ishlab chiqarish vositasi bo'ladi
options_ru: Производство продукции не зависит от сезона года
Результаты совсем не зависят от погодных условий
Производственный цикл является очень коротким
Земля выступает основным средством производства
options_en: Output does not depend on the season at all
Results do not depend on weather conditions
The production cycle is a very short one
Land is the main means of production used
questions.explanation_en: In farming land is not merely a site but the active means of production, and its fertility and location directly determine output. The other statements are the reverse of reality: agriculture is strongly seasonal, weather dependent and marked by long production cycles.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligidagi mavsumiylik asosan nimaga olib keladi?
questions.text_ru: К чему в основном приводит сезонность в сельском хозяйстве?
questions.text_en: What does seasonality in agriculture mainly lead to?
options: Yer unumdorligining tez sur'atda o'sishi
Mehnat va mablag'lardan notekis foydalanish
Mahsulot sifatining doimiy ravishda o'sishi
Ishlab chiqarish xarajatlarining yo'qolishi
options_ru: Быстрый рост естественного плодородия почвы
Неравномерное использование труда и средств
Постоянное повышение качества всей продукции
Полное исчезновение производственных затрат
options_en: A rapid rise in the natural soil fertility
Uneven use of labour and of the resources
A constant rise in the quality of output
The complete disappearance of all costs
questions.explanation_en: Peak demand for labour and machinery at sowing and harvest alternates with slack periods, so resources stand idle part of the year and working capital is tied up unevenly. Seasonality does not improve product quality, remove costs or raise soil fertility.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligi biologik jarayonlarga bog'liq bo'lgani uchun ishlab chiqarish qarorlari qanday natija beradi?
questions.text_ru: Поскольку сельское хозяйство зависит от биологических процессов, какой результат дают производственные решения?
questions.text_en: Because agriculture depends on biological processes, what result do production decisions give?
options: Umuman hech qanday natija keltirib chiqarmaydi
Faqat narx o'zgarishidan keyin natija beradi
Natijani faqat ma'lum vaqtdan keyin beradi
Natijani darhol, bir zumda namoyon qiladi
options_ru: Вообще не приводят ни к какому результату
Дают результат лишь после изменения цены
Дают результат только через определённое время
Дают результат сразу же, в тот же самый момент
options_en: Do not lead to any kind of result at all
Give results only after prices change
Give results only after a certain period
Give results at once, in the same moment
questions.explanation_en: Plants and animals need a biologically determined growing time, so a decision to plant or breed today yields marketable output only months or years later; this lag makes supply slow to react to prices. Instant adjustment is characteristic of some industrial processes, not of farming.

questions.text: Yer rentasi nimani ifodalaydi?
questions.text_ru: Что выражает земельная рента?
questions.text_en: What does land rent represent?
options: Kapitaldan foydalanish uchun olinadigan foiz
Ish kuchi xizmatlari uchun to'lanadigan haq
Tadbirkorlik tavakkali uchun olinadigan foyda
Yerdan foydalanish uchun to'lanadigan daromad
options_ru: Процент, получаемый за использование капитала
Плата, вносимая за услуги наёмной рабочей силы
Прибыль, получаемая за предпринимательский риск
Доход, уплачиваемый за использование земли
options_en: Interest received for the use of capital
Payment made for the services of labour
Profit received for entrepreneurial risk
Income paid for the use of a plot of land
questions.explanation_en: Rent is the factor income of land: the payment a tenant makes to the owner for the right to use a plot for a period. Interest rewards capital, wages reward labour, and profit rewards entrepreneurship and risk bearing.

questions.text: Birinchi tur differensial renta qanday farqlardan kelib chiqadi?
questions.text_ru: Из каких различий возникает дифференциальная рента первого вида?
questions.text_en: From which differences does differential rent of the first type arise?
options: Yerning tabiiy unumdorligi va joylashuvi
Qo'shimcha kapital qo'yilmalari hajmi
Ishchilar sonining mavsumiy o'zgarishi
Davlat belgilagan soliq stavkalari
options_ru: Естественного плодородия и расположения земли
Объёма дополнительных вложений капитала
Сезонного изменения численности работников
Уровня налоговых ставок, введённых властью
options_en: Natural fertility and location of the land
The volume of extra investment of capital
Seasonal change in the number of workers
The level of tax rates set by the state
questions.explanation_en: Differential rent I stems from natural advantages that cannot be reproduced: better soil and closeness to markets lower costs on favoured plots, and the surplus accrues as rent. Rent arising from additional capital outlays is differential rent II, while labour numbers and taxes are not its source.

questions.text: Ikkinchi tur differensial renta qanday hollarda yuzaga keladi?
questions.text_ru: В каких случаях возникает дифференциальная рента второго вида?
questions.text_en: In which case does differential rent of the second type arise?
options: Bozor narxlarining pasayishi natijasida
Ishchilar sonining kamayishi natijasida
Qo'shimcha kapital qo'yilmalari natijasida
Yerning tabiiy unumdorligi natijasida
options_ru: В результате снижения рыночных цен на товар
В результате сокращения численности рабочих
В результате дополнительных вложений капитала
В результате естественного плодородия земли
options_en: It results from a fall in the market price
It results from a fall in the labour force
It results from extra investment of capital
It results from natural fertility of soil
questions.explanation_en: Differential rent II arises from intensification: irrigation, fertiliser, better machinery and other added capital raise economic fertility and generate an extra surplus on the same plot. Natural fertility gives differential rent I, and falling prices or a smaller workforce reduce rather than create rent.

questions.text: Mutlaq renta yer egasi tomonidan qaysi yerlardan olinadi?
questions.text_ru: С каких земель землевладелец получает абсолютную ренту?
questions.text_en: From which land does the owner receive absolute rent?
options: Faqat eng unumdor uchastkadan
Faqat eng yomon uchastkadan
Faqat shahar yaqinidagi yerdan
Yerning har qanday uchastkasidan
options_ru: Только с самого плодородного участка
Только с наихудшего земельного участка
Только с земли, лежащей близ города
С любого земельного участка вообще
options_en: Only from the most fertile plot
Only from the very worst plot
Only from land close to a city
From any plot of land whatsoever
questions.explanation_en: Absolute rent follows from private ownership and the limited supply of land, so even the least productive plot in cultivation yields a payment to its owner. Rent that depends on the quality or location of the plot is differential rent, not absolute rent.

questions.text: Yer uchastkasining narxi asosan nima bilan aniqlanadi?
questions.text_ru: Чем в основном определяется цена земельного участка?
questions.text_en: What mainly determines the price of a plot of land?
options: Yillik renta va soliq summasi yig'indisi
Yer maydoni va ishchilar soni ko'paytmasi
Mahsulot narxi va hosildorlik ayirmasi
Yillik renta va foiz stavkasi nisbati
options_ru: Суммой годовой ренты и уплаченного налога
Произведением площади земли и числа рабочих
Разностью цены продукции и урожайности поля
Отношением годовой ренты к ставке процента
options_en: The sum of annual rent and the tax paid
The product of land area and number of workers
The difference of output price and the yield
The ratio of annual rent to the interest rate
questions.explanation_en: Land is bought for the stream of rent it yields, so its price is capitalised rent: annual rent divided by the rate of interest. The other expressions mix incompatible magnitudes and cannot give a capital value.

questions.text: Yillik renta 500 so'm, foiz stavkasi 5 foiz bo'lsa, yer narxi qancha?
questions.text_ru: Годовая рента 500 сум, ставка процента 5 процентов. Чему равна цена земли?
questions.text_en: If annual rent is 500 so'm and the interest rate is 5 per cent, what is the price of the land?
questions.explanation_en: Capitalised rent equals 500/0.05 = 10,000 so'm, the sum that would earn the same 500 at the market interest rate. The other figures follow from multiplying rather than dividing by the rate or from using a different rate.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligi yerining umumiy taklifi qanday tavsiflanadi?
questions.text_ru: Как характеризуется общее предложение сельскохозяйственной земли?
questions.text_en: How is the total supply of agricultural land described?
options: Narxga to'liq mutanosib ravishda
Mavsumga qarab keskin o'sadigan
Juda noelastik, deyarli o'zgarmas
Juda elastik va tez o'zgaruvchan
options_ru: Полностью пропорциональным цене земли
Резко растущим в зависимости от сезона
Крайне неэластичным, почти неизменным
Очень эластичным и быстро меняющимся
options_en: Fully proportional to the price
Sharply rising with the season
Highly inelastic and almost fixed
Highly elastic and fast changing
questions.explanation_en: The area of land is naturally limited, so higher rents cannot call forth much additional supply and the supply curve is nearly vertical; this is why demand determines rent. Elastic, price-proportional or seasonally growing supply would contradict the fixed stock of land.

questions.text: Agrobiznes tushunchasi nimani qamrab oladi?
questions.text_ru: Что охватывает понятие агробизнеса?
questions.text_en: What does the concept of agribusiness cover?
options: Faqat qishloq aholisiga xizmat ko'rsatish tizimi
Qishloq xo'jaligi va bog'liq tarmoqlar yagona tizimi
Faqat dalada o'simlik yetishtirish jarayoni o'zi
Faqat chorva mollarini boqish va parvarishlash ishi
options_ru: Только система бытового обслуживания сельских жителей
Единая система сельского хозяйства и смежных отраслей
Только сам процесс выращивания растений на полях
Только работа по содержанию и выпасу скота в селе
options_en: Only the system of services for rural residents
The whole system of farming and related industries
Only the process of growing crops in the fields
Only the work of feeding and tending livestock
questions.explanation_en: Agribusiness covers the entire chain: supply of inputs, farm production, processing, storage, transport and marketing of food. Restricting the term to crop growing, livestock keeping or rural services captures only one link of that chain.

questions.text: Agrobiznesda vertikal integratsiya nimani anglatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает вертикальная интеграция в агробизнесе?
questions.text_en: What does vertical integration in agribusiness mean?
options: Yetishtirish, qayta ishlash va sotishni qo'shadi
Faqat bitta dalada bir xil ekinni yetishtiradi
Faqat tayyor mahsulotni chetdan sotib oladi
Faqat qishloq xo'jaligi texnikasini ta'mirlaydi
options_ru: Соединяет выращивание, переработку и сбыт продукции
Выращивает только одну культуру на одном поле
Только закупает готовую продукцию со стороны
Только ремонтирует сельскохозяйственную технику
options_en: It combines growing, processing and selling
It grows only one single crop on one field
It only buys finished products from outside
It only repairs the machinery used in farming
questions.explanation_en: Vertical integration unites successive stages of the food chain under one management, which cuts transaction costs and secures supplies and quality. Specialising in one crop is monoculture, buying finished goods is trading, and repair work is a service activity.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligi kooperativi nima?
questions.text_ru: Что такое сельскохозяйственный кооператив?
questions.text_en: What is an agricultural cooperative?
options: Davlatga qarashli yirik sanoat korxonasi
Chet el kapitaliga asoslangan qo'shma firma
Bir kishiga tegishli kichik savdo do'koni
Ishlab chiqaruvchilarning ixtiyoriy uyushmasi
options_ru: Крупное промышленное предприятие государства
Совместная фирма на основе иностранного капитала
Небольшой торговый магазин одного владельца
Добровольное объединение самих производителей
options_en: A large industrial enterprise of the state
A joint firm based on foreign capital funds
A small retail shop owned by one person
A voluntary association of the producers
questions.explanation_en: A cooperative is owned and controlled by its member producers, who pool purchasing, processing or marketing to gain scale and bargaining power while sharing the surplus. State enterprises, foreign joint ventures and sole proprietorships rest on quite different ownership principles.

questions.text: Dehqon (oilaviy) xo'jaligining tipik xususiyati nimada?
questions.text_ru: В чём состоит типичная особенность дехканского (семейного) хозяйства?
questions.text_en: What is a typical feature of a family (dehkan) farm?
options: Faqat yollanma ishchilar mehnatini ishlatadi
Faqat davlat buyurtmasi asosida ishlaydi
Faqat eksport uchun mahsulot yetishtiradi
Asosan oila a'zolari mehnatidan foydalanadi
options_ru: Использует только труд наёмных работников
Работает только по государственному заказу
Выращивает продукцию только для экспорта
В основном использует труд членов семьи
options_en: It uses only the labour of hired workers
It works only on a state order contract
It grows produce only for export markets
It mainly uses the labour of family members
questions.explanation_en: The family farm relies on household labour and combines ownership, management and work in the same persons, which lowers supervision costs. Exclusive reliance on hired labour, state orders or export markets describes larger commercial or contract farming instead.

questions.text: Engel qonuniga ko'ra uy xo'jaligi daromadi oshsa nima yuz beradi?
questions.text_ru: Согласно закону Энгеля, что происходит при росте дохода домохозяйства?
questions.text_en: According to Engel's law, what happens as household income rises?
options: Jami sarf-xarajatlar kamayadi
Oziq-ovqat narxlari pasayadi
Oziq-ovqatga sarf ulushi pasayadi
Oziq-ovqatga sarf ulushi ortadi
options_ru: Общая сумма всех расходов семьи падает
Цены на продукты питания заметно падают
Доля расходов на продукты питания падает
Доля расходов на продукты питания растёт
options_en: The total spending of a family falls
The prices of food products decline
The share spent on food declines
The share spent on food increases
questions.explanation_en: Food has a low income elasticity, so as income grows absolute food spending may rise a little while its share of the budget falls; this is why the farm sector's share of the economy shrinks with development. Engel's law says nothing about total spending or about food prices.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligi mahsulotiga talab noelastik bo'lgani uchun mo'l hosil nimaga olib keladi?
questions.text_ru: Поскольку спрос на сельхозпродукцию неэластичен, к чему приводит обильный урожай?
questions.text_en: Because demand for farm products is price-inelastic, what does a large harvest lead to?
options: Faqat eksport hajmining qisqarishiga olib keladi
Narx va daromadning keskin pasayishiga olib keladi
Narx va daromadning keskin o'sishiga olib keladi
Narx va daromadga umuman ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi
options_ru: Ведёт только к сокращению объёмов экспорта
Ведёт к резкому падению цен и доходов фермеров
Ведёт к резкому росту цен и доходов фермеров
Вообще не влияет ни на цены, ни на доходы
options_en: Leads only to a cut in the export volume
Leads to a sharp fall in prices and incomes
Leads to a sharp rise in prices and incomes
Has no effect on either prices or incomes
questions.explanation_en: With inelastic demand a larger quantity can be sold only at a much lower price, so total revenue falls even though output is higher; this is the paradox of the good harvest. Prices cannot rise when supply expands, and the effect on revenue is precisely what makes the case interesting.

questions.text: "Kobweb" (o'rgimchak to'ri) modeli qishloq xo'jaligi narxlarining qanday xususiyatini izohlaydi?
questions.text_ru: Какую особенность сельскохозяйственных цен объясняет паутинообразная модель?
questions.text_en: Which feature of agricultural prices does the cobweb model explain?
options: Faqat pasayish tomon harakat qiladi
Davlat tomonidan to'liq belgilanadi
Yildan yilga kuchli tebranib turadi
Har doim barqaror darajada qoladi
options_ru: Движутся только в сторону снижения
Полностью устанавливаются государством
Сильно колеблются от года к году
Всегда остаются на стабильном уровне
options_en: They move only in a downward direction
They are fully set by the government
They fluctuate sharply from year to year
They remain at a stable level always
questions.explanation_en: Because farmers decide output on the basis of last season's price while supply reacts only after the biological lag, high prices bring overproduction next year and low prices bring shortage, so prices oscillate around equilibrium. Stability, a one-way trend and administrative price setting are not implications of the model.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligiga davlat subsidiyalarining asosiy maqsadi nima?
questions.text_ru: Какова главная цель государственных субсидий сельскому хозяйству?
questions.text_en: What is the main purpose of state subsidies to agriculture?
options: Fermerlar daromadlarini barqarorlashtirish
Oziq-ovqat narxlarini keskin oshirish
Qishloq xo'jaligi mahsulotini kamaytirish
Qishloq aholisi sonini tez qisqartirish
options_ru: Стабилизация доходов фермерских хозяйств
Резкое повышение цен на продукты питания
Сокращение производства сельской продукции
Быстрое уменьшение числа сельских жителей
options_en: Stabilising the incomes of farm households
Raising food prices sharply for consumers
Reducing the output of farm products made
Cutting the number of rural residents fast
questions.explanation_en: Support measures are intended to smooth the income swings caused by weather and inelastic demand and to keep food production and rural employment viable. Raising consumer prices, cutting output and depopulating the countryside are not goals of agricultural policy.

questions.text: Agrar iqtisodiyotda "narx qaychisi" atamasi nimani ifodalaydi?
questions.text_ru: Что выражает термин «ножницы цен» в аграрной экономике?
questions.text_en: What does the term price scissors mean in agrarian economics?
options: Narxlarning davlat organlari tomonidan belgilanishi
Sanoat narxlari qishloq narxlaridan tez o'sishi
Qishloq narxlari sanoat narxlariga teng bo'lishi
Barcha narxlarning bir vaqtda pasayib ketishi
options_ru: Цены устанавливаются только органами государства
Цены промышленности растут быстрее цен села
Цены села становятся равными ценам промышленности
Все цены в экономике одновременно снижаются
options_en: Prices are set by the state authorities alone
Industrial prices rise faster than farm prices
Farm prices become equal to industrial prices
All prices in the economy fall at the same time
questions.explanation_en: Price scissors describe a worsening of agriculture's terms of trade: the prices of fuel, fertiliser and machinery that farmers buy climb faster than the prices they receive, squeezing farm incomes. Equal prices, general deflation and administrative pricing are different phenomena.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligining intensiv rivojlanishi nima hisobidan amalga oshadi?
questions.text_ru: За счёт чего осуществляется интенсивное развитие сельского хозяйства?
questions.text_en: How is intensive development of agriculture achieved?
options: Mavjud yerda unumdorlikni oshirish orqali
Ekin maydonlarini kengaytirish hisobidan
Ishchilar sonini ko'paytirish hisobidan
Yangi yerlarni o'zlashtirish hisobidan
options_ru: За счёт роста урожайности на тех же землях
За счёт расширения посевных площадей полей
За счёт увеличения численности работников
За счёт освоения новых земельных участков
options_en: Raising yields on the same area of land
Expanding the sown area of the fields
Increasing the number of hired workers
Bringing new plots of land into use
questions.explanation_en: Intensive growth raises output per hectare through better seeds, irrigation, fertiliser and technology rather than by using more land. Enlarging the sown area, adding workers or opening virgin land are all forms of extensive growth.

questions.text: Gektardan olinadigan hosildorlik qaysi ko'rsatkichni ifodalaydi?
questions.text_ru: Какой показатель выражает урожайность с гектара?
questions.text_en: Which indicator does yield per hectare express?
options: Yerdan foydalanish samaradorligi
Mehnat unumdorligining darajasi
Kapital rentabelligi ko'rsatkichi
Mahsulot sifatining darajasi
options_ru: Эффективности использования земли
Уровня производительности труда
Показателя рентабельности капитала
Уровня качества готовой продукции
options_en: The efficiency of the use of land
The level of labour productivity
The rate of return on capital used
The quality level of the output
questions.explanation_en: Yield measures output per unit of land and is therefore the central indicator of land productivity. Output per worker measures labour productivity, profit per unit of capital measures its return, and quality is assessed by separate standards.

questions.text: Agrar islohot odatda nimalarda o'zgarishlarni nazarda tutadi?
questions.text_ru: Какие изменения обычно предполагает аграрная реформа?
questions.text_en: What changes does agrarian reform usually involve?
options: Yerga egalik va foydalanish munosabatlarida
Pul massasi hamda bank foiz stavkalarida
Tashqi savdodagi bojxona tariflarida
Davlat budjeti xarajatlari tarkibida
options_ru: В отношениях владения и пользования землёй
В денежной массе и банковских ставках
В таможенных тарифах внешней торговли
В структуре бюджетных расходов государства
options_en: In the ownership and the use of land
In money supply and bank interest rates
In the customs tariffs of foreign trade
In the structure of state budget outlays
questions.explanation_en: Agrarian reform redistributes land and redefines ownership, tenure and lease rights so as to create effective producers. Monetary policy, trade tariffs and budget structure belong to other areas of economic policy.

questions.text: Qishloqning ijtimoiy infratuzilmasi asosan nimalarni o'z ichiga oladi?
questions.text_ru: Что в основном включает социальная инфраструктура села?
questions.text_en: What does rural social infrastructure mainly include?
options: Faqat o'g'it va urug'lik zaxiralari
Faqat bank kreditlari va sug'urta puli
Yo'llar, maktablar va tibbiyot punktlari
Faqat traktorlar va kombaynlar parki
options_ru: Только запасы удобрений и семенного зерна
Только банковские кредиты и страховые суммы
Дороги, школы и медицинские пункты села
Только парк тракторов и комбайнов хозяйства
options_en: Only the stores of fertiliser and seed
Only bank credits and insurance payments
Roads, schools and rural medical points
Only the stock of tractors and combines
questions.explanation_en: Social infrastructure consists of the roads, schools, clinics, water and power networks that make rural life and work possible and raise the quality of rural labour. Machinery and material stocks are productive assets, and credit and insurance are financial services.

questions.text: Oziq-ovqat qiymat zanjirida fermerning sotish narxi qanday bo'ladi?
questions.text_ru: Какой является цена производителя в продовольственной цепочке стоимости?
questions.text_en: In the food value chain, what is the farmgate price like?
options: Chakana narxga aniq teng bo'ladi
Chakana narxdan butunlay mustaqil
Chakana narxdan ancha past bo'ladi
Chakana narxdan ancha yuqori bo'ladi
options_ru: Точно равна розничной цене продукта
Совсем не связана с розничной ценой
Заметно ниже розничной цены продукта
Заметно выше розничной цены продукта
options_en: Exactly equal to the retail price paid
Fully unrelated to the retail price
Noticeably below the retail price paid
Noticeably above the retail price paid
questions.explanation_en: Processing, transport, storage and trade margins are added after the farm gate, so the farmer receives only part of what the consumer pays. The farm price cannot exceed or equal the retail price in a functioning chain, and it is clearly linked to it.

questions.text: Qishloq xo'jaligida hosil sug'urtasi asosan nima uchun qo'llaniladi?
questions.text_ru: Для чего в основном применяется страхование урожая в сельском хозяйстве?
questions.text_en: What is crop insurance in agriculture mainly used for?
options: Ishchilar ish haqini pasaytirish uchun
Ob-havo xatarlari zararini qoplash uchun
Ekin yer maydonlarini kengaytirish uchun
Mahsulot narxini keskin oshirish uchun
options_ru: Чтобы снизить заработную плату работников
Чтобы возместить ущерб от погодных рисков
Чтобы расширить посевные площади хозяйства
Чтобы резко повысить цену своей продукции
options_en: To reduce the wages paid to the workers
To cover losses caused by weather risks
To expand the sown area of the farm land
To raise the price of its own produce
questions.explanation_en: Insurance pools the risks of drought, hail, frost and disease, so a bad season does not destroy the farm's capital and credit standing. It neither enlarges the farm, nor sets product prices, nor affects wage levels.

questions.text: 60 gektar yerdan 240 tonna hosil olindi. Hosildorlik qancha?
questions.text_ru: С 60 гектаров получено 240 тонн урожая. Чему равна урожайность?
questions.text_en: A harvest of 240 tonnes is taken from 60 hectares. What is the yield?
options: Gektariga 4 tonna
Gektariga 6 tonna
Gektariga 14 tonna
Gektariga 40 tonna
options_ru: 4 тонны с гектара
6 тонн с гектара
14 тонн с гектара
40 тонн с гектара
options_en: 4 tonnes per hectare
6 tonnes per hectare
14 tonnes per hectare
40 tonnes per hectare
questions.explanation_en: Yield is output divided by area: 240/60 = 4 tonnes per hectare. The other values follow from dividing by the wrong figure or from mixing up the harvest and the area.

questions.text: Oziq-ovqat xavfsizligi tushunchasi nimani anglatadi?
questions.text_ru: Что означает понятие продовольственной безопасности?
questions.text_en: What does the concept of food security mean?
options: Fermer xo'jaliklari sonining keskin qisqarishi
Aholining oziq-ovqat bilan barqaror ta'minlanishi
Oziq-ovqat eksporti hajmining tez o'sib borishi
Qishloq xo'jaligida narxlarning erkinlashtirilishi
options_ru: Резкое сокращение числа фермерских хозяйств
Устойчивое обеспечение населения продовольствием
Быстрый рост объёмов экспорта продовольствия
Либерализация цен в сельском хозяйстве страны
options_en: A sharp fall in the number of farm units
Stable supply of food to the whole population
Rapid growth in the volume of food exports
Liberalisation of prices in the farm sector
questions.explanation_en: Food security means that all people have reliable physical and economic access to sufficient safe and nutritious food at all times. Export growth, price liberalisation and changes in the number of farms are policy outcomes that may help or hinder it but do not define it.
